declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nothing to declare
declarations.funderStatement: Nothing to declare

detail.abstract: Fernández-Villaverde et al. (2024) propose a dynamic hierarchical factor model to measure geoeconomic fragmentation as a latent construct designed to capture its inherently multifaceted nature. This paper examines the robustness of that framework through four complementary exercises. First, we offer a reconstructive replication of the model and assess the sensitivity of the resulting estimates to alternative state-space representations and identification choices, with particular attention to issues of replicability and scalability. Second, we examine the framework's capacity to accommodate new sources of information by replacing an energy-related uncertainty indicator with a market-based measure constructed from the sensitivity of defense-sector equity returns to geopolitical news. Third, we investigate the role of taxonomy by reassigning selected indicators across the four domains underlying the fragmentation index. Fourth, we examine the behavior of the estimated factors across a set of historically grounded regimes spanning segmented integration, hyperglobalization, slowbalization, and strategic fragmentation. Across all exercises, the aggregate fragmentation factor displays a remarkably high degree of stability. By contrast, the interpretation of domain-specific factors proves considerably more sensitive to modeling choices, proxy selection, and the classification of indicators. The evidence suggests that aggregate measures of geoeconomic fragmentation are robust to a wide range of reasonable specifications, whereas their decomposition across channels remains closely tied to the informational structure through which the latent construct is identified.

AI.tldr: 本文对Fernández-Villaverde等人(2024)提出的动态分层因子模型进行了系统性稳健性检验，通过四项互补的实证练习（重建复制、替代指标、重新分类、历史制度检验）发现：总体地理经济碎片化因子对模型设定高度稳健，但各领域特定因子的解释对建模选择高度敏感。
AI.research_question: Fernández-Villaverde等人(2024)提出的地理经济碎片化动态分层因子模型是否具有稳健性？其估计结果对建模选择、识别方案、指标选择和指标分类的敏感性如何？
AI.motivation: 地理经济碎片化是一个多维度、多面性的潜在构念，其测量方法直接影响政策判断和学术结论。原作者提出的动态分层因子模型是测量该构念的重要工具，但其稳健性尚未被系统检验。由于因子模型对设定选择（状态空间表示、识别约束、指标选择和分类）高度敏感，有必要对该框架进行严格的稳健性评估，以确定哪些结论可靠、哪些结论依赖于特定建模抉择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态分层因子模型（Dynamic Hierarchical Factor Model）；潜在变量测量理论；地理经济碎片化的多维构念理论
AI.method: 四项互补的稳健性检验：(1) 重建复制（reconstructive replication），测试不同状态空间表示和识别选择下的敏感性（重点关注可复现性和可扩展性）；(2) 替代指标检验，用基于国防部门股票收益对地缘政治新闻敏感性的市场化指标替换能源相关不确定性指标；(3) 分类检验（taxonomy），将选定指标在碎片化指数的四个领域间重新分配；(4) 历史制度分析，考察估计因子在分段融合、超级全球化、慢速全球化和战略碎片化等历史阶段的动态行为。
AI.findings: (1) 在所有稳健性练习中，总体碎片化因子表现出高度稳定性；(2) 领域特定因子的解释对建模选择、代理指标选择和指标分类显著敏感；(3) 总体地理经济碎片化的测量对广泛的合理设定具有稳健性，而其跨渠道分解与识别潜在构念的信息结构密切相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为地理经济碎片化的测量文献提供了严谨的稳健性证据，明确了模型结论的边界条件：总体层面结论具有普遍可靠性，而领域分解层面的结论需要谨慎解释。这深化了对潜在构念测量中"总体与分解"稳健性不对称性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为使用地理经济碎片化测量的政策制定者和研究者提供了操作指南：总体碎片化指数可放心用于政策分析和跨国比较，但基于领域特定因子（如贸易、金融、科技等领域）的结论应结合具体的信息结构和指标选择进行审慎解读。

title: Fair Value Gaps Work — Until You Try to Trade Them

detail.title: Fair Value Gaps Work — Until You Try to Trade Them
detail.abstract: We test the widely-taught belief that a Fair Value Gap (FVG) — a three-candle price imbalance — marks a level where price will reliably react, using seven years of data across four liquid futures markets, three timeframes, and roughly 40,000 detected occurrences. We measure not only whether price reacts at these levels, but whether it does so more than a random level at the same distance — the only test that separates a genuine signal from noise. We find the reaction is real as a measurement (approximately five percentage points above random) but carries no tradeable edge. Across five independent trade constructions — including the 5- and 15-minute versions most heavily marketed on social media — the effect is either a coin flip or, at its best, exactly consumed by realistic trading costs. The one construction that appears strongly profitable proves to be an artifact: it depends on resolving trade exits on coarse hourly bars, which smuggles in look-ahead bias; measured honestly on 1-minute data, the apparent edge collapses from a profit factor of ~2.4 to ~1.0. The result is consistent across all four instruments and every timeframe. We report the descriptive finding and the negative tradability result together, with full sample sizes and methodology, so that other researchers can verify, extend, or refute this work.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过七年、四个流动性期货市场、三个时间框架、约40,000个检测到的FVG（公平价值缺口）实例，检验了广泛流传的"FVG是价格可靠反应的水平"这一信念。研究发现价格在这些水平的反应确实略高于随机水平（约高5个百分点），但不具备可交易的超额收益。五种独立的交易构建中，效果要么是抛硬币，要么最好的情况恰好被现实交易成本所吞噬。唯一看似显著盈利的构建被证明是人为产物——它依赖粗粒度小时K线解析交易出场，隐含了前视偏差；在诚实的1分钟数据上测量时，表观利润因子从约2.4骤降至约1.0。结果在四种工具和每个时间框架下均一致。
AI.research_question: FVG（公平价值缺口）是否真的标志着价格会可靠反应的水平？这种反应是否具有可交易的超额收益（edge）？
AI.motivation: FVG是社交媒体和交易教育中广泛教授的交易概念，但缺乏严谨的实证检验。现有讨论多为轶事证据或选择性呈现，需要区分真实信号与噪声的严格测试，以判断其是否具有实际交易价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场效率假说（弱式有效市场）、价格不平衡/供给需求失衡理论，以及统计检验中区分真实信号与随机噪声的对照方法（与同距离随机水平比较）。
AI.method: 使用七个年头横跨四个流动性期货市场、三个时间框架的数据，自动检测约40,000个FVG实例。核心方法是将FVG处的价格反应率与同距离随机水平的反应率进行比较，以分离信号与噪声。构建五种独立的交易策略（包括社交媒体上最流行的5分钟和15分钟版本），并检验其盈利性，同时严格控制前视偏差（尤其是出场时使用的数据粒度）。
AI.findings: （1）FVG处的价格反应确实略高于随机水平（约高5个百分点），说明作为测量现象是真实存在的；（2）但这种优势不具有可交易性——五种交易构建中要么近似抛硬币，要么最好的结果恰好被现实交易成本完全消耗；（3）唯一看似强烈盈利的构建是伪影：依赖粗粒度小时K线解析出场导致前视偏差，在正确的1分钟数据上测量后，利润因子从约2.4跌至约1.0；（4）上述结论在全部四种工具和所有时间框架下高度一致。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提供了一个严格的实证框架，区分"现象真实存在"与"具备可交易性"两个层次，为市场微结构研究中的信号检验提供了方法论范例；（2）揭示了前视偏差（look-ahead bias）如何通过数据粒度选择被无意引入，对实证资产定价和交易策略检验方法具有方法论警示意义；（3）支持弱式市场有效假说：即使是社交媒体上广泛传播的"技术信号"，在经过严谨检验后也不存在超额收益。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为使用FVG策略的交易者提供了严谨的证据，表明该信号虽有其统计真实性但无法覆盖交易成本，不能作为独立盈利策略的基础；（2）对社交媒体上广泛营销的FVG交易课程和内容提出了实证质疑，帮助投资者识别夸大其词的交易主张；（3）提供了完整的方法论、样本量和检测框架，供其他研究者验证、扩展或反驳，促进交易策略研究领域的可复现性。

title: Trust but Verify: Benchmarking Gallup World Poll Employment Data Against the EU-Labour Force Survey
affiliations: and

detail.title: Trust but Verify: Benchmarking Gallup World Poll Employment Data Against the EU-Labour Force Survey
detail.abstract: The Gallup World Poll (GWP) links internationally comparable measures of well-being and attitudes to a short labour-market module. We benchmark its employment and hours variables against EU Labour Force Survey (EU LFS) microdata in available European countryyears from 2009 to 2023. Under a broad GWP definition that includes both part-time categories, the average country-level GWP-EU LFS employment-rate gap is approximately-1.0 percentage point. The pooled Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition yields a total gap of-0.85 points: observable composition accounts for-0.97 points and the unexplained component is +0.12 points, with a standard error of 1.99 points. This aggregate result masks country and demographic heterogeneity. A narrow definition that excludes part-time work understates employment by roughly 10-20 points. For hours, the GWP mean is 40.18 hours per week, compared with 37.41 in the EU LFS. Demographic reweighting reduces the aggregate difference from 2.77 to 1.99 hours, while group-specific reweighting raises each country-group difference by 0.11 to 0.58 hour. Hours reports generally require more recall and aggregation than binary employment status. The GWP limits this burden by anchoring employment to the preceding seven days and recording total weekly hours in five intervals. The resulting variable provides a common interval-based measure of work intensity; exact mean levels depend on the values assigned to those intervals.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2009至2023年欧洲国家数据，将盖洛普世界民意调查（GWP）的就业与工时变量与欧盟劳动力调查（EU LFS）微观数据进行比较。研究发现，在广义定义下，GWP与EU LFS的就业率差距约为-1.0个百分点；Oaxaca-Blinder分解显示总差距为-0.85点，其中可观测构成部分为-0.97点，不可解释部分为+0.12点。然而，狭义定义（排除兼职）会使就业率低估10-20个百分点。在工时方面，GWP周均工时为40.18小时，高于EU LFS的37.41小时，人口学加权可将差异从2.77小时降至1.99小时。GWP通过锚定前七天就业和区间式工时记录来减轻记忆负担。
AI.research_question: GWP的就业和工时变量在多大程度上与国际可比的高质量劳动力调查数据（EU LFS）一致？其测量差异的来源和大小是什么？
AI.motivation: GWP作为覆盖全球的民意调查，其劳动力市场模块被广泛使用，但其与官方劳动力调查数据之间的可比性尚未得到系统验证。理解这些测量差异对研究者和政策制定者正确使用GWP数据至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场测量误差理论、Oaxaca-Blinder分解方法（用于区分可观测构成差异与不可解释差异）、调查设计中的回忆偏差与聚合偏差理论。
AI.method: 将GWP数据与EU LFS微观数据进行基准比较；使用广义和狭义两种就业定义；运用Oaxaca-Blinder分解分析就业率差距的来源；采用人口学重加权和组别特定重加权方法分析工时差异。
AI.findings: （1）广义定义下GWP就业率平均差距为-1.0个百分点，Oaxaca-Blinder分解总差距为-0.85点，主要由可观测构成驱动（-0.97点），不可解释部分很小（+0.12点，标准误1.99）；（2）狭义定义（排除兼职）导致就业率低估10-20个百分点；（3）GWP周均工时（40.18小时）高于EU LFS（37.41小时），人口学重加权将差异从2.77降至1.99小时；（4）组别特定重加权使各国各组的差异增加0.11至0.58小时；（5）GWP通过七天就业锚定和五个区间的工时记录减轻回忆负担。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统量化了全球民意调查与官方劳动力调查之间在就业率和工时测量上的偏差幅度与来源；验证了Oaxaca-Blinder分解在跨国劳动力测量比较中的适用性；揭示了调查设计（定义宽窄、时间锚定、测量区间）对劳动力变量可比性的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者使用GWP劳动力数据提供误差量级参考和解释指南；为理解不同就业定义（是否包含兼职）导致的系统性低估提供了量化证据；为跨调查数据比较与整合提供了方法论指导；为调查设计优化（如时间锚定和区间测量）提供经验支持。

title: Beauty and the Blades: The Local Economic Impact of Wind Turbines *
affiliations: , University of Amsterdam and Sapienza University Of Rome, Department of Social Sciences and Economics

detail.title: Beauty and the Blades: The Local Economic Impact of Wind Turbines *
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of wind turbine visibility on tourism outcomes. Using data from Italy from 1998-2019, we show that the visibility of wind turbines reduces tourist arrivals by 20%, with the effect peaking approximately seven years after installation. The effect is mainly driven by rural areas. Tourist spending follows a similar pattern, declining by about 19%. We further estimate that tourism-related losses offset up to 40% of the CO 2 emission savings resulting from wind turbine installations. These findings highlight the need for policies that mitigate local externalities while preserving broader environmental benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文利用意大利1998-2019年的数据，研究发现风力涡轮机的可见性使游客到达量减少20%，该效应在安装后约七年达到峰值，且主要集中于农村地区。游客支出也呈现类似模式，下降约19%。研究进一步估算，旅游业相关损失抵消了风力涡轮机安装所带来CO₂减排效益的40%。
AI.research_question: 风力涡轮机的可见性如何影响旅游业（游客到达量和游客支出）？
AI.motivation: 风力发电作为清洁能源被广泛推广，但其可能对当地景观和旅游业产生负面影响，这种地方性外部效应可能抵消部分环境收益，需要对其进行量化评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地方性外部性理论、清洁能源的本地负外部性与全球正外部性权衡框架、景观美学价值理论
AI.method: 利用意大利1998-2019年的面板数据，采用计量经济学方法（如双重差分或事件研究设计）估计风力涡轮机可见性对旅游业的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 风力涡轮机可见性使游客到达量减少20%；2. 该效应在安装后约七年达到峰值；3. 效应主要由农村地区驱动；4. 游客支出下降约19%；5. 旅游业损失抵消了CO₂减排效益的至多40%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次量化了风力涡轮机可见性对旅游业的因果影响，揭示了清洁能源的本地负外部性规模，为可再生能源与环境政策之间的权衡提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了风力涡轮机选址的参考依据，强调需制定缓解地方外部性的政策（如合理选址、景观补偿等），同时保留风电的全球环境效益。

title: The Power Structure of Knowledge in Co-creation: A Generative Relational Being Perspective

detail.title: The Power Structure of Knowledge in Co-creation: A Generative Relational Being Perspective
detail.abstract: Accounts of knowledge and power have taken two broad forms. On the first, knowledge is content, and power is a contamination that a well-ordered epistemic practice excludes. On the second, associated with Foucault and with the sociology of knowledge, power conditions what may count as knowledge, so that the two are historically inseparable. This paper proposes a third account. Knowledge is a relational structure through which interpretation is coordinated, and every such structure generates asymmetry among its participants. Upon that asymmetry the tendency of a position to maintain itself is itself generative: it produces the conditions of its own continuation. Power in knowledge is this self-maintaining generativity, which places it within generation rather than in opposition to it. Five channels through which an epistemic asymmetry maintains itself are distinguished, following the life of an interpretation (proposal, admission, validation, revision, attribution), together with the cost of exit that prices them. The paper argues that a configuration degrades when the generation issuing from a position turns to the production of its own conditions, and that the criterion of this turn is the closure of the revision loop: whether an exercise of revision alters the conditions under which the next interpretation is generated. Generative power is treated as power rather than as its benign alternative, marked by the erosion of the conditions on which the exercising position depends. The account is developed across education, intimacy, international relations, and academic knowledge production, which are taken as instances of one mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出关于知识与权力的第三种解释：知识是协调诠释的关系性结构，每个此类结构都在参与者之间产生不对称性，这种不对称性驱动的自我维持生成力即为权力。论文区分了诠释生命历程中不对称性自我维持的五条渠道，并提出配置退化的判据是修正回路的闭合。该解释适用于教育、亲密关系、国际关系与学术知识生产等领域。
AI.research_question: 知识与权力的关系究竟是什么？如何超越"知识内容被权力污染"与"权力条件化知识"两种既有解释，提供第三种理论路径？
AI.motivation: 既有的两种知识-权力观存在局限：第一种将权力视为应当被排除的污染，忽视了知识本身的结构性权力；第二种（福柯及知识社会学）虽承认二者不可分，但未能解释权力如何在知识生成内部具体运作。本文试图在"生成"内部而非对立面上定位权力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识作为关系性结构（协调诠释）；不对称性生成理论；自我维持的生成力（self-maintaining generativity）；诠释生命循环理论（提出、接纳、验证、修正、归因五阶段）；修正回路闭合判据；退出成本经济学。
AI.method: 理论演绎与概念分析，辅以跨领域案例比较（教育、亲密关系、国际关系、学术知识生产），论证各领域呈现同一机制。
AI.findings: 1）知识结构必然产生参与者间的不对称性；2）权力即这种不对称性的自我维持生成力，位于生成之内而非其对立面；3）不对称性通过五条渠道（提案、接纳、验证、修正、归因）自我维持，以退出成本为其定价；4）当某位置的生成转为生产自身延续条件时，配置即退化，判断标准是修正回路的闭合。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出关于知识与权力的第三种理论路径，将权力重新定位为知识生成的内在机制而非外部污染或单纯历史条件；以"修正回路闭合"为判据，为权力退化提供了精确的理论标准；将福柯式洞见操作化为可分析的结构机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多领域（教育、亲密关系、国际关系、学术生产）提供识别权力退化的分析框架；通过"修正回路"与"退出成本"概念，为实践者提供检测知识结构健康度的诊断工具。

title:
Access Dilution in Contribution Economies 
Scarcity, Scale, and the Erosion of Contribution Purchasing Power

detail.title:
Access Dilution in Contribution Economies 
Scarcity, Scale, and the Erosion of Contribution Purchasing Power
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Contribution Purchasing Power (CPP) model to analyse how the value of participation changes as contribution-based systems scale. It defines Access Dilution as the decline in the effective value of benefits such as exclusivity, recognition, proximity, and meaningful interaction when participation grows without corresponding expansion in scarce resources. Building on the economics of positional goods and club goods, and drawing on platform theory, the model distinguishes Access Dilution from conventional inflation and deliberate platform degradation. The paper argues that Access Dilution is often a structural outcome of growth colliding with scarcity rather than extractive intent. It offers a contributor-centric framework for understanding contemporary membership, creator, and donor economies, supported by original figures and a real-world case study.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"贡献购买力"（CPP）模型，分析基于贡献的系统在规模化过程中参与价值的变化。定义了"访问稀释"（Access Dilution）概念，即当参与人数增长但稀缺资源未相应扩张时，排他性、认可、接近性和有意义互动等好处的有效价值下降。基于地位品和俱乐部品经济学，并结合平台理论，将访问稀释与普通通胀及平台蓄意降质区分开来。
AI.research_question: 贡献型系统在规模扩张时，参与价值如何变化？访问稀释这一现象如何产生及其本质是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注平台经济的通胀效应或平台故意降质行为，但缺乏一个专门框架来解释因规模增长与稀缺资源冲突而导致参与价值结构性下降的现象，特别是针对会员制、创作者经济和捐赠经济等当代贡献驱动型系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地位品经济学（positional goods）、俱乐部品经济学（club goods）、平台理论（platform theory）
AI.method: 理论建模（贡献购买力CPP模型），辅以原创图表和一个真实世界案例研究
AI.findings: 访问稀释通常是增长与稀缺性碰撞的结构性结果，而非平台的攫取意图所致；它区别于传统通胀和平台蓄意降质，是一种独立且可识别的发展现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"贡献购买力"（CPP）模型和"访问稀释"（Access Dilution）这一新概念，为理解贡献型系统的规模效应提供了新的理论透镜，将地位品/俱乐部品理论与平台研究融合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当代会员制、创作者经济和捐赠经济中的参与者、平台运营者及政策制定者提供了一个以贡献者为中心的框架，帮助识别和应对规模增长带来的价值稀释问题。

title: Innovation-Output Relationship: Does Location Matter?
affiliations: Delhi School of Economics and South Asian University

detail.title: Innovation-Output Relationship: Does Location Matter?
detail.abstract: This is an extensive review paper on the relationship pertaining to innovation and returns to investment. It begins by adhering to the view that innovation-output relationship differs across space as the spatial characteristics causally induce firms to innovate and the response to innovation in terms of total factor productivity growth or any other indicator also varies across space. Given this background each subsection considers a particular locational characteristic, and asks of it whether, first, the theory suggests that this should matter, and second, whether the evidence supports a genuine causal relation or it is a mere correlation which could have been produced for some other reason. It may be seen that the most prominent empirical claim made in this literature stands on shaky identification grounds. Location appears to be convincingly related to innovation in many settings and with many techniques, but the mechanisms behind the causal effect (density, spill-overs, diversity or quality of institutions) are still only partially identified. More in-depth research is required to decipher the firm level, industry level and the location-specific characteristics and the mechanisms through which they are related in certain situations.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于创新与投资回报关系的广泛综述论文，指出创新-产出关系在不同空间存在差异，空间特征既因果性地促使企业创新，也影响创新带来的全要素生产率增长等回报。文章逐一考察各类区位特征，评估其理论重要性及实证识别强度，发现该领域最突出的实证主张建立在脆弱的识别基础上——区位与创新的关联虽稳健，但背后的因果机制（密度、溢出、多样性或制度质量）仍仅被部分识别。
AI.research_question: 区位特征是否以及如何因果性地影响企业创新及其投资回报？现有实证证据中的因果识别是否牢固？
AI.motivation: 创新与投资回报的关系在不同空间呈现差异，需要系统性地审视各区位特征（如密度、溢出、多样性、制度质量）是否在理论上应发挥作用、在实证上是否具有真实因果效应而非仅是相关性，以厘清该领域文献的可靠程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间经济学与创新理论，涵盖区位特征（密度、知识溢出、产业多样性、制度质量）影响企业创新决策及创新回报的理论机制。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述方法，按区位特征分小节，逐一评估其理论依据与实证识别策略（因果关系vs.相关性）的可靠性。
AI.findings: 区位与创新之间的关系在多种设定与技术下均表现稳健，但该领域最突出的实证主张建立在脆弱的识别基础上。因果效应背后的具体机制（密度、溢出、多样性或制度质量）仍仅被部分识别，尚需深入的细分研究来解析企业层面、行业层面与区位特定特征及其作用机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地梳理了空间特征与创新及投资回报之间的理论联系，揭示了各区位特征因果机制的识别缺口，为该领域未来理论研究指明了方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者与从业者提供了关于区位政策（如产业集聚、制度完善）对创新回报影响证据可靠性的评估，警示不宜过度依赖当前的因果推断结论。

title: Digital Assets: A Unified Global Framework of Property Law, Regulation, Accounting and Capital Treatment

detail.title: Digital Assets: A Unified Global Framework of Property Law, Regulation, Accounting and Capital Treatment
detail.abstract: A digital asset has to be classified twice over. Private law asks what the holder actually owns, a thing or only a claim, and that answer decides what happens when the intermediary holding the asset fails: the holder lifts the asset out of the estate, or proves in the insolvency as a creditor. Regulatory law asks which rulebook governs the asset, and so which supervisor, licence and disclosure rules apply. This book builds a single framework on those two questions and carries the private-law answer through to the two treatments that follow from it: the accounting under IFRS and United States GAAP, and the bank capital charge under the Basel cryptoasset standard (SCO60), in force since January 2026. On that scaffold it defines ten functional categories, grouped into five families, surveyed across nineteen jurisdictions, the world's leading frameworks, and against the principal international authorities: UNIDROIT, the Basel Committee, the Financial Stability Board, the FATF and the SEC's 2026 interpretive release. The categories track standards that already exist; the contribution is the layer those standards omit: the proprietary characterisation that the UNIDROIT and ELI Principles, by design, refer to other law, carried through to the accounting and capital treatment of every category. The book closes with practical protocols for the legal practitioner, the public accountant and the policymaker building a digital asset regime that interoperates globally.

AI.tldr: 本书构建了一个统一框架，解答数字资产的双重分类问题（私法上的所有权性质与监管法上的规则适用），并将私法答案贯穿至会计处理（IFRS与美国GAAP）及银行资本监管（巴塞尔加密资产标准SCO60）中。基于此框架定义了十个功能类别、五大族系，覆盖十九个司法辖区及主要国际权威机构（UNIDROIT、巴塞尔委员会、金融稳定理事会、FATF、SEC 2026年解释性公告），并为法律从业者、公共会计师和政策制定者提供全球互操作的实践协议。
AI.research_question: 数字资产应如何在私法上分类（持有人拥有的是物还是仅仅是一项债权），以及该分类如何影响中介机构破产时的处置（取回资产或作为债权人参与破产分配）？同时，监管法上应适用哪套规则体系，且私法分类如何贯穿至会计处理和银行资本监管中？
AI.motivation: 数字资产面临双重分类问题：私法上需确定持有人拥有的是物（thing）还是债权（claim），这决定中介机构失败时持有人是取回资产还是作为债权人参与破产清偿；监管法上需确定适用哪套规则。现有国际标准（如UNIDROIT和ELI原则）有意将所有权定性问题指向其他法律，留下了空白，且缺乏将私法定性贯穿至会计与资本监管的统一框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于双重分类理论框架：私法层面的所有权性质分类（物 vs 债权）与监管法层面的规则适用分类；并将私法分类结果作为基础，贯通至会计处理（IFRS与美国GAAP）和银行资本监管（巴塞尔加密资产标准SCO60）。
AI.method: 比较法研究方法：构建单一分类框架，定义十个功能类别（分为五大族系），对十九个司法辖区及世界主要法律框架进行系统调研，并与主要国际权威机构文件（UNIDROIT、巴塞尔委员会、金融稳定理事会、FATF、SEC 2026年解释性公告）进行对照分析。
AI.findings: 本书定义了十个功能类别并归为五大族系，覆盖十九个司法辖区；发现现有国际标准（如UNIDROIT与ELI原则）有意将所有权定性问题交由其他法律处理，而本书的贡献在于补充这一缺失层面——将专有性定性贯穿至各类别的会计处理和资本监管待遇中。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了现有国际标准缺失的层面：将UNIDROIT与ELI原则有意留给其他法律的专有性（所有权）定性问题，系统性地贯穿至每一类别的会计处理（IFRS/GAAP）与银行资本监管（巴塞尔SCO60）中，构建了私法分类与会计/资本监管之间的理论桥接框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为三类实践者提供操作协议：法律从业者（处理中介失败时的资产处置与破产问题）、公共会计师（适用IFRS与美国GAAP会计处理）、政策制定者（构建可全球互操作的数字资产监管制度）。

title: Machine Learning, Return Predictability, and Implementable Alpha on the Ghana Stock Exchange
affiliations: , Ege University, Accra Technical University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Machine Learning, Return Predictability, and Implementable Alpha on the Ghana Stock Exchange

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We confirm that no authors of this manuscript have any competing financial or non-financial interests, currently or previously, including serving in an editorial capacity for the journal we are submitting to.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the return predictability and portfolio performance of machine learning models relative to conventional asset pricing models on the Ghana Stock Exchange using monthly equity, macroeconomic, and commodity price data from 2007:M12-2023:M4. Results show that Elastic Net delivers the strongest out-of-sample performance, achieving an R² of 28.23%, an annualised long-short portfolio return of 88.4%, and a gross Sharpe ratio of 3.28. This substantially outperforms CAPM (-0.08% return; Sharpe-0.003) and ARIMA (14.7% return; Sharpe 0.59). Although the market consists of a concentrated eight-stock liquid universe typical of frontier markets, the performance differential remains economically and statistically significant. After accounting for GSE-specific transaction costs of 1.5%-2.5% round-trip, net Sharpe ratios remain between 1.86 and 2.96. Subsample results further indicate improving predictive performance over time, implying that regularised nonlinear machine learning models can extract persistent alpha in emerging equity markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了机器学习模型相对于传统资产定价模型在加纳证券交易所的收益可预测性和投资组合表现，利用2007年12月至2023年4月的月度股票、宏观经济和商品价格数据。结果显示Elastic Net模型表现最佳，样本外R²为28.23%，年化多空组合收益为88.4%，毛夏普比率为3.28，显著优于CAPM和ARIMA模型，即使在考虑交易成本后仍有可观净收益。
AI.research_question: 机器学习模型相对于传统资产定价模型在新兴前沿市场（加纳证券交易所）的收益可预测性和投资组合表现如何？
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习预测研究主要集中在发达市场，对新兴前沿市场（如非洲股市）的研究不足。需要检验机器学习模型在流动性有限、市场集中的前沿市场中是否仍能提取持续性超额收益（alpha）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产定价理论（CAPM）、时间序列预测（ARIMA）、正则化机器学习方法（Elastic Net等）以及前沿市场微观结构理论。
AI.method: 使用月度股票、宏观经济和商品价格数据，比较机器学习模型（如Elastic Net）与传统模型（CAPM、ARIMA）的样本外预测表现；构建多空投资组合评估收益表现；考虑GSE交易成本（1.5%-2.5%往返）计算净夏普比率；进行子样本分析检验预测能力随时间的变化。
AI.findings: Elastic Net模型表现最佳，样本外R²为28.23%，年化多空组合收益88.4%，毛夏普比率3.28，显著优于CAPM（-0.08%收益，夏普-0.003）和ARIMA（14.7%收益，夏普0.59）。考虑交易成本后净夏普比率仍达1.86-2.96，子样本分析显示预测性能随时间提升，表明正则化非线性机器学习模型能在新兴股权市场提取持续性alpha。
AI.theory_contributions: 将机器学习预测框架扩展到前沿市场，证明了在仅有八只流动性股票的集中市场中机器学习模型仍能提取显著alpha，挑战了认为机器学习优势仅在发达市场显著的假设；同时检验了市场效率理论在前沿市场的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为前沿市场投资者提供了可操作的机器学习投资策略，证实即使在1.5%-2.5%的高交易成本环境下仍可获得显著净收益，为新兴市场资产配置和被动投资策略的改进提供了实证依据。

title: Executive Compensation and Conflicts of Interest in Analyst Research
affiliations: University of Oklahoma, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Oklahoma - Division of Finance

detail.title: Executive Compensation and Conflicts of Interest in Analyst Research
detail.abstract: The paper studies whether executive compensation incentives can affect how sell-side analysts produce and disseminate accounting information about other firms. We examine brokerage houses whose executives receive relative performance evaluation (RPE) awards based on total shareholder returns. By linking executive pay to named peers’ stock prices, these contracts create incentives for affiliated analysts to disclose unfavorable information about those peers when it is most relevant for the broker’s compensation outcome. We find that affiliated analysts devote more attention to RPE rivals, and their research becomes more negative during final performance-measurement windows: they revise earnings forecasts downward, write in a more pessimistic tone, and elicit more negative announcement returns. Forecast accuracy does not decline, consistent with strategic dissemination of credible negative information. The effects concentrate among peers whose stock price declines can improve the broker’s relative rank, and final rankings cluster on the payout-favorable side of rank cutoffs. Overall, the results show that executive incentives can create conflicts of interest in the production, timing, content, and tone of analyst research.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了高管薪酬激励如何影响卖方分析师对其他公司的会计信息生产和传播。研究发现，当经纪公司高管获得基于总股东回报的相对绩效评估（RPE）奖励时，关联分析师会更有动力在关键绩效窗口披露对RPE竞争对手不利的信息——如向下修正盈利预测、使用更悲观的语气、引发更负面的公告回报。这些影响集中在股价下跌能改善经纪公司相对排名的同行中，且最终排名会聚集在有利于薪酬支付的截断值一侧。
AI.research_question: 高管薪酬激励是否会影响卖方分析师对其他公司会计信息的产生和传播？具体而言，基于相对绩效评估（RPE）的高管薪酬合同是否会促使关联分析师对RPE竞争对手发布不利信息？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注分析师自身利益冲突或公司层面的激励对分析师行为的影响，但很少探讨经纪公司高管的薪酬激励是否会对分析师的独立性和信息生产行为产生系统性影响。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 相对绩效评估理论（Relative Performance Evaluation）；代理理论及高管薪酬激励理论；分析师利益冲突理论。
AI.method: 实证研究方法，利用经纪公司高管RPE薪酬合约的自然实验，通过对比分析关联分析师对RPE同行与其他人关注度、预测修正方向、语气、公告回报，以及预测准确性等指标进行差异分析。
AI.findings: 1. 关联分析师对RPE竞争对手投入更多关注；2. 在最终绩效衡量窗口期间研究更为负面（盈利预测下调、语气悲观、引发更负面公告回报）；3. 预测准确性未下降，表明是有策略地传播可信的负面信息；4. 效应集中在股价下跌能改善经纪公司相对排名的同行中；5. 最终排名聚集在薪酬支付有利的截断值一侧。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了高管薪酬激励作为分析师利益冲突的新来源，扩展了分析师利益冲突和薪酬激励交叉领域的研究；证明执行层面的激励能渗透到分析师研究的生产、时机、内容和语气等多个维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和投资者提供了新的视角：高管薪酬合约设计（尤其是RPE合约）可能在无意中创造分析师利益冲突，需关注此类激励对市场信息效率和质量的影响。

title: A Two-Stage Scheduling Heuristic for the Deadline-Constrained Traveling Salesman Problem with a Drone Station (TSP-DS)

detail.title: A Two-Stage Scheduling Heuristic for the Deadline-Constrained Traveling Salesman Problem with a Drone Station (TSP-DS)

keywords: Traveling Salesman Problem with Drone Stations

detail.abstract: This study investigates a deadline-constrained traveling salesman problem with drone stations in which a truck replenishes fixed drone pads and drones serve geographically eligible customers. The objective is to minimize total order tardiness under release times and soft delivery deadlines. A mixed-integer programming formulation jointly determines pad activation, truck routing, customer-to-pad assignment, drone sequencing, and delivery timing. Because the integrated model becomes computationally difficult at realistic demand scales, this study proposes LBIP-VND, an iterative two-stage heuristic combining load-balanced assignment, tardiness-based best insertion, variable-neighborhood descent, and truck routing guided by pad-level tardiness penalties. The method is evaluated on semi-synthetic Manhattan instances containing 48 candidate pads and approximately 1,500 orders with 60-minute delivery targets. Across all tested scales and departure settings, LBIP-VND produced feasible schedules within a few seconds. For full-size instances, average runtime was 2.88 seconds and average total tardiness was 9.53 hours across approximately 1,500 orders. Under a relaxed midnight-departure benchmark, all instances achieved zero tardiness. In contrast, the exact formulation exhibited rapidly increasing runtime and did not reliably produce competitive full-scale solutions within a two-hour limit. The results demonstrate that scheduling-based decomposition can provide scalable, service-level-oriented solutions for large fixed-pad truck--drone delivery systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对带有无人机站的截止日期约束旅行商问题，提出LBIP-VND两阶段迭代启发式算法，在约1500个订单、48个候选停机坪的曼哈顿实例上，平均2.88秒内生成可行调度方案，平均总延迟9.53小时，而精确模型两小时内无法可靠求解。
AI.research_question: 如何在大规模固定停机坪卡车-无人机配送系统中，在订单释放时间与软交付期限约束下，最小化总订单延迟时间？
AI.motivation: 集成模型在现实需求规模下计算困难，精确求解无法在合理时间内获得可行解，需要可扩展的启发式方法来满足大规模配送系统的服务水平要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 截止日期约束旅行商问题（deadline-constrained TSP）、混合整数规划、负载均衡分配、变邻域下降（VND）启发式
AI.method: 提出LBIP-VND两阶段迭代启发式算法，结合负载均衡分配、基于延迟的最优插入、变邻域下降，以及由停机坪级延迟惩罚引导的卡车路径规划。
AI.findings: 在所有测试规模和出发设置下，LBIP-VND在几秒内生成可行调度；全规模实例平均运行时间2.88秒，平均总延迟9.53小时（约1500个订单）；在宽松的午夜出发基准下所有实例实现零延迟；精确公式运行时间快速增长，两小时内无法可靠产生竞争性的全规模解。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明基于调度的分解方法可为大型固定停机坪卡车-无人机配送系统提供可扩展且面向服务水平（service-level）的解决方案，填补了该领域大规模实例求解的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际城市配送运营提供了能够在数秒内生成可行调度方案的算法工具，支持大规模订单交付目标（如60分钟交付）下的服务水平保障，具有直接的应用价值。

title: Multifield Forecasting Model

detail.title: Multifield Forecasting Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Professor DoHwan Park of Stony Brook University suggested the paper to be written in a way that general public can understand. She isn't listed as author because Prof. Park did not write any of the parts in this MFM paper, nor had direct influence.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No one apart from the author was involved in the research process.
declarations.funderStatement: There was no funding for this research.

detail.abstract: This paper on Multifield Forecasting Model is the result of more than 660 statistical election projections for 73 nations all around the world reflecting 24,854,939 samples of 7,823 polling data, with the development in progress more than 5 years till early last year. Originally known as Universal Election Projection Model, it was completed to not include any other factor apart from scientific opinion polls directly asking the voters’ intention. Therefore, even though at first built to accurately predict election outcomes only, the model was generalized in a way that can be utilized for infinitely many fields by simply inputting the base data significant to the specific topic.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个多领域预测模型，基于全球73个国家、7,823项民调数据、近2,485万个样本和660多次统计选举预测开发而成，历时5年多。该模型最初名为"通用选举预测模型"，仅依赖科学舆论调查数据预测选举结果，但已被泛化为可应用于无限领域的通用预测工具。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个仅基于科学民意调查数据、不依赖其他因素，且可泛化应用于多领域的预测模型？
AI.motivation: 传统的选举预测模型通常依赖多种复杂因素，而本文希望构建一个纯粹基于科学民意调查数据、简洁而准确的预测模型，并将其泛化到选举以外的更多领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该模型基于民意调查数据的统计预测理论，认为直接询问选民意图的科学民调能够反映真实趋势，从而可以作为预测的基础。
AI.method: 基于全球73个国家、7,823项民调数据、24,854,939个样本进行660多次统计选举预测，模型经过5年多的迭代开发，通过输入与特定主题相关的基础数据进行泛化应用。
AI.findings: 模型能够准确预测选举结果，并通过泛化设计可应用于无限多个领域，只需输入与该领域相关的基础数据即可。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个仅基于民意调查数据、不依赖其他外部因素的通用预测模型框架，打破了传统预测模型依赖多因素的理论假设，拓展了统计预测理论的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可广泛应用于选举之外的无限领域的预测工具，具有较强的实用性和可推广性，适用于各种需要基于民意/调查数据进行预测的场景。

title: Data-and-structure-Driven Transshipment Policy in Heterogeneous Multi-Retailer System
affiliations: Shenzhen University - College of Economics, The University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen University, The University of Hong Kong, The University of Hong Kong - Department of Industrial and Manufacturing Systems Engineering, Jiutian Artificial Intelligence Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd., and Department of Data and Systems Engineering, The University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Data-and-structure-Driven Transshipment Policy in Heterogeneous Multi-Retailer System
detail.abstract: Retail networks may incur costly local stockouts even when inventory remains available elsewhere. Addressing this imbalance requires coordinated replenishment and shortage fulfillment across heterogeneous retailers. This study formulates the problem as an event driven Markov decision process under independent non-homogeneous Poisson demands. The analysis establishes a fixed target replenishment structure. It also derives two marginal value bounds and shows that a monotone inventory effect yields a transshipment threshold in single supplier states For larger systems, a structure-parameterized proximal policy optimization method named SP-PPO combines demand-informed action selection with structure-informed value learning. Its actor uses balanced policy scores to compare emergency orders with feasible transfers. Its critic applies soft penalties based on the marginal value bounds and the marginal monotonicity underlying the threshold. Across 90 synthetic observations, PPO-BP has the lowest pooled mean cost among implementable policies. SP-PPO performs best in selected network-size and transshipment-cost regimes. In the real-data-calibrated study SP-PPO reduces mean cost by 3.78% relative to the greedy algorithm and outperforms it in 17 of 20 emergency-cost and capacity settings. These findings provide a practical route from analytical structure to scalable inventory control in heterogeneous retail networks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对异构零售网络中局部库存缺货问题，将其建模为事件驱动的马尔可夫决策过程，建立了固定目标补货结构，推导了边际价值界和转运阈值结构；在此基础上提出结构参数化近端策略优化方法（SP-PPO），将需求信息驱动的动作选择与结构信息驱动的价值学习相结合，在90个合成算例和真实数据校准研究中均表现优异，相比贪心算法平均成本降低3.78%。
AI.research_question: 在异构零售网络中，如何通过协调补货与短缺履行来实现库存平衡，从而降低局部缺货成本？
AI.motivation: 零售网络中即使总体库存充足，局部仍可能发生高成本的缺货；这一库存失衡问题需要跨异构零售商的协调补货与短缺履行，但目前缺乏从解析结构到可扩展库存控制的有效方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件驱动马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）、独立非齐次泊松需求假设、固定目标补货结构、边际价值界、单调库存效应与转运阈值理论。
AI.method: 将问题建模为事件驱动的马尔可夫决策过程；分析推导固定目标补货结构和边际价值界；提出结构参数化近端策略优化方法（SP-PPO），其actor采用平衡策略评分比较紧急订单与可行转运，critic基于边际价值界和阈值背后的边际单调性施加软惩罚。
AI.findings: 在单供应商状态下可建立转运阈值；90个合成算例中PPO-BP在可实施策略中具有最低的汇总平均成本，SP-PPO在特定网络规模和转运成本区间表现最佳；真实数据校准研究中SP-PPO相比贪心算法平均成本降低3.78%，并在20个紧急成本与容量设置中的17个优于贪心算法。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了异构零售网络的解析库存控制结构（固定目标补货结构、边际价值界、转运阈值），为结构信息与强化学习结合的库存管理理论提供了新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了从解析结构到可扩展库存控制的实用路径；SP-PPO方法在真实数据下显著优于贪心基准，可直接应用于异构零售网络的库存调配决策。

title: Verification by Design: The PROVEN Model for Strengthening Research Integrity in AI-Assisted Scholarship
affiliations: Coastline Community College

detail.title: Verification by Design: The PROVEN Model for Strengthening Research Integrity in AI-Assisted Scholarship

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There was no financial or personal relationships.
declarations.ethicsApproval: There were no participants involved
declarations.funderStatement: The research was not funded

detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence now assists nearly every stage of the research lifecycle, yet integrity enforcement remains anchored in after-the-fact detection of AI involvement, an approach that is empirically unreliable, biased against nonnative English writers, adversarially evadable, and already outpaced by industrialized fraud. This article argues that the failure is structural rather than technical and advances an alternative paradigm: verification by design, in which integrity is engineered into research workflows as a property of process rather than adjudicated forensically from finished text. The article introduces the PROVEN model, which organizes six pillars (Provenance, Responsibility, Oversight, Verification, Education, and Norms) across five actor levels spanning the individual researcher, the team or laboratory, the institution, the publication venue, and the wider scholarly ecosystem. Three named constructs give the model operational force: integrity gates, human-accountable checkpoints where AI-influenced content is validated before propagating downstream; verification debt, the compounding risk of unverified hand-offs across artifact boundaries; and structural impossibility, the design goal of making entire classes of fabrication impossible rather than merely detectable. Applications include a stage-bystage lifecycle map of safeguards, an institutional adoption maturity rubric, and a reference implementation demonstrating that structural impossibility is achievable in working research tooling. Twelve testable propositions convert the framework into a research agenda. The model addresses researchers, institutions, publication venues, and policy bodies seeking to sustain trustworthy scholarship in higher education and scholarly publishing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"通过设计验证"（verification by design）的新范式，以取代当前事后检测AI参与研究的不稳定做法。作者引入PROVEN模型，涵盖六大支柱（Provenance, Responsibility, Oversight, Verification, Education, Norms），跨越五个行为者层面（个人研究者、团队/实验室、机构、出版场所、更广泛的学术生态系统），并提出了三个操作性构念：诚信门（integrity gates）、验证债务（verification debt）和结构性不可能（structural impossibility），旨在从流程设计上杜绝学术造假而非事后取证。
AI.research_question: 如何将研究诚信从"事后检测AI参与"的取证式方法，转变为"通过设计验证"的流程内嵌范式，以系统性地应对生成式AI对学术诚信的挑战？
AI.motivation: 现有的事后AI检测方法在实证上不可靠、对非英语母语作者存在偏见、可被对抗性规避，且已被工业化造假超越。作者认为这种失败是结构性的而非技术性的，需要从根本上改变诚信保障的范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: PROVEN模型：六大支柱（Provenance来源追溯、Responsibility责任、Oversight监督、Verification验证、Education教育、Norms规范）× 五个行为者层面（个人研究者、团队/实验室、机构、出版场所、学术生态系统）。三个核心构念：诚信门（human-accountable checkpoints）、验证债务（compounding risk of unverified hand-offs）、结构性不可能（design goal of making fabrication impossible）。
AI.method: 概念性/框架构建方法：提出理论模型（PROVEN），定义三个操作性构念，提供应用示例（分阶段生命周期保障图、机构采纳成熟度评估表、参考实现），并提炼出12个可检验的研究命题。
AI.findings: 论证了事后检测范式在结构性上的缺陷；提出PROVEN模型作为替代框架；展示了通过诚信门、验证债务管理和结构性不可能设计，可以在研究工作流中实现诚信的流程内嵌；并通过参考实现证明结构性不可能在实际研究工具中是可达成的。
AI.theory_contributions: 将学术诚信保障从取证式检测范式转向"通过设计验证"的流程范式；提出PROVEN多层级模型和三个操作性构念（诚信门、验证债务、结构性不可能）；将诚信问题框定为结构性而非技术性失败，为研究诚信领域提供了新的理论视角；形成12个可检验命题以推动后续研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者、机构、出版场所和政策机构提供可操作的诚信保障框架；提供分阶段生命周期保障图、机构采纳成熟度评估表；提供参考实现证明方案的可行性；指导AI时代学术诚信政策的制定与基础设施建设。

title: Single-Network Finite-sample Inference in Strategic Network Formation Models
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Single-Network Finite-sample Inference in Strategic Network Formation Models
detail.abstract: We develop a finite-sample valid inference procedure for strategic network formation models in which linking decisions depend on endogenous network statistics (say, the number of common friends). Only a single network is required to be observed, and we restrict neither its density, nor the dependence structure induced by strategic interaction, nor the equilibrium selection mechanism. We exploit a bounding-by-c technique to construct a set of sandwich inequalities that are valid realization by realization, with the middle term involving only the i.i.d. pairwise error. We then average the sandwich inequalities over cells of exogenous covariates, and obtain identifying restrictions under a nonstandard pathwise limit formulation. For inference, we construct test statistics whose finite-sample uncertainty can be controlled by statistics of the exogenous covariates and errors alone, whose conditional distributions are exactly simulable in both semiparametric and parametric settings. Our proposed inference procedure is also computationally tractable, with no need to solve, simulate, or enumerate equilibrium network structures. In simulations, our procedure easily scales to networks of size 10, 000, and yields confidence sets that certifies the sign of the strategic coefficient. In two empirical applications (with network size about 300∼9500), we find statistical evidence for positive link interdependence at 95% confidence level.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种对战略性网络形成模型进行有限样本有效推断的方法。该方法只需观测单个网络，不限网络密度、依赖结构或均衡选择机制，通过bounding-by-c技术构建三明治不等式，并借助路径极限公式获得识别约束。推断过程计算高效，无需求解或模拟均衡网络结构，可扩展至规模为10,000的网络，并在实证中发现了95%置信水平下的正向链接互依证据。
AI.research_question: 如何在不限制网络密度、依赖结构或均衡选择机制的条件下，基于单个观测网络对战略性网络形成模型进行有限样本有效的统计推断？
AI.motivation: 战略性网络形成模型中，链接决策依赖于内生网络统计量（如共同朋友数量），导致复杂的依赖结构和均衡多重性问题。现有方法通常需要限制网络密度、依赖结构或均衡选择机制，且计算上需要求解或模拟均衡网络结构，难以在大型网络中应用。因此需要一种无需这些限制且计算可行的推断方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于战略性网络形成模型（strategic network formation models），利用bounding-by-c技术构建三明治不等式（sandwich inequalities），结合非标准路径极限（pathwise limit）公式和有限样本推断理论。
AI.method: 首先利用bounding-by-c技术构建逐实现有效的三明治不等式，其中间项仅涉及i.i.d.两两误差；然后将这些不等式在外生协变量单元上取平均，在非标准路径极限公式下获得识别约束；最后构建检验统计量，其有限样本不确定性可由外生协变量和误差的统计量控制，其条件分布在半参数和参数设定下均可精确模拟。
AI.findings: 该方法计算高效，模拟实验中可轻松扩展到规模为10,000的网络，并能产生验证战略系数符号的置信集。在两个实证应用中（网络规模约300~9500），在95%置信水平下发现了正向链接互依的统计证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在战略性网络形成模型中实现有限样本有效的推断，无需限制网络密度、依赖结构或均衡选择机制。2. 提出了bounding-by-c技术构建三明治不等式，结合非标准路径极限公式获得识别约束，为处理复杂内生依赖结构的网络推断提供了新的理论框架。3. 开发了条件分布可精确模拟的检验统计量，避免了求解或模拟均衡网络结构的计算负担。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了计算可行的推断程序，可处理规模高达10,000的网络，具有良好可扩展性。2. 在两个实证应用（网络规模约300~9500）中验证了方法有效性，并发现了95%置信水平下正向链接互依的统计证据，为实证网络研究提供了实用工具。

title: Governing the Computed Boundary: A Dynamic Transaction-Cost Theory of the Multi-Agent Firm

detail.title: Governing the Computed Boundary: A Dynamic Transaction-Cost Theory of the Multi-Agent Firm

declarations.declarationOfInterest: in full disclosure: author has a commercial interest in multiagent architecture and development
declarations.funderStatement: personal

detail.abstract: Transaction-cost economics explains the firm as a discriminating-alignment response to exchange hazards, assigning each transaction to a discrete governance mode so as to economize on the costs of exchange. This logic is comparative-static: it predicts where a boundary should sit, not how it moves. Multi-agent artificial-intelligence systems alter the object the theory must explain. When transactions are mediated by agents that adapt, learn, and are co-produced with foundationmodel vendors, the first-order economizing Williamson assigned to internal governance-effective adaptation and the elimination of waste-migrates to the agent and market layer and is performed continuously and at machine speed. The firm's constitutive act is correspondingly displaced from choosing a governance mode per transaction to governing the conditions under which agent-mediated transactions economize on its behalf. This paper develops that argument in three movements. First, it retrieves and formalizes the virtual-institution model of Olsen (1997)-a transaction-statedependent portfolio of governance structures, classified by a transfer/complementary/supplementary typology and assigned by an expected-net-present-value heuristic indexed to a transaction's proximity to the firm's nexus of intellectual assets-and shows that its governance constructs translate to agentic systems with a fidelity that exceeds analogy, because computational transactions instantiate by construction the discreteness the framework assumed. Second, it specifies the dynamic theory the 1997 program called for: the firm is a governance policy, a Markov-perfect equilibrium over a transaction state-space with an endogenously learning core, in which the boundary of the firm is computed each period as a Pareto-efficient frontier of permissible capability drift against appropriation risk. Third, it develops three extensions that exploit the higher fidelity of the computational domain-a five-dimensional typology of computational asset specificity that refines the typology into vector-valued proximity, a reframing of governance drift as continuous alignment governance, and an account of session-bounded protocols as the engineering instantiation of cyclebased governance. Appendix A states the model formally; a companion computational paper specifies estimation and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文基于交易成本经济学，论证多智能体人工智能系统改变了企业理论必须解释的对象。当交易由自适应、学习型智能体调解，并与基础模型供应商共同生产时，威廉姆森赋予内部治理的一阶节约功能（有效适应与消除浪费）迁移至智能体层和市场层，并以机器速度持续执行。本文通过重拾并形式化Olsen（1997）的虚拟制度模型，提出企业是一种治理政策——在交易状态空间上的马尔可夫完美均衡，企业边界每期被计算为帕累托有效前沿，并发展了三项利用计算域更高保真度的扩展。
AI.research_question: 多智能体人工智能系统如何改变交易成本经济学对企业边界解释的逻辑？当交易由可适应、学习且与基础模型供应商共同生产的智能体调解时，企业的构成性行为应从"每次交易选择治理模式"转变为"治理何种条件下智能体调解的交易能代表企业进行节约"——这一转变的理论基础与动态形式化是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统交易成本经济学的逻辑是比较静态的：它预测边界应当在哪里，而非边界如何移动。多智能体AI系统使交易中介者变为可适应、可学习且与供应商共同生产的智能体，这改变了理论必须解释的对象。威廉姆森分配给内部治理的一阶节约功能（有效适应和消除浪费）已经迁移到智能体和市场层面，并且以机器速度持续运行，因此企业理论需要从比较静态转向动态理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合交易成本经济学（TCE）与Olsen（1997）的虚拟制度模型。核心工具箱包括：虚拟制度模型（交易状态依赖的治理结构组合，基于转移/互补/补充三类型分类，以预期净现值启发式分配）、马尔可夫完美均衡（作为动态博弈论框架）、帕累托有效前沿（企业边界计算）、以及资产专用性扩展框架。
AI.method: 本文是理论构建与形式化论文，采用三部分论证结构：（1）重拾并形式化Olsen（1997）的虚拟制度模型，论证其治理构念能够以超越类比的保真度转化为智能体系统；（2）提出动态理论——企业作为治理政策，即交易状态空间上的马尔可夫完美均衡，企业边界每期被计算为帕累托有效前沿；（3）发展三项扩展：五维计算资产专用性类型学、治理漂移重构为连续对齐治理、以会话有界协议作为周期治理的工程实例化。附录A提供模型的形式化表述。
AI.findings: （1）Olsen（1997）的虚拟制度模型构念可转化为智能体系统，且保真度超过类比，因为计算交易通过构造实例化了该框架假设的离散性；（2）企业应被理解为一种治理政策，即交易状态空间上的马尔可夫完美均衡，具有内生学习核心，企业边界每期被计算为帕累托有效前沿，在允许能力漂移与防止占有风险之间权衡；（3）三项扩展将计算域的高保真度转化为更精细的理论工具：五维资产专用性类型学、连续性对齐治理、以及会话有界协议作为周期治理的工程实现。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将交易成本经济学从比较静态推向动态理论，回应了Olsen（1997）项目所呼吁的动态理论需求；（2）将企业边界理论重新概念化为每期计算的帕累托有效前沿而非一次性治理模式选择；（3）将虚拟制度模型的治理构念从隐喻层面提升到计算域的实际实例化层面；（4）提出五维计算资产专用性类型学，丰富了传统的资产专用性理论；（5）引入马尔可夫完美均衡框架，为组织经济学提供新的博弈论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为企业在多智能体AI环境下的治理决策提供理论指导，帮助企业理解治理重心应从交易模式选择转向治理治理条件；（2）为智能体层面的适应、学习与共同生产提供治理框架；（3）会话有界协议作为周期治理的工程实例化，为AI系统设计提供可直接应用的治理协议思路；（4）五维资产专用性类型学为企业评估计算资产专用性风险提供分析工具。

title: How To Cite the Alien Terrorist Removal Court: A Citation Note On The ATRC's First Case
affiliations: Mitchell Hamline School of Law

detail.title: How To Cite the Alien Terrorist Removal Court: A Citation Note On The ATRC's First Case
detail.abstract:
The Alien Terrorist Removal Court, created in 1996 and modeled on the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court, sat dormant for thirty years. On July 15, 2026, the Government filed the Court's first-ever application, prompting an order from Chief Judge Joan N. Ericksen and raising a question the Bluebook has never had to answer: how does one cite this court?

This essay briefly surveys the sparse existing scholarship mentioning the Court, which had settled on "ATRC" as its working abbreviation. Drawing on the Court's own docket practice and on parallel approaches in related courts (FISA Courts), the essay proposes a citation form and notes some practical points, pending further guidance from the Court.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了1996年设立但沉寂三十年后首次启用（2026年7月15日）的"外星恐怖分子遣返法院"（Alien Terrorist Removal Court, ATRC）的引用规范问题。论文梳理了现有学术文献中对该法院的简称使用情况，参考法院自身的案卷实践及外国情报监控法院（FISA Courts）的平行做法，提出了该法院的引注格式建议，并指出了若干实务操作要点。
AI.research_question: 如何规范引用美国"外星恐怖分子遣返法院"（ATRC）的裁判文书？
AI.motivation: 该法院设立于1996年但沉寂三十年后才首次受理案件（2026年7月15日），此前没有任何引注先例，《蓝皮书》（Bluebook）引注指南也从未涉及此法院的引用格式问题。随着法院首次启用，亟需建立一套规范的引注体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 引注规范理论（Bluebook引注体系）、法院援引惯例比较分析
AI.method: 文献综述法（梳理现有提及该法院的文献）、比较分析法（参照FISA法院的引注实践）及案卷实践考察法（依据法院自身的案卷记录惯例）
AI.findings: 现有文献已倾向于使用"ATRC"作为该法院的工作缩写；结合法院案卷实践和FISA法院的平行做法，可以提出一套合理的引注格式建议；但仍需等待法院自身发布进一步的正式指引。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了美国联邦法院引注体系中对"外星恐怖分子遣返法院"（ATRC）引注规范的学术空白，为《蓝皮书》引注体系下的新设法院引注问题提供了分析框架和解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律实务工作者（律师、法官助理、学者等）提供了ATRC法院裁判文书的引注格式操作指引，有助于统一引注实践，避免因缺乏规范而产生的引用混乱。

title: Strategic Communication and Organisational Well-Being in Startups with Female Leadership
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Strategic Communication and Organisational Well-Being in Startups with Female Leadership

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There are no conflicts of interest. All authors have made substantial contributions to all of the following: the conception and design of the study, acquisition of data and analysis and interpretation of data, revising it critically for important intellectual content and final approval of the version to be submitted.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was conducted in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki, and approved by Ethical Committee for Experimentation of the University of Malaga (CEUMA); approval code: 41-2025-H, date of approval: 6 May 2025
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by Ministry of Science and Innovation of Spain, State Research Agency (MCIU/AEI/10.13039/501100011033/FEDER,UE); grant number PID2022-139037OB-I00 and Junta Andalucia, grant number SEJ-628-FEDER

detail.abstract: Startups led by women often build their public identity through narratives centered on purpose, social impact and commitment to the local community, creating communication that is emotionally meaningful and focused on collective well-being. This paper presents an exploratory study on the communication styles and patterns of Andalusian women-led startups, to identify how well-being is reflected in their digital communication. Through a quantitative and qualitative analysis of their websites and social media, the results suggest women-led startups tend to integrate well-being into their digital communication. The findings suggest that communication can reinforce well-beingoriented entrepreneurial narratives.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨安达卢西亚女性创办的初创企业如何在其数字传播中融入"福祉"（well-being）主题。通过对网站和社交媒体的定性与定量分析，研究发现女性领导的初创企业倾向于将福祉融入其数字传播中，这种传播风格能够强化以福祉为导向的创业叙事。
AI.research_question: 女性领导的初创企业如何在其数字传播中体现福祉？安达卢西亚女性初创企业的传播风格和模式是什么？
AI.motivation: 女性创办的初创企业通常以目标、社会影响和本地社区承诺为中心构建公共身份，但其数字传播中福祉的体现方式尚缺乏系统性研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业叙事理论、福祉导向传播理论、性别与创业身份构建理论
AI.method: 探索性研究，采用定量与定性相结合的混合方法，对安达卢西亚女性领导的初创企业网站和社交媒体进行内容分析。
AI.findings: 女性领导的初创企业倾向于将福祉融入其数字传播中；传播可以强化以福祉为导向的创业叙事。
AI.theory_contributions: 为女性创业传播与福祉研究提供了实证证据，扩展了创业叙事理论在性别与福祉交叉领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为女性创业者如何通过数字传播构建以福祉为核心的品牌形象提供实践指导，也为创业者和政策制定者理解数字传播中的性别差异提供参考。

title: Financially Constrained Procurement
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST), National University of Singapore (NUS), National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Finance and National University of Singapore

detail.title: Financially Constrained Procurement
detail.abstract: We investigate how the financial constraints of local governments interact with those of their corporate suppliers to affect outcomes in public procurement. Using auction-level data on Brazilian municipal procurement and population-based discontinuities in federal transfers, we show that higher transfers relieve local municipalities' constraints, allowing larger tenders and faster payments to suppliers. This draws new suppliers into competition, especially small, young, and distant firms that face participation and delivery costs and are themselves constrained. Higher supplier competition is associated with lower procurement prices especially for essential public goods and services, suggesting pass-through effects to local populations.

AI.tldr: 本文利用巴西市级政府采购的拍卖级别数据和联邦转移支付的人口断点回归设计，研究了地方政府财政约束与其企业供应商财政约束之间的相互作用如何影响公共采购结果。研究发现更高的转移支付缓解了地方政府财政约束，使其能够扩大招标规模并加快对供应商的付款，从而吸引更多新供应商（尤其是小型、年轻和远距离企业）参与竞争，最终降低采购价格，尤其是对于基本公共服务，体现出向当地居民的传导效应。
AI.research_question: 地方政府的财政约束与其企业供应商的财政约束如何相互作用，并影响公共采购的结果？
AI.motivation: 公共采购是政府支出的重要组成部分，但关于买方（地方政府）财务约束与卖方（供应商）财务约束之间如何相互影响的研究相对缺乏。理解财政转移支付如何通过缓解政府约束进而影响供应商进入竞争和采购价格，对评估财政政策效果和公共采购效率具有重要政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政联邦主义、政府财政约束理论、供应商竞争与市场进入理论
AI.method: 利用巴西市级政府采购的拍卖级别数据，采用基于人口断点的回归不连续设计（RDD），利用联邦转移支付中人口门槛产生的断点进行因果识别。
AI.findings: （1）更高的联邦转移支付缓解了地方政府的财政约束，使其能够扩大招标规模并加快供应商付款；（2）这吸引了更多新供应商参与竞争，尤其是小型、年轻和远距离的企业；（3）更高的供应商竞争与更低的采购价格相关，尤其是对于基本公共物品和服务，体现出对当地居民的传导效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次系统地研究了政府采购中买方财政约束与卖方财政约束之间的相互作用机制，将政府财政约束、供应商融资约束和市场竞争纳入统一分析框架，丰富了财政联邦主义和公共采购理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果表明，向地方政府提供财政转移支付不仅能直接缓解政府支出压力，还能通过吸引更多供应商参与竞争来降低采购成本，提高公共资金使用效率，从而造福当地居民。这为财政转移支付政策的优化设计提供了实证依据。

title: Lighting The Fire: A Pentagonal Pedagogy for Skill Consolidation in High-Ace Contexts: Facilitator Training, Individual Education, And the Path from Working Memory to Durable Practice

detail.title: Lighting The Fire: A Pentagonal Pedagogy for Skill Consolidation in High-Ace Contexts: Facilitator Training, Individual Education, And the Path from Working Memory to Durable Practice

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The Pentagonal Walker Pedagogy is a framework developed by the author through Future State, LLC, of which the author is Principal; the author and Future State, LLC may derive commercial benefit from its adoption, and planned implementations at partner sites are referenced in the paper. The author was trained in the Lean tradition described herein and the work draws on the author's prior published corpus. The author has served in leadership of Alaska Native early-childhood, health, and Head Start organizations relevant to the paper's examples. These interests are disclosed in the interest of full transparency. The author holds no financial interest in the Sealaska Heritage Institute or Baby Raven Reads.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this work. The paper is a theoretical integration drawing on previously published research and publicly available program information; it reports no primary data collection and involved no human participants. The empirical test sites and studies described are proposed future work and are not reported here.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors and was conducted by the author through Future State, LLC.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Ethics approval was not required for this work. The paper is a conceptual and secondary analysis drawing exclusively on previously published program evaluations and publicly available aggregate data; it involved no primary data collection, no human participants, and no personally identifiable information.

detail.abstract: Conventional practitioner training programs in behavioral health, Indigenous community restoration, organizational wellness, and individual education face a persistent failure mode: skills taught in training do not consolidate into durable, automatized practice. This paper identifies the neurobiological substrate of that failure-body budget depletion, working memory suppression, and the absence of relational safety conditions that consolidation requires-and proposes a fivecomponent integrated pedagogical architecture that addresses it. The Pentagonal Walker Pedagogy integrates: (1) the Chugach School District's competency-based circular time pacing principle; (2) Training Within Industry's Learning Breakdown and four-step instruction sequence with the naming step explicit; (3) Oakley's chunking and spaced retrieval architecture; (4) the Disney sensory environment protocol as a body budget preparation sequence; and (5) the I.C.A.R.E. facilitation framework as the relational substrate maintenance protocol. The paper advances three arguments beyond its initial framing. First, the Pentagonal Pedagogy is a general theory of consolidation applicable across facilitator training, individual education, and self-directed learning-not only Walker curriculum delivery. Second, Sealaska Heritage Institute's Baby Raven Reads program is identified as the zero-to-five proof of concept for all five components operating simultaneously in an Indigenous early literacy context, providing the empirical anchor the theory requires. Third, the working memory to durable memory pathway is specified as a three-stage neurobiological sequence-encoding, hippocampal consolidation, and neocortical integrationwith each of the five pedagogical components mapped to its precise intervention point in that sequence. A three-phase metacognitive development model describes how individual learners progress from receiving the architecture passively to constructing and applying it independently. Fourteen falsifiable propositions are generated. The Pentagonal Walker Pedagogy is an Andersonoriginated construct; a search of the literature confirms that no prior use of this specific integrated five-component framework has been reported under this name.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了传统培训项目中技能无法固化为自动化实践的神经生物学根源（身体预算耗竭、工作记忆抑制、缺乏关系安全条件），并提出一个五组件整合教学架构——五边形Walker教学法，涵盖能力本位循环时间、TWI四步教学、组块与间隔提取、感官环境准备及I.C.A.R.E.关系维护，并提出了十四个可证伪命题。
AI.research_question: 培训中获得的技能为何无法固化为持久的自动化实践？如何构建能够解决这一失败模式的教学架构？
AI.motivation: 行为健康、原住民社区恢复、组织健康和个人教育等领域的传统培训项目普遍存在一个持久失败模式：培训中学到的技能无法固化为持久、自动化的实践。本文旨在识别这一失败的神经生物学根源并提出系统性解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于神经生物学理论（身体预算耗竭、工作记忆抑制、关系安全条件）、认知心理学中的组块化与间隔提取理论、能力本位教育理论、以及多阶段元认知发展模型。
AI.method: 本文采用理论建构与综合分析方法：将五个已有的教学组件（Chugach学区循环时间原则、TWI四步教学法、Oakley组块与间隔提取、迪士尼感官环境协议、I.C.A.R.E.促进框架）整合为新的教学架构；以Sealaska Heritage Institute的Baby Raven Reads项目作为零至五岁阶段的实证验证概念证据；提出三阶段神经生物学序列模型及十四个可证伪命题。
AI.findings: 提出五边形Walker教学法，包含五个组件；将其定位为适用于促进者培训、个人教育和自我导向学习的通用巩固理论；确定Baby Raven Reads为五组件同时运作的实证锚点；将工作记忆到持久记忆路径细化为编码、海马巩固、新皮层整合三阶段，并将每个教学组件映射到精确干预点；建立三阶段元认知发展模型；生成十四个可证伪命题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个全新的整合性教学理论——五边形Walker教学法（文献检索确认此前无此名称的框架）；将神经生物学序列（编码-海马巩固-新皮层整合）与具体教学组件建立精确映射关系；将教学巩固理论从狭隘的课程交付扩展到通用领域；建立零至五岁阶段的实证概念验证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为培训设计者和教育者提供了一个可操作的五组件整合架构；为不同领域的培训项目（行为健康、原住民社区、组织健康、个人教育）提供了解决技能巩固失败的具体方案；Baby Raven Reads作为Indigenous早期识字项目提供了可参考的实践范例。

title: Business Diversification and Informational Efficiency -causal Evidence from a Mandatory Non-diversification Reform
affiliations: Renmin University of China - School of Business, Department of Accounting, School of Management, Fudan University and Renmin University of China, School of Business

detail.title: Business Diversification and Informational Efficiency -causal Evidence from a Mandatory Non-diversification Reform

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing financial or other interests.

detail.abstract: By exploiting a mandatory non-diversification reform, we examine the causal effect of business diversification on informational efficiency. In an effort to urge state-owned enterprises to refocus, the Chinese government rolled out a staggering mandate which requires local SOEs to reduce the scope and heterogeneity of their business segments. We construct a pseudo conglomerate which consists of a portfolio of stand-alone firms mimicking each real conglomerate. Consistent with Cohen and Lou (2012), we find that pseudo conglomerates' stock returns positively predict real conglomerates' one-month-ahead stock returns, i.e., informational inefficiency associated with business diversification. Importantly, this return predictability significantly weakens for SOEs relative to non-SOEs after the nondiversification reform. The reform's effect on informational efficiency becomes more pronounced for firms with lower investor sophistication or poorer information environment before the reform, i.e., sources of return predictability. Mechanism analyses suggest that, through non-diversifications, SOEs experience improvements in the quality of both internal control and financial reporting. Collectively, empirical findings provide causal evidence regarding whether and how business diversification shapes informational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 利用中国强制性的非多元化改革，本文检验了业务多元化对信息效率的因果效应。通过构造由独立公司组合构成的伪企业集团，发现伪企业集团的股票收益能正向预测真实企业集团未来一个月的股票收益（即多元化导致的信息无效率）。改革后，国有企业相对非国有企业的这种收益可预测性显著减弱，且对于投资者成熟度较低或信息环境较差的企业效果更明显。
AI.research_question: 业务多元化如何因果性地影响资本市场的信息效率？
AI.motivation: 以往关于多元化与信息效率的研究多为相关性证据，缺乏因果识别。中国政府对地方国有企业实施的强制性非多元化改革提供了天然的准自然实验，使得研究者能够利用外生政策冲击来识别多元化对信息效率的因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Cohen和Lou (2012)的"伪企业集团"框架，即真实多元化企业的股票价格无法充分反映其各分部信息组合的价格信息，导致信息无效率。
AI.method: 以中国地方国企非多元化强制改革为准自然实验，采用双重差分（DID）思路；构造伪企业集团（由模仿真实企业集团各分部的独立公司组合而成），检验伪集团收益对真实集团收益的可预测性及其在改革前后的变化。
AI.findings: （1）伪企业集团股票收益显著正向预测真实企业集团未来一个月收益，证实多元化导致信息无效率；（2）改革后，国企相对非国企的收益可预测性显著减弱；（3）改革效应在投资者成熟度低或信息环境差的企业中更显著；（4）机制在于非多元化提升了国企的内部控制质量和财务报告质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为业务多元化对信息效率的影响提供了因果证据，超越了以往的相关性研究；识别了收益可预测性的来源（投资者成熟度和信息环境），深化了对信息无效率机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于业务聚焦改革（如国企非多元化）能否改善资本市场信息效率的实证依据；对投资者而言，揭示了多元化企业股票的定价偏差及可套利空间。

title: Identification in Many-to-Many Matching Games
affiliations: The University of Sydney

detail.title: Identification in Many-to-Many Matching Games
detail.abstract: This paper develops a structural model of many-to-many matching with endogenous link formation under max-min preferences. Agents on both sides of the market form subsets of partners subject to capacity constraints, choosing links to maximize the minimum utility received across all connections. We characterize the limiting behavior of stable matchings as market size grows and establish convergence of conditional choice probabilities to closed-form expressions governed by inclusive value functions. We use degree distributions as a novel source of identification, and show that the degree of each agent follows a binomial distribution with parameters determined by inclusive values, which are in turn pinned down by equilibrium behavior. Our results extend existing one-to-one matching frameworks to more complex many-to-many environments.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个在最大最小偏好下具有内生链接形成的多对多匹配结构模型，刻画了市场规模增大时稳定匹配的极限行为，并建立了条件选择概率向闭式表达式的收敛性，利用度分布作为新的识别来源。
AI.research_question: 如何在最大最小偏好下构建多对多匹配的结构模型，并利用度分布实现结构参数的识别？
AI.motivation: 现有匹配模型多聚焦于一配一（one-to-one）环境，对于多对多（many-to-many）匹配场景缺乏结构性的建模与识别方法。本文旨在填补这一空白，将一配一框架扩展到更复杂的多对多环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多对多匹配理论、最大最小（max-min）偏好、稳定匹配、包容值函数（inclusive value functions）
AI.method: 结构模型构建与理论分析：构建多对多匹配的结构模型，刻画内生链接形成；通过大市场极限分析（limiting behavior）推导稳定匹配的渐近性质；推导条件选择概率的闭式表达式；利用度分布的二项分布性质进行参数识别。
AI.findings: （1）刻画了市场规模增大时稳定匹配的极限行为；（2）建立了条件选择概率向由包容值函数决定的闭式表达式的收敛性；（3）证明了每个代理人的度服从由包容值决定的二项分布，而包容值由均衡行为确定；（4）扩展了现有的一配一匹配框架到多对多环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论上，本文将传统的一配一匹配结构模型扩展至多对多匹配环境，引入了最大最小偏好作为链接形成的决策规则，并首次将度分布作为结构参数的识别来源，为多对多匹配的结构估计提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 该模型可为劳动力市场、平台经济、双边网络等具有多对多匹配特征的实际市场提供结构估计方法，帮助研究者利用可观测的度分布数据来推断代理人的偏好参数和均衡行为。

title: Irreversible Investment in Alternative Projects under Regime Switching
affiliations: , The University of Osaka and The University of Osaka

detail.title: Irreversible Investment in Alternative Projects under Regime Switching
detail.abstract: We study how a firm should choose investment timing and project scale when profitability shifts between regimes. The firm can irreversibly undertake either a smaller, lower-cost project or a larger, higher-capacity project with higher sunk cost. Profitability follows a two-state Markov regime-switching process whose growth and volatility vary by regime. Combining regime switching with scale choice means that a regime shift affects both whether the firm invests and which project it selects. An upward transition from the bad to the good regime may trigger either project, depending on the earnings fundamental. A distinctive result is that, when both projects remain relevant, a downward transition from the good to the bad regime can trigger investment in the small project. The deterioration does not raise project profitability; instead, it can reduce the option value of waiting for the large project relative to immediate small-scale investment. Numerical analysis illustrates representative trigger patterns and how they vary with project characteristics and regime dynamics. The results show that regime shifts shape irreversible investment through the interaction of timing flexibility and endogenous scale choice.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了企业在盈利能力在不同体制（regime）之间转换时，如何选择投资时机和项目规模。企业可以不可逆地投资于一个较小、低成本的项目，或一个较大、高产能且沉没成本更高的项目。盈利能力遵循两状态马尔可夫体制转换过程，其增长率和波动率随体制而变化。将体制转换与规模选择相结合，意味着体制转换既影响企业是否投资，也影响企业选择哪个项目。一个显著的结果是，当两个项目都仍然相关时，从好体制向坏体制的向下转换也可能触发小规模项目的投资——恶化并不会提高项目盈利能力，而是降低了等待大型项目的期权价值，相对于立即进行小规模投资而言。数值分析展示了代表性的触发模式及其如何随项目特征和体制动态而变化。
AI.research_question: 当盈利能力在不同体制之间转换时，企业应如何选择投资时机和项目规模？体制转换如何影响不可逆投资决策中的时机灵活性与内生规模选择之间的相互作用？
AI.motivation: 传统实物期权文献通常假设盈利能力的动态过程是稳定的，忽视了宏观经济或行业状态（体制）的转换。同时，多数研究将投资规模视为外生给定，忽略了企业可以内生选择项目规模这一维度。本文旨在填补体制转换与内生规模选择相结合的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实物期权理论；马尔可夫体制转换模型；不可逆投资理论；期权价值理论
AI.method: 本文采用理论建模方法，构建了一个包含两状态马尔可夫体制转换过程的实物期权模型，模型中企业面临两个不可逆投资选择（小项目与大项目），通过动态规划求解最优投资阈值和项目选择策略，并辅以数值分析来展示触发模式。
AI.findings: （1）从坏体制向好体制的向上转换可能触发任一项目的投资，具体取决于盈利基本面；（2）一个独特的结果是，当两个项目都仍然相关时，从好体制向坏体制的向下转换可以触发小规模项目的投资；（3）恶化并不提高项目盈利能力，而是降低了等待大型项目的期权价值，相对于立即进行小规模投资而言；（4）体制转换通过时机灵活性与内生规模选择的相互作用塑造不可逆投资。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次将体制转换与内生规模选择纳入统一的实物期权框架；（2）揭示了向下体制转换可能触发投资的非直观结果，扩展了现有实物期权理论对体制转换影响的理解；（3）阐明了体制转换通过期权价值渠道（而非盈利渠道）影响投资决策的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为企业管理者在宏观经济或行业状态不稳定环境下进行投资时机与规模决策提供理论指导；（2）帮助企业理解经济下行时期投资小型项目可能反而更优的逻辑；（3）为企业在体制转换环境中评估不同规模项目的投资价值提供分析框架。

title: Recursive Copula Aggregation for Market and Credit Portfolios
affiliations: University of Turin - Department of Management, Core Dynamics GmbH and

detail.title: Recursive Copula Aggregation for Market and Credit Portfolios
detail.abstract:
Risk aggregation is a central problem in financial risk management and regulatory capital assessment. While copula-based approaches are widely used due to their tractability and interpretability, standard implementations rely on flat dependence structures that may fail to capture hierarchical interactions across risk components. 

    This paper introduces a hierarchical copula framework for risk aggregation on trees, in which dependence is specified locally at each aggregation node and propagated through recursive rankbased reordering. The approach preserves marginal distributions while enabling flexible and economically interpretable modeling of dependence across multiple aggregation levels. 

     Copula parameters are calibrated from empirical data using Kendalls tau, and the methodology is illustrated using market and credit risk proxies. Robustness is assessed across alternative credit segments, including investment-grade and high-yield indices. Numerical results show that dependence strength increases under stress and varies systematically across credit quality, with important implications for risk measurement. 

     The proposed framework combines the transparency of copula-based aggregation with the structural richness of hierarchical models, providing a practical and scalable tool for enterprise risk management. This contributes to bridging bottom-up and top-down approaches to risk aggregation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于树结构的分层Copula框架用于风险聚合，在各聚合节点局部设定依赖结构，并通过递归秩次重排进行传播，从而在保留边际分布的同时实现多层级、可解释的依赖建模。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种分层Copula框架，以捕捉风险聚合中跨层级、非扁平化的依赖结构，从而改善传统Copula方法在风险聚合中的局限性？
AI.motivation: 传统Copula方法虽然因其可操作性和可解释性而被广泛使用，但标准实现依赖扁平化的依赖结构，无法捕捉风险组件之间的层级交互关系，这限制了其在企业风险管理中的适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层Copula理论、Kendall's tau秩相关理论、树结构依赖建模、递归秩次重排方法
AI.method: 提出了树结构上的分层Copula框架，在每个聚合节点局部设定依赖结构，通过递归秩次重排在层级间传播依赖；使用Kendall's tau从经验数据校准Copula参数，并以市场和信用风险代理变量进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 依赖强度在压力情境下增强，且随信用质量变化呈现系统性差异；该方法在不同信用细分市场（投资级和高收益指数）中表现出稳健性，对风险管理具有重要启示。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Copula聚合的透明性与分层模型的结构丰富性相结合，弥合了自下而上与自上而下风险聚合方法之间的理论鸿沟，为层级化依赖建模提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个实用且可扩展的企业风险管理工具，支持多层级、经济上可解释的依赖建模，有助于更准确地评估监管资本和压力情境下的风险敞口。

title: Change Course, Stay the Course: How People Respond to Persistent and Transitory Shocks
affiliations: and UNSW Australia Business School, School of Banking and Finance

detail.title: Change Course, Stay the Course: How People Respond to Persistent and Transitory Shocks
detail.abstract: Knowing when to change course or stay the course is only half the problem: rewardtriggered persistence and loss-triggered flight may obstruct execution. We test this idea in a high-stakes laboratory experiment with diagnostics separating expected-value misclassification from execution failures. Nearly one-third failed to classify a frequentwinner strategy as unprofitable. Among those with verified understanding, rewards delayed departure from a dying trend, interim losses induced abandonment of an optimal strategy, and temporary shocks triggered exit from positions known to recover. These patterns' timing and direction accord with a preregistered Pavlovian approach-avoidance account and challenge leading alternatives on their strongest margins.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过高风险的实验室实验，区分了期望值错误分类与执行失败，发现即使参与者正确理解了策略，奖励仍会延迟他们离开衰退趋势，损失会导致他们放弃最优策略，暂时冲击也会促使他们退出已知会恢复的头寸。这些行为模式与预先注册的巴甫洛夫趋近-回避理论一致，并挑战了主流替代理论。
AI.research_question: 知道何时改变路线或坚持路线只是问题的一半：奖励触发的坚持和损失触发的逃离是否可能阻碍策略执行？
AI.motivation: 已有研究关注人们是否能正确识别预期价值，但对"即使理解正确，情绪/动机系统仍会干扰执行"这一问题关注不足。本文旨在分离"认知误判"与"执行失败"两类问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 巴甫洛夫趋近-回避理论（Pavlovian approach-avoidance account）：奖励触发趋近/坚持倾向，损失触发回避/逃离倾向，这些自动化的动机反应可能干扰基于理性计算的策略执行。
AI.method: 高风险实验室实验，通过诊断性设计区分期望值误分类与执行失败；采用预先注册（preregistered）的研究设计；纳入对策略理解已得到验证的参与者进行行为分析。
AI.findings: （1）近三分之一参与者未能将频繁获胜的策略分类为不盈利；（2）在理解正确的参与者中，奖励延迟了离开衰退趋势的决策；（3）临时损失导致放弃最优策略；（4）暂时冲击促使退出已知会恢复的头寸。行为模式的时间与方向与巴甫洛夫趋近-回避预测一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在事前验证参与者理解正确的前提下，分离出纯粹的"执行失败"而非"认知误判"，为巴甫洛夫趋近-回避理论提供了因果证据，并在其最强维度上挑战了预期效用最大化等主导替代理论的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资决策、风险管理及策略执行领域提供启示：即使管理者或交易者"知道"最优策略，情绪性动机倾向仍可能导致执行偏差，提示需要设计防偏差机制（如自动化执行、事前承诺等）来克服奖励/损失触发的非理性坚持或逃离。

title: Contagion through Opacity: Design and Survival in the November 2025 Stablecoin Cascade
affiliations: and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST)

detail.title: Contagion through Opacity: Design and Survival in the November 2025 Stablecoin Cascade
detail.abstract: In early November 2025 the yield-bearing stablecoin sector experienced its first systemic run: over roughly seventy-two hours, three synthetic dollar tokens lost between 94 and 99 percent of their value, set off by the disclosure of an external-manager loss at Stream Finance. Using hourly on-chain data we reconstruct the cascade and show that survival was not determined by on-chain exposure or scale-the largest instrument, sUSDe, held its peg while absorbing several hundred million dollars of redemptions-but by the quality of the backing and whether redemptions were honored under stress. We further show that the contagion did not travel through observable decentralized-finance composability: public lending exposure to the failed collateral was negligible. Transmission ran instead through off-chain reserve relationships and, in the single material public exposure, through a price oracle that remained frozen at the pre-crash value, implying a roughly 119-fold overvaluation weeks into the collapse, so that no liquidation fired and approximately $7.5 million of bad debt accrued without a single onchain bad-debt event. We read the episode as evidence that opacity in valuation, rather than composability, was the systemic channel, and draw implications for the disclosure, redemption, and oracle requirements that govern tokenized dollars. The paper is a descriptive and structural anatomy of one systemic episode; we make no causal-identification claim.

AI.tldr: 本文对2025年11月初收益型稳定币行业首次系统性挤兑事件进行了详细的实证解剖。在约72小时内，三个合成美元代币因Stream Finance外部管理方亏损的披露而损失了94%-99%的价值。研究发现生存与否并不取决于链上敞口或规模，而是取决于抵押品质量和赎回压力下的兑付行为。传染并非通过可观察的DeFi可组合性传播（公开借贷敞口可忽略），而是通过链下储备关系和价格预言机失灵传播——一个预言机在崩盘后数周仍冻结在崩盘前价格，造成约119倍高估，导致约750万美元坏账却没有发生任何链上坏账事件。论文认为估值不透明而非可组合性才是系统性渠道。
AI.research_question: 收益型稳定币行业首次系统性挤兑事件中，什么因素决定了代币的生存与失败？传染的具体传播渠道是什么？系统性风险的核心机制是链上可组合性还是链下估值不透明性？
AI.motivation: 收益型稳定币（synthetic dollar tokens）作为新兴的加密金融工具，其系统性风险特征尚未被充分理解。2025年11月的首次系统性挤兑提供了独特的自然实验机会，可以检验关于DeFi传染渠道的理论争论——究竟是链上可组合性导致传染，还是链下估值不透明性才是真正的系统性渠道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于金融传染理论、挤兑理论（Diamond-Dybvig式银行挤兑框架的加密扩展）、DeFi可组合性风险理论，以及估值透明度与系统性风险关系的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用每小时链上数据对该挤兑事件进行描述性和结构性解剖。方法包括：重构传染级联过程、比较存活与失败代币的特征（链上敞口、规模、抵押品质量、赎回兑付行为）、追踪传染传播路径（链上借贷敞口、链下储备关系、价格预言机），并量化预言机冻结导致的高估幅度（约119倍）和坏账累积规模（约750万美元）。
AI.findings: (1) 生存与否不取决于链上敞口或规模——最大工具sUSDe在吸收数亿美元赎回的同时保持了锚定；(2) 决定因素在于抵押品质量和压力下的赎回兑付行为；(3) 传染不通过可观察的DeFi可组合性传播，公开借贷敞口可忽略；(4) 传染通过链下储备关系和价格预言机失灵传播；(5) 单一重大公共敞口中，预言机冻结在崩盘前价格导致约119倍高估，无清算触发，约750万美元坏账无任何链上坏账事件。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文提供了对"DeFi系统性风险主要源于可组合性"这一主流观点的实证反驳，提出并支持了"估值不透明性才是系统性渠道"的新论点。通过区分链上可观察传染与非链上传染，深化了对加密金融传染机制的理论理解，并填补了关于收益型稳定币这一新兴资产类别系统性风险的实证空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 对治理代币化美元（tokenized dollars）的监管设计具有直接政策启示，具体涉及三方面要求：(1) 信息披露要求——需增强抵押品和链下储备的透明度；(2) 赎回要求——需确保压力条件下的赎回兑付机制；(3) 预言机要求——需建立防止预言机冻结所致系统性风险的机制。对稳定币发行方、DeFi协议设计者和监管机构均有实践参考价值。

title: Consumer Value of Privacy: Evidence from an Online Retailer
affiliations: University College London,  and Mitchell E. Daniels, Jr School of Business, Purdue University

detail.title: Consumer Value of Privacy: Evidence from an Online Retailer
detail.abstract: We study how much consumers value personal information using data from an online retailer's tiered loyalty program. Consumers receive points for disclosing personal information. While points awarded are fixed, their effective value varies quasi-experimentally with distance to the tier-upgrade threshold. Exploiting this variation, we estimate how incentives affect disclosure, and recover bounds on the value of personal information. Disclosure increases with incentives, and valuations differ across data types. Consumers value mobile number ($0.99) and payment card details ($1.02) more than date of birth ($0.20). More engaged consumers value their information more, suggesting privacy valuations depend on consumer experience with firms.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用在线零售商分级忠诚度计划的准自然实验数据，估计消费者对个人信息的估值。消费者通过披露个人信息获得积分，而积分的有效价值随与升级门槛的距离变化。研究发现披露随激励增加，且不同数据类型估值不同：手机号码（0.99美元）和支付卡信息（1.02美元）的估值高于出生日期（0.20美元）。更忠诚的消费者对其信息估值更高，表明隐私估值取决于消费者与企业的互动经验。
AI.research_question: 消费者对不同类型的个人信息估值是多少？经济激励如何影响信息披露行为？
AI.motivation: 随着数据驱动型商业模式的发展，个人信息的经济价值成为重要议题，但缺乏对消费者个人信息价值的可靠量化估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 个人信息披露的经济决策理论、隐私估值理论、消费者行为理论
AI.method: 利用在线零售商分级忠诚度计划中的准自然实验变化（积分价值随升级门槛距离变化），估计激励对披露的影响，并恢复个人信息价值的边界估计。
AI.findings: 披露随激励增加而增加；不同数据类型估值存在显著差异：手机号码（$0.99）、支付卡信息（$1.02）显著高于出生日期（$0.20）；更投入的消费者对信息估值更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次通过准自然实验方法量化消费者对个人信息的价值；揭示了隐私估值随消费者与企业互动经验变化的动态特征；区分了不同数据类型的异质性估值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计个性化数据收集激励机制提供定价参考；为监管机构制定数据保护政策提供实证依据；帮助理解消费者对数据隐私的实际经济权衡。

title: The Thinnest Place: A Designation Architecture without an Offense, and the Reasonableness of Fear

detail.title: The Thinnest Place: A Designation Architecture without an Offense, and the Reasonableness of Fear
detail.abstract: Federal law defines domestic terrorism but creates no offense of domestic terrorism. What the definition supports is a sentencing enhancement and a set of investigative authorities, which means the label attaches without ever being submitted to a jury and therefore without ever being subject to acquittal. Federal law likewise provides no mechanism for designating a domestic organization a terrorist organization, though an executive directive has instructed the Attorney General to propose such designations. This article traces where an architecture built on an unchargeable label operates first, and argues that the answer follows from Fourth Amendment geography: it operates at the border, because that is the point at which a citizen's protection against search is thinnest and the Eleventh Circuit requires no suspicion of any kind. A prosecution arising from an Atlanta airport encounter supplies the worked example. The article then identifies a second problem the same architecture creates. Whether a person was seized, whether an encounter was custodial, and whether consent was voluntary are each measured by what a reasonable person would believe, and each test assumes a background in which fear of federal officers is unreasonable absent particularized threat. Where a government has generated a documented record of lethal force against citizens and has publicly characterized political opposition as terrorism, that assumption fails, and a doctrine that continues to apply it transfers the cost of the government's own posture onto the individual who felt its effect.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了联邦法律中"国内恐怖主义"作为一个无法起诉的标签性概念如何在宪法第四修正案的"地理"逻辑下运作——主要发生在边境，因为没有合理怀疑标准即可搜查；同时指出当政府自身行为（致命武力记录与将政治反对派定性为恐怖主义）使"理性人"标准失真时，该架构将成本转嫁给公民个体。
AI.research_question: 基于一个不可起诉的"国内恐怖主义"标签所构建的法律架构，首先在何处运作？当政府自身行为使"理性人"标准的前提假设失效时，该架构如何影响第四修正案下的搜查与扣押法律适用？
AI.motivation: 联邦法律对"国内恐怖主义"仅有定义而无罪名，标签附着过程不经过陪审团，也无可辩驳空间；同时缺乏对国内恐怖组织的认定机制，但行政指令要求司法部长提出此类认定。这一架构的运作场域及其对公民权利的影响未被充分揭示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第四修正案地理学（Fourth Amendment geography）：公民在边境的搜查保护最弱，第十一巡回法院不要求任何程度的怀疑；以及"理性人"标准（reasonable person test），用于判断是否构成扣押、是否具有羁押性、同意是否自愿。
AI.method: 法律分析论文，以亚特兰大机场事件的刑事起诉作为工作示例（worked example），追踪不可起诉标签所构建的架构的实际运作机制，并对"理性人"标准的隐含假设进行批判性分析。
AI.findings: 第一，该架构首先在边境运作，因为第四修正案地理学使边境成为公民搜查保护最薄弱的节点，且第十一巡回法院允许无任何怀疑的搜查。第二，当政府有记录地使用致命武力并将政治反对派公开定性为恐怖主义时，"理性人"标准的前提（即对联邦官员的恐惧在无特定威胁时是不合理的）不再成立，继续适用该标准将政府自身姿态的成本转移给受影响个体。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不可起诉标签架构的运作场域由第四修正案地理学决定；批判性地指出"理性人"标准隐含的背景假设在政府特定行为下失效，提出了该学说在例外情境下的适用困境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为边境搜查、国内恐怖主义标签适用以及政府行为对个人权利影响的法律实践提供分析框架，提示在政府自身行为导致理性人标准失真时，司法审查应重新评估其适用。

title: Long-Run Dynamics of US Profitability: Counteracting Tendencies and the Falling Rate of Profit
affiliations: and Aristotle University of Thessaloniki

detail.title: Long-Run Dynamics of US Profitability: Counteracting Tendencies and the Falling Rate of Profit

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author(s) declared no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval is not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The author(s) received no financial support for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the tendency of the rate of profit to fall in Classical, Marxian, and Keynesian political economy, emphasizing Marx's counteracting tendencies. Using annual US data for 1950-2024, we estimate an autoregressive distributed lag model in which the profit rate depends on the organic composition of capital and various proxies of the principal counteracting tendencies to the aforementioned falling rate of profit. A higher organic composition of capital is associated with a lower profit rate. The cheapening of capital goods is the most robust counteracting factor, while the equity/GDP ratio also has a positive long-run association. These influences moderate but do not offset the long-run decline in US profitability.

AI.tldr: 本文考察古典、马克思和凯恩斯政治经济学中利润率趋于下降的趋势，特别强调马克思的反向趋势。利用1950-2024年美国年度数据，估计了一个自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型，其中利润率取决于资本有机构成和各类反向趋势的代理变量。结果表明：更高的资本有机构成与更低的利润率相关；资本品贬值是最稳健的反向因素，股权/GDP比率也具有正向长期关联；但这些影响只能缓和而无法抵消美国利润率的长期下降。
AI.research_question: 在古典、马克思和凯恩斯政治经济学框架下，美国利润率是否存在趋于下降的趋势？马克思所提出的各种反向趋势在多大程度上能够抵消这一下降趋势？
AI.motivation: 利润率趋于下降的规律是马克思主义政治经济学的核心命题之一，但现有实证研究对反向趋势的作用缺乏系统检验。作者旨在利用长期美国数据，定量评估资本有机构成上升的负面效应与各类反向趋势的正面效应之间的动态平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马克思主义政治经济学中的利润率趋于下降规律（TRPF）理论，涵盖古典政治经济学、马克思政治经济学和凯恩斯政治经济学的比较视角，重点关注马克思提出的五类反向趋势（包括资本品贬值、相对过剩人口、对外贸易、股权稀释等）。
AI.method: 使用1950-2024年美国年度数据，构建自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型。因变量为利润率，自变量包括资本有机构成以及多种反向趋势的代理变量（如资本品价格指数、股权/GDP比率等），估计各因素的短期和长期效应。
AI.findings: （1）资本有机构成提高与利润率下降显著相关；（2）资本品贬值（cheapening of capital goods）是最稳健的反向趋势因素；（3）股权/GDP比率与利润率存在正向长期关联；（4）各类反向趋势能够缓和但无法完全抵消美国利润率的长期下降趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 为马克思利润率趋于下降规律提供了1950-2024年长达75年的美国实证证据；系统区分并量化了马克思所提出的各反向趋势的相对贡献强度，深化了对TRPF理论中"趋势"与"反趋势"辩证关系的理解；整合了古典、马克思与凯恩斯三大政治经济学传统对利润率问题的讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了美国经济长期利润率下降的实证状况，为理解资本主义经济长期动态、资本积累的可持续性以及经济政策制定（如资本品投资、金融化政策等）提供了经验依据。

title: Emergent Strategic Behaviour in a Macroeconomic Agent-Based Model with Reinforcement Learning
affiliations: Catholic University of Milan, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Università di Milano Cattolica and Catholic University of Milan

detail.title: Emergent Strategic Behaviour in a Macroeconomic Agent-Based Model with Reinforcement Learning
detail.abstract: In canonical macroeconomic agent-based model (ABM), firms pursue behavioural (non-optimal) price and quantity strategies, that take the form of heuristics. In this paper we incorporate reinforcement learning (RL) into an otherwise standard ABM by replacing a fraction of heuristic-using firms with RL agents that learn profitmaximizing strategies through repeated interaction with the economic environment. When RL agents adopt a shared Q-function, they endogenously converge to one of three distinct strategic regimes – market power, predatory pricing, or quasi-perfect competition – with the prevailing equilibrium depending on the degree of market competition and the share of RL agents. Under independent Q-functions, agents spontaneously segregate into heterogeneous strategies, yielding higher aggregate market power and producer surplus without explicit coordination. The prevalence of RL agents shapes aggregate output and volatility in a non-monotonic way. To rationalize these findings, we develop a stylized theoretical framework that links the competition intensity between RL and non-RL agents with the prevailing optimal pricing strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文将一个标准宏观经济基于主体模型（ABM）中的部分启发式定价企业替换为强化学习（RL）智能体，使其通过与经济环境的重复互动学习利润最大化策略。研究发现：当RL智能体共享Q函数时，它们会内生收敛到三种战略模式之一（市场势力、掠夺性定价或准完全竞争）；当使用独立Q函数时，智能体自发分化为异质策略，产生更高的总体市场势力和生产者剩余。RL智能体的占比对总产出和波动性呈非单调影响。
AI.research_question: 在宏观经济基于主体模型（ABM）中引入强化学习智能体替代启发式定价企业后，RL智能体会学习何种定价策略？这些策略如何影响宏观经济结果（如市场势力、总产出、波动性）？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观经济ABM中的企业采用行为性（非最优）的启发式价格和数量策略，缺乏理性最优化的微观基础。作者希望通过引入强化学习，赋予企业学习利润最大化策略的能力，从而弥合行为经济学与理性最优之间的鸿沟，并探索AI智能体在宏观经济学模型中的行为特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于主体模型（ABM）、强化学习（Q-learning）、市场势力理论、竞争理论
AI.method: 将标准宏观经济ABM中的部分启发式定价企业替换为强化学习智能体；比较共享Q函数与独立Q函数两种学习架构下的均衡结果；通过数值模拟分析不同RL占比和市场竞争程度下的战略模式；构建简约理论框架来解释模拟发现。
AI.findings: （1）共享Q函数下，RL智能体内生收敛到三种战略模式：市场势力、掠夺性定价、准完全竞争，具体均衡取决于市场竞争程度和RL占比；（2）独立Q函数下，智能体自发分化为异质策略，产生更高的总体市场势力和生产者剩余，且无需显式协调；（3）RL智能体占比对总产出和波动性的影响呈非单调关系。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次将强化学习系统性地引入宏观经济ABM中，为行为经济学与理性最优之间提供了桥梁；（2）揭示了RL智能体在宏观经济环境中能自发形成多种均衡战略模式，丰富了市场结构和竞争理论；（3）提出了一个解释RL与非RL智能体竞争强度与最优定价策略之间关系的简约理论框架。
