AI.practical_contributions: 实践上，为政策制定者提供警示：气候政策若缺乏有效监督和执行机制，可能事与愿违地激励象征性环境行为；为投资者提供识别漂绿风险的分析框架（如关注披露-绩效差距而非单纯ESG评级）；为企业董事会和治理层提供强化环境实质性监督的建议；并为资本市场参与者揭示漂绿行为的长期融资成本代价。

title: Downsian Competition for the Myerson Value
affiliations: Hitotsubashi University - Graduate School of Economics

detail.title: Downsian Competition for the Myerson Value
detail.abstract: This paper studies an electoral competition model in which parties maximize legislative power rather than vote shares. Voters are uniformly distributed on the unit interval and vote for the party proposing the closest policy platform. After the election, parties form coalitions through a communication network arising from ideological proximity: two parties are directly linked if their policy distance is at most d. A party's objective is its Myerson value in the resulting graph-restricted voting game. I characterize symmetric pure-strategy equilibria in two-, three-, and four-party systems. The two-party case yields convergence to the median. The three-party case admits a continuum of symmetric equilibria in which the two extreme parties are directly linked. In the four-party case, the unique symmetric equilibrium places two parties at (1-d)/2 and two parties at (1+d)/2. In both three-and four-party systems, more restrictive coalition communication, represented by a smaller d, generates a centripetal force, and the median voter theorem holds in the limit despite the multiparty setting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个政党以最大化立法权力（而非选票份额）为目标的选举竞争模型。选民均匀分布在单位区间上，投票给政策平台最近的政党。选举后，政党通过基于意识形态邻近性的沟通网络（政策距离不超过d的两党直接相连）形成联盟，政党目标是其在图受限投票博弈中的Myerson值。作者刻画了二党、三党和四党体制下的对称纯策略均衡，发现在三党和四党体制下，更受限的联盟沟通（更小的d）会产生向心力，并使中位选民定理在极限情形下成立。
AI.research_question: 在多党选举竞争模型中，当政党最大化立法权力（而非选票份额）且联盟形成受沟通网络限制时，各政党体制下的对称纯策略均衡为何？更受限的联盟沟通对政策极化有何影响？
AI.motivation: 传统选举竞争模型通常假设政党最大化选票份额或获胜概率，但现实中政党更关注立法权力和联盟组建能力。本文引入Myerson值作为政党目标，并结合网络结构刻画联盟沟通约束，试图弥合选举竞争理论与联盟博弈理论之间的鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选举竞争模型（Hotelling-Downs框架）、联盟形成博弈、图受限合作博弈理论、Myerson值、中位选民定理
AI.method: 理论建模与分析：构建选民均匀分布在单位区间、政党策略选择政策平台的选举竞争模型，利用Myerson值定义政党目标函数，通过博弈论方法求解二、三、四党体制下的对称纯策略均衡并分析参数d的影响。
AI.findings: （1）两党情形收敛于中位选民；（2）三党情形存在连续统的对称均衡，其中两个极端政党直接相连；（3）四党情形存在唯一对称均衡，两个政党位于(1-d)/2，另两个位于(1+d)/2；（4）在三党和四党体制下，更小的d（更受限的联盟沟通）产生向心力，极限情形下中位选民定理成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Myerson值引入选举竞争模型，拓展了政党目标函数的研究视角；证明在考虑立法权力的多党选举中，联盟沟通限制可产生向心力并使中位选民定理在极限下成立，丰富了多党制下的政策收敛理论；将网络博弈理论与选举竞争理论有机结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解多党制下政党政策定位提供理论依据；揭示了联盟沟通结构的紧密程度对政策极化的影响，对政党联盟策略和制度设计具有参考意义。

title: From Displacement to Settlement A Scenario Framework for the AI Labor Transition, the Indian Transmission Channel, and a Firm Level Survival Audit

detail.title: From Displacement to Settlement A Scenario Framework for the AI Labor Transition, the Indian Transmission Channel, and a Firm Level Survival Audit
detail.abstract: This paper develops an end to end framework for the labor market transition induced by advanced artificial intelligence, extending the analysis past the moment of displacement to the economic equilibrium that follows it. A decomposition of the global labor force shows that even superhuman AI capability in cognitive domains directly exposes only about one fifth of world employment, and three displacement scenarios are constructed with assessed probabilities over a six to eight year window. The framework's central empirical case is India, whose export of cognitive labor creates a distinctive transmission channel: displacement occurring domestically even when AI adoption occurs abroad, propagating through the technology export engine, urban consumption, fiscal capacity, and demographic pressure. Evidence from 2026, including silent layoffs, collapsed entry level hiring, and the divergence between industry revenue growth of 6.1 percent and headcount growth of 2.3 percent, is shown to match the framework's predicted early signature, in which displacement manifests as underemployment and wage compression rather than headline unemployment. The paper then characterizes the transition as a rotation of economic activity toward five durable scarcities, models the post transition settlement, and contributes a firm level diagnostic, the Displacement Survival Audit, that converts the macro scenario into a scored, stress testable assessment of any operating business. The framework connects to the redistribution literature by identifying broad based asset ownership infrastructure as the settlement era's defining institution.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个端到端的框架，分析先进人工智能引发的劳动力市场转型，将分析从失业发生时刻延伸到随后的经济均衡。研究将全球劳动力进行分解，发现即使是超人级的AI认知能力也仅直接暴露约五分之一的全球就业。论文以印度为核心实证案例，识别出其认知劳动出口带来的独特传导渠道，并基于2026年的证据验证了框架的早期预测特征。文章还将转型描述为经济活动向五大持久稀缺性轮动，提出了企业层面的诊断工具"流离失所生存审计"，并将广义资产所有权基础设施确立为转型后时代的制度核心。
AI.research_question: 先进人工智能引发的劳动力市场转型如何从失业发生时刻延伸到后续经济均衡？具体包括：哪些就业暴露于AI能力、转型的传导机制如何运作、转型后的经济均衡形态是什么？
AI.motivation: 已有研究多聚焦于AI导致的失业瞬间，缺乏对转型全过程及后续经济均衡的系统性分析。全球劳动力和经济结构高度异质，需要更细致的分解和分场景的概率评估，需要将宏观场景转化为可操作的企业层面诊断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场转型理论、认知劳动出口传导机制（技术出口引擎、城市消费、财政能力、人口压力四条传导渠道）、经济均衡模型、持久稀缺性理论、再分配文献中关于资产所有权基础设施的制度理论。
AI.method: 全球劳动力分解分析、分场景概率评估（三个流离失所场景，六年至八年窗口）、印度实证案例分析（基于2026年数据：隐性裁员、入门级招聘崩塌、行业收入增长6.1%与员工人数增长2.3%的背离）、企业层面诊断工具（Displacement Survival Audit）构建与压力测试。
AI.findings: 超人级AI认知能力直接暴露约五分之一的全球就业；印度作为认知劳动出口国存在独特传导渠道（即使在海外采用AI，流离失所也会在国内发生）；2026年的证据与框架的早期预测特征吻合——流离失所表现为隐性失业和工资压缩而非显著失业率；转型本质是经济活动向五大持久稀缺性轮动。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI劳动力市场转型分析从流离失所时刻扩展到后续均衡，提出认知劳动出口国的独特传导机制，将再分配文献与转型后制度设计（广义资产所有权基础设施）联系起来，为宏观场景向企业微观诊断的桥接提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供三个流离失所场景及概率评估以指导政策制定；贡献Displacement Survival Audit企业级诊断工具，可将宏观情景转化为可评分、可压力测试的企业评估；为印度等认知劳动出口国的政策响应提供实证依据。

title: The Concept of Lawful Access and its Implications for User Freedoms in the EU Copyright Acquis: Opinion of the European Copyright Society
affiliations: Centre for IT & IP Law (CiTiP), Faculty of Law - KU Leuven, University of Glasgow - School of Law, Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, Juristische Fakultät, University of Amsterdam - Institute for Information Law (IViR) and University of Cyprus

detail.title: The Concept of Lawful Access and its Implications for User Freedoms in the EU Copyright Acquis: Opinion of the European Copyright Society

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The European Copyright Society (ECS) was founded in 2012 with the aim of creating a platform for critical and independent scholarly thinking on European Copyright Law and policy. Its members are scholars and academics from various countries of Europe, seeking to articulate and promote their views of the overall public interest on all topics in the field of authors rights, neighbouring rights and related matters. The ECS is neither funded nor instructed by any particular stakeholders. Its Opinions represent the independent views of a majority of ECS members.

detail.abstract: The advent of digital technologies and connected patterns of production and consumption has progressively displaced ownership in favour of access as the predominant mode of enjoyment of works of authorship and other information goods. This transition from acquiring physical copies to subscribing to digital services has become prevalent across various sectors and has even enabled new commercial, cultural and scientific practices. However, it also marks a major shift in the theory and function of copyright: it transforms a right primarily concerned with regulating certain exploitations and circulations of works into one capable of controlling individual acts of access and use. EU copyright law increasingly reflects this shift through conditions of lawfulness. These appear across the acquis in different forms: the “lawful acquirer” in the Software Directive, the “lawful user” in the Database Directive, “lawful use” and “lawful source” in the Information Society Directive and CJEU case law, and “lawful access” in the Text and Data Mining (TDM) provisions of the Copyright in the Digital Single Market Directive (CDSMD). These expressions are not merely terminological variants. They perform a boundary-setting function by determining when exceptions and limitations may be relied upon, and therefore when certain acts may take place without right holders’ authorization. The principal risk, surfaced in decisions such as ACI Adam or VOB, is that lawful access, lawful use or lawful source might be equated with right holders’ authorization. An interpretation of this kind would undermine the nature and function of exceptions and limitations. Since an exception presupposes that authorization is not required, making authorization the sole condition of lawfulness would create circularity and deprive exceptions of practical effect. At the same time, lawfulness cannot be understood as an unlimited permission to access or use protected works. It must operate within identifiable legal boundaries, including effective technological protection measures, valid and enforceable contractual restrictions where not overridden by mandatory law, and other legally binding limits. Its application must also be guided by contextual principles, including the meaning of content “freely available online”, the knowledge and role of the user, the purpose and commercial or non-commercial character of the activity, the applicable fundamental rights framework, and the three-step test.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了数字技术推动下，版权法从控制作品利用转向控制作品访问与使用的范式转变。欧盟版权法通过"合法获取"、"合法用户"、"合法使用"、"合法来源"、"合法访问"等条件性表述来设定行为边界，决定何时可以适用例外与限制。文章警告不能将这些"合法性"条件等同于权利人授权，否则将造成循环论证并使例外制度丧失实效，同时指出合法性必须在技术保护措施、合同限制、基本权利框架和三步检验法等法律边界内运行。
AI.research_question: 在数字时代版权从"所有权"转向"访问权"的背景下，欧盟版权法中"合法性"条件（lawfulness）的功能定位是什么？应如何解释和适用这些条件性表述以维持版权例外与限制制度的有效性？
AI.motivation: 数字技术促使版权从控制作品利用转向控制访问与使用，欧盟版权法中出现了"合法获取"、"合法用户"、"合法使用"、"合法来源"、"合法访问"等多种合法性表述。这些表述可能被误解为等同于权利人授权（如ACI Adam和VOB案所示），从而破坏例外与限制制度的功能，因此需要厘清其法律边界和适用原则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 版权例外与限制的功能理论；版权法的边界设定理论（boundary-setting function）；版权法中"合法性"条件的概念分析
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（Doctrinal Legal Analysis）：对欧盟版权法相关指令（软件指令、数据库指令、信息社会指令、CDSM指令）中的合法性条款进行文本分析，结合CJEU判例（ACI Adam、VOB等）进行体系性解释。
AI.findings: 欧盟版权法中的合法性表述在功能上具有一致性，即设定例外与限制适用的边界。合法性不应等同于权利人授权，否则会产生循环论证并使例外失效。合法性须在具体法律边界内运行：技术保护措施、合同限制（除被强制法覆盖的情形外）、其他法律约束，并需结合语境性原则——内容是否"自由在线可得"、用户知识与角色、活动目的与商业/非商业性质、基本权利框架及三步检验法。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文系统化了欧盟版权法中分散的合法性概念，论证其在版权例外与限制体系中的统一功能，并提出防止"合法性=授权"这一循环性解释的理论框架，丰富了版权例外理论的边界设定维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟法院和成员国法院在解释合法性条件（尤其是TDM条款下的"合法访问"）时提供了操作性的判断标准，也有助于立法者和利益相关者理解版权例外适用的具体边界，避免因过度依赖授权条件而使例外制度空洞化。

title: Youth-Type Blackhole Economy: Behavioral Rerouting and Future Effective Stock in Japan

detail.title: Youth-Type Blackhole Economy: Behavioral Rerouting and Future Effective Stock in Japan
detail.abstract:
This paper develops the Youth-Type Blackhole Economy as a theory of temporal disconnection in which present resources exist but fail to reinforce an efficient, credible, and recursively shared path to future livelihood security. The concept is not a synonym for poverty, low saving, or physical resource disappearance. Younger generations generate labor income, pay compulsory social insurance contributions, accumulate employment and contribution histories, and form human capital. The analytical problem arises when these resources are routed through channels whose conversion performance, portability, risk-sharing capacity, or perceived credibility is weak, causing resources to leave or fail to strengthen the shared risk-pooling circuit.

 The paper introduces a channel-based dynamic model. Objective Stock formation occurs through public, occupational, and private transfer routes, each with its own allocation share, conversion efficiency, and rate of return. Transtemporal trust is represented operationally by route-specific perceived credibility γ. It does not directly reduce objective Stock. It influences route choice, voluntary allocation, and reliance on liquid self-insurance. A decline in perceived credibility may therefore increase private saving for some individuals, increase liquidity preference for others, or increase current consumption for others. The common mechanism is not a uniform fall in total Stock, but the weakening or abandonment of a shared public temporal bridge and the resulting loss of risk pooling, continuity, and allocative efficiency. 

The model also includes a later-life release circuit in which accumulated Stock must be converted into current livelihood Flow. Objective barriers and subjective defensive preferences are separated. Public social insurance is treated as imperfectly substitutable with private accumulation because longevity pooling, disability and survivor protection, and broadly accessible inflation-adjusted lifetime claims cannot generally be replicated on equivalent terms through individual saving alone. This produces a temporal symmetry between forward disconnection in youth and release disconnection in later life.

A Cabinet Office survey item on old-age planning is presented only as an illustrative behavioral proxy. The paper explicitly identifies the age-period-cohort problem and does not infer cohort specific trust from one cross-section. The contribution is a falsifiable research framework for studying when institutionally transferred resources remain formally present yet generate welfare losses because participants reroute, duplicate, or immobilize resources in response to a channel they do not regard as credible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"青年型黑洞经济"理论，解释当代资源存在却未能有效转化为未来生计保障的跨期断裂现象。通过渠道动态模型，区分公共、职业、私人三条转移路径，引入路径特定感知可信度γ来操作化跨期信任，揭示资源在低可信度渠道中被重新路由、重复或固化的福利损失机制，并建立了可证伪的研究框架。
AI.research_question: 当代资源虽然存在却无法有效强化通往未来生计安全的共享路径时，跨期断裂是如何产生的？感知可信度的下降如何影响个体在资源分配中的行为选择及整体福利？
AI.motivation: 现有研究常将这类问题简单等同于贫困、低储蓄或资源消失，未能捕捉资源形式上存在但渠道转换功能失灵所导致的深层机制。需要一个新的理论框架来解释为什么制度性转移资源在名义上存在却产生福利损失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 青年型黑洞经济理论、跨期信任理论（以路径特定感知可信度γ操作化）、渠道基础动态模型、生命周期资源释放理论、公共与私人积累不完全替代理论。
AI.method: 渠道基础动态模型构建：公共、职业、私人三条转移路径各自具有分配份额、转换效率和回报率；引入路径特定感知可信度γ反映跨期信任；模型包含后期释放回路，分离客观障碍与主观防御性偏好；使用内阁府调查项目作为说明性行为代理指标。
AI.findings: 感知可信度下降不直接减少客观存量，而是影响路径选择、自愿分配和流动性自我保险依赖。不同个体可能表现为增加私人储蓄、提高流动性偏好或增加当前消费。共同机制是共享公共时间桥梁的弱化或放弃，导致风险分担、连续性和配置效率的损失。公共社会保险与私人积累不可完全替代，产生青年期前向断裂与晚年释放断裂的时间对称性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"青年型黑洞经济"这一新概念，将问题从资源数量的减少重新定义为资源在低可信度渠道中的流失；建立可证伪的研究框架；揭示感知可信度影响行为的微观机制差异化；识别前向断裂与释放断裂的时间对称性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解制度性转移资源的信任危机提供分析工具；帮助识别个体因不信任渠道而进行的重复性、防御性资源配置行为；为公共社会保险改革提供理论依据，说明其不可替代的价值所在。

title: A Dynamic Search and Matching Model of Foster Care: Theory and Evidence
affiliations: Nazarbayev University - Economics Department and Banco de México

detail.title: A Dynamic Search and Matching Model of Foster Care: Theory and Evidence
detail.abstract: This paper examines the two-sided dynamic matching problem in the US foster care system, where foster parents and children form reversible matches that may separate, persist, or transition to adoption. We first present new empirical facts on match transitions using administrative data. We then develop a two-sided search and matching model to rationalize these facts and generate predictions. Our findings show that a financial penalty on adoption exacerbates the intrinsic disadvantage faced by children with greater care needs and discourages high-quality matches from transitioning to adoption, highlighting important policy implications for improving permanency outcomes in foster care.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国寄养系统中的双边动态匹配问题，提出了一个新的实证发现（基于行政数据）和双面搜索匹配模型，发现收养的经济惩罚会加剧高需求儿童的内在劣势，并阻碍高质量匹配向收养转化，对改善寄养永久性结果具有重要政策启示。
AI.research_question: 美国寄养系统中，寄养父母与儿童之间的双边动态匹配如何形成、演变（分离、持续或收养），以及收养相关的经济激励如何影响匹配结果和永久性结局？
AI.motivation: 寄养系统中的匹配是可逆的，可能分离、持续或转化为收养，但现有研究缺乏对匹配转变动态的系统理解。理解这些动态以及收养经济激励的影响，对改善儿童永久性结局至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双边搜索与匹配理论（Two-sided search and matching model）
AI.method: 使用行政数据呈现匹配转变的新实证事实，并构建双面搜索匹配模型对事实进行合理化解释并生成预测。
AI.findings: 收养上的经济惩罚会加剧高护理需求儿童面临的内在劣势，并抑制高质量匹配向收养的转化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将双边搜索匹配理论应用于寄养系统这一独特的可逆匹配情境，为理解匹配转变动态（分离、持续、收养）提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了收养经济激励政策对寄养儿童永久性结局的影响机制，为改进寄养系统的政策设计（尤其是关于收养补贴或惩罚）提供了实证和理论依据。

title: Forward and Reverse Bayesianism under Ambiguity

detail.title: Forward and Reverse Bayesianism under Ambiguity
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a model of ambiguity in which a decision maker may encounter new information and unforeseen contingencies simultaneously during a decision-making process. Focusing on constant independence preferences, the paper characterizes three methods of forward and reverse updating: the full Bayesian update and the maximum and minimum likelihood methods, all of which are consistent with Bayesianism. In all methods, Bayesianism requires that the prior and posterior belief sets satisfy a weaker form of rectangularity (Epstein and Schneider, 2003). This condition implies that the decision maker's probability perception over the current states may be independent of unobserved events and newly recognized events.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个同时涉及新信息和不可预见偶然事件的模糊决策模型，基于常数独立偏好，刻画了三种与贝叶斯主义一致的更新方法（完全贝叶斯更新、最大似然和最小似然方法），并证明所有方法都要求先验和后验信念集合满足矩形性的弱化形式。
AI.research_question: 在决策过程中同时遇到新信息和不可预见偶然事件时，如何对模糊信念进行前后向更新？
AI.motivation: 现有模糊决策模型通常假设状态空间是固定的，但现实中决策者可能在决策过程中同时遭遇新信息和之前未预见的偶然事件，这对信念更新提出了新的理论挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模糊决策理论；贝叶斯主义；常数独立偏好；矩形性条件（Epstein and Schneider, 2003）
AI.method: 理论建模与公理化分析，聚焦于常数独立偏好下的信念更新规则刻画
AI.findings: （1）刻画了三种与贝叶斯主义一致的前向与反向更新方法：完全贝叶斯更新、最大似然和最小似然方法；（2）所有方法都要求先验和后验信念集满足弱化形式的矩形性条件；（3）该条件意味着决策者对当前状态的概率感知独立于未观测事件和新识别的事件。
AI.theory_contributions: 将模糊决策中的信息更新理论扩展至同时包含新信息和不可预见偶然事件的情形，并放松了矩形性条件，拓展了Epstein和Schneider（2003）的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际决策情境中面临动态环境变化和意外事件的决策者提供了信念更新的理论指导，有助于理解不确定性条件下的决策行为。

title: Economic-Aware Agentic Private Networks
affiliations: and Celona Inc.

detail.title: Economic-Aware Agentic Private Networks
detail.abstract: Private wireless networks are becoming the operating fabric of modern enterprises. In factories, ports, airports, warehouses, hospitals, mines, and energy sites, network decisions increasingly shape production continuity, worker safety, inspection quality, logistics flow, compliance, energy use, and operating cost. This paper introduces Economic-Aware Agentic Private Networks (Economic-Aware Agentic Private Networks), a framework for private wireless systems that bring enterprise value into the control loop. An Economic-Aware Agentic Private Network reasons over technical state, spectrum state, application criticality, business-economic state, historical evidence, and governance rules to select, validate, explain, and audit network actions. The framework combines business-intent translation, economic policy, retrieval and memory, supervisor and specialist agents, enterprise-utility scoring, digital-twin validation, governed actuation, and post-action verification. We formulate economic-aware control as constrained enterprise-utility maximization under cost, risk, energy, service-level, spectrum, safety, and approval constraints. We then develop a reference architecture, data model, closed-loop workflow, enterprise use cases, evaluation framework, and research roadmap. The central message is that private networks should evolve from KPI-driven automation toward business-aware control systems that act only when a network action creates enterprise value, respects operational risk, and satisfies governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出经济感知智能体专用网络（Economic-Aware Agentic Private Networks）框架，将企业价值纳入专用无线网络的控制回路中，通过技术状态、频谱状态、应用关键性、业务经济状态等多维度推理来选择、验证、解释和审计网络操作，实现从KPI驱动的自动化向业务感知控制系统的演进。
AI.research_question: 如何将企业经济价值纳入专用无线网络的控制回路，使网络决策不仅能保障技术性能（KPI），还能兼顾业务经济价值、运营风险与治理合规？
AI.motivation: 专用无线网络已成为现代企业（工厂、港口、机场、仓库、医院、矿山、能源站点等）的运营基础设施，网络决策直接影响生产连续性、工人安全、检查质量、物流流程、合规性、能源使用和运营成本。然而现有网络自动化主要围绕KPI驱动，缺乏对企业经济价值的感知与纳入，需要向业务感知控制系统演进。
AI.theoretical_framework: 约束型企业效用最大化（constrained enterprise-utility maximization）、经济感知控制（economic-aware control）、多智能体系统（supervisor and specialist agents）、数字孪生验证（digital-twin validation）
AI.method: 本文提出一个概念性框架，包括：业务意图翻译、经济策略、检索与记忆、主管和专家智能体、企业效用评分、数字孪生验证、受治理的执行、以及行动后验证等组件。同时开发了参考架构、数据模型、闭环工作流、企业用例、评估框架和研究路线图。
AI.findings: 专用网络应从KPI驱动的自动化演进为业务感知的控制系统，仅在网络行动能创造企业价值、尊重运营风险并满足治理要求时才采取行动。该框架将经济感知控制公式化为在成本、风险、能源、服务水平、频谱、安全和审批约束下的约束型企业效用最大化问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了经济感知Agentic网络的新概念框架，将企业价值、经济效用与治理约束系统地引入网络控制回路，扩展了传统KPI驱动网络自动化的理论边界，并形式化了经济感知控制问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为专用无线网络的运营商和企业用户提供了参考架构、数据模型、闭环工作流和评估框架，支持在工厂、港口、机场、仓库、医院、矿山和能源站点等场景中实现业务感知的网络控制，提升运营效率并降低风险。

title: Digital Payments and Retail Productivity: An Exploration with A Panel of U.S. Retail Subsectors
affiliations: Charles River Associates (CRA), Charles River Associates (CRA), Charles River Associates (CRA), Charles River Associates (CRA) and Charles River Associates (CRA)

detail.title: Digital Payments and Retail Productivity: An Exploration with A Panel of U.S. Retail Subsectors

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have received financial support from Visa USA in the preparation of this study. The opinions expressed in this study are exclusively those of the authors, and do not reflect or represent the views of Visa USA, Charles River Associates, or any other institutions with which the authors are, or have been, affilicated
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Visa USA

detail.abstract: The evidence suggests that labor productivity in the U.S. retail sector has increased substantially since 1995. A few studies also show that investments in information technology by retailers have contributed to raising labor productivity. To our knowledge, however, the link between digital-payment use and retail productivity remains unexamined. We explore the issue by combining publicly available panels from the Bureau of Labor Statistics and the U.S. Census Bureau's County Business Patterns with a dataset on payment-card use by county and retail subsector. We estimate a variety of econometric specifications, including instrumental-variable models that address the potential endogeneity of digital-payment use. We find that a 10-percent increase in the share of digital payments in total sales is associated with an increase in retail labor productivity of between half of a percent and one and a half percent.

AI.tldr: 本文首次考察了数字支付使用与美国零售业劳动生产率之间的关系，通过结合BLS和Census Bureau的企业数据以及按县和零售子行业划分的支付卡使用数据，使用包括工具变量在内的多种计量经济模型，发现数字支付占总销售额比例每增加10%，零售劳动生产率将提高0.5%到1.5%。
AI.research_question: 数字支付的使用是否以及如何影响美国零售业的劳动生产率？
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明自1995年以来美国零售业劳动生产率大幅提升，且信息技术投资对劳动生产率有贡献，但数字支付使用与零售生产率之间的关联尚未被研究过，本文填补了这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息技术投资与生产率关系的研究脉络，探讨数字支付作为技术投入对零售业劳动生产率的影响机制。
AI.method: 将劳工统计局和人口普查局县商业模式的公开面板数据与按县和零售子行业分类的支付卡使用数据相结合，采用多种计量经济学模型，包括处理数字支付潜在内生性的工具变量模型。
AI.findings: 数字支付占总销售额的比例每增加10%，零售劳动生产率提高0.5%至1.5%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次建立了数字支付使用与零售劳动生产率之间的实证联系，拓展了信息技术投资与生产率关系的研究领域，为理解数字化转型对服务业生产率的影响提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售企业投资数字支付基础设施提供了实证依据，同时也为政策制定者在推动数字经济发展和提升服务业效率方面提供了参考。

title: Activity Moves, Volatility does not: Falsification Evidence from a Regulator-mandated Expiry-day Reassignment
affiliations: Vijayanagara Sri Krishnadevaraya University and Vijayanagara Sri Krishnadevaraya University

detail.title: Activity Moves, Volatility does not: Falsification Evidence from a Regulator-mandated Expiry-day Reassignment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing financial or non-financial interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses publicly available aggregate market and bibliographic data and involves no human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no financial support for the research, authorship or publication of this article.

detail.abstract:
Purpose. This study asks whether a regulator can relocate expiry-day trading activity by administrative decision, and whether such a relocation carries measurable consequences for volatility. It exploits a reassignment of weekly derivatives expiry days that moved two competing Indian exchanges to opposite weekdays on the same date.

Design. Following Securities and Exchange Board of India circular SEBI/HO/MRD/MRD-TPD-1/P/CIR/2025/76, the National Stock Exchange moved Nifty 50 weekly expiry from Thursday to Tuesday on 1 September 2025 while BSE Limited moved Sensex weekly expiry from Tuesday to Thursday. Difference-in-differences and triple-difference models are estimated on 387 trading days spanning 1 January 2025 to 28 July 2026. Because the design rests on only two exchanges, every headline estimate is subjected to a four-part falsification battery: randomisation inference over 200 placebo event dates excluding a ninety-day window around the true one, specifications with weekday-specific linear time trends, quarterly event studies, and placebo weekdays.

Findings. Trading activity relocated sharply and the result survives every test. At the BSE the Tuesday turnover premium fell from 46.8 to −9.7 per cent and the Thursday premium rose from −4.7 to 61.8 per cent, both interactions significant beyond the 0.1 per cent level. The actual estimates lie outside the 95 per cent placebo interval, giving randomisation p-values below 0.001; the coefficients strengthen rather than weaken when weekday time trends are added; the event study shows a flat pre-period and a discontinuity at the migration; and among the five weekdays only Tuesday and Thursday move. Volatility tells the opposite story. The triple-difference coefficient of 0.000365 is significant under clustered standard errors (p = 0.006) but fails every falsification test: the randomisation p-value is 0.233, the coefficient collapses by 99 per cent to 0.000004 once an index-specific Tuesday trend is included, and the event study reveals a steady slope rather than a break. What appeared to be a volatility effect is a pre-existing trend in the relative volatility of the two indices. Expiry days also carry no abnormal returns in either regime.

Originality. This is the first study of a regulator-mandated, bidirectional expiry-day reassignment. Its methodological contribution is to show that in a two-venue difference-in-differences design, conventional clustered standard errors can indicate significance where randomisation inference and trend controls do not, and that reporting both is necessary rather than optional.

Practical implications. Settlement-day assignment is an effective instrument for redistributing trading activity across the week. The evidence does not, however, support the inference that redistributing activity alters volatility, which bears directly on the regulator’s stated objective of de-concentrating expiry-day risk.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用印度市场监管机构将两家交易所周度衍生品到期日互换这一自然实验，发现行政指令可以显著重塑到期日交易活动分布（BSE周二溢价从46.8%降至-9.7%，周四溢价从-4.7%升至61.8%），但交易活动的重新分配并未带来波动率的实质性变化——看似显著的波动率效应实为两指数间的事前趋势。
AI.research_question: 监管机构能否通过行政决策重新安排到期日的交易活动？这种重新安排是否会对波动率产生可测量的影响？
AI.motivation: 印度证监会（SEBI）出于分散到期日风险的监管目标，通过行政指令将印度国家证券交易所（NSE）和孟买证券交易所（BSE）的周度衍生品到期日互换。这提供了一个独特的机会来检验监管主导的到期日活动重分配是否有效，以及是否真的能达到降低波动率风险的目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于到期日效应理论（如到期日波动率异常等），并运用双重差分（DID）和三重差分（DDD）的因果推断框架。
AI.method: 采用双重差分和三重差分模型，基于2025年1月1日至2026年7月28日共387个交易日的数据。由于设计中仅涉及两家交易所，作者对核心估计进行四部分虚假检验（falsification battery）：(1) 200个安慰剂事件日的随机化推断；(2) 加入工作日特定线性时间趋势的设定；(3) 季度事件研究；(4) 安慰剂工作日检验。
AI.findings: (1) 交易活动确实发生了显著且剧烈的重新分配，BSE周二成交溢价从46.8%降至-9.7%，周四溢价从-4.7%升至61.8%，所有交互项在0.1%水平上显著，并通过所有虚假检验；(2) 波动率方面，三重差分系数虽然在聚类标准误下显著（p=0.006），但未通过任何虚假检验（随机化p值0.233，加入趋势后系数崩塌99%），表明波动率效应实为事前趋势；(3) 到期日在两种制度下均无异常收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 这是首篇研究监管强制、双向到期日重分配的研究。方法论贡献在于证明：在两场所双重差分设计中，传统聚类标准误可能在随机化推断和趋势控制显示不显著时仍然显示显著，因此报告两者是必要的而非可选的。
AI.practical_contributions: 结算日分配是有效的工具，可以用来重新分配一周内的交易活动。但证据不支持"重新分配交易活动会改变波动率"的推断，这直接关系到监管机构分散到期日风险的既定目标是否能够实现。

title: Diagnosing How College Basketball Teams Defend: An Opponent-Adjusted Public-Data Decision-Support Framework
affiliations: University of Waterloo - Department of Management Sciences

detail.title: Diagnosing How College Basketball Teams Defend: An Opponent-Adjusted Public-Data Decision-Support Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available team-level and game-level basketball data and does not involve human participants, intervention, private personal information, or biological material. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no specific funding for this work.

detail.abstract: Defensive rankings make college basketball look cleaner than scouting rooms usually feel. Teams with similar adjusted efficiency often create different preparation problems: one defense ends possessions through pressure, another protects shot quality, and another taxes fouls or rebounds. This paper develops an opponent-adjusted public-data performanceanalysis framework that turns standard NCAA team-game records into defensive scouting channels. The framework treats prediction as a pregame scouting task, asking whether those channels identify future matchups where scoring risk deserves attention. The adjusted defensive dimensions carry most of the framework's value. Risk-oriented validation translates those dimensions into matchup triage, while the lagged spatial scouting supplement adds a secondary source of court-location evidence. The paper contributes a validated scouting language between public rankings and film-based preparation.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个对手调整的公开数据表现分析框架，将标准的NCAA球队比赛记录转化为防守侦察渠道。该框架将预测视为赛前侦察任务，检验这些渠道能否识别出值得关注的未来比赛对位风险。调整后的防守维度承载了框架的主要价值，而滞后空间侦察补充提供了次要的球场位置证据来源。
AI.research_question: 如何将标准的NCAA大学篮球公开比赛数据转化为对手调整的防守侦察渠道，并识别未来比赛中值得关注的得分风险对位？
AI.motivation: 防守排名使大学篮球看起来比实际侦察室的情况更清晰。具有相似调整效率的球队往往会产生不同的备战问题：一个防守通过施压终结进攻，另一个保护投篮质量，还有一个消耗罚球或篮板。传统的排名无法捕捉这些差异化的防守风格。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对手调整的表现分析框架，将比赛预测视为赛前侦察任务，结合风险导向的验证逻辑与滞后空间侦察补充。
AI.method: 构建对手调整的公开数据性能分析框架，将球队比赛记录转化为多维防守侦察渠道，采用风险导向验证方法将防守维度转化为对位分诊，并加入滞后空间侦察作为辅助证据来源。
AI.findings: 调整后的防守维度承载了框架的大部分价值；风险导向验证将这些维度转化为对位分诊工具；滞后空间侦察补充提供了第二来源的球场位置证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个经过验证的侦察语言，连接了公开排名与基于录像的赛前准备，填补了定量排名与定性录像分析之间的方法论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学篮球队提供了可操作的对位风险识别工具，帮助教练组在赛前准备中更精准地识别防守风格差异带来的备战挑战，并以对位分诊形式辅助战术决策。

title: Refugee Absorption and Electoral Change: Evidence from the Indian Partition
affiliations: and University of Luxembourg

detail.title: Refugee Absorption and Electoral Change: Evidence from the Indian Partition
detail.abstract: The 1947 Partition of British India triggered the largest forced migration of the twentieth century, redistributing millions of refugees across newly independent India. We study whether this demographic shock left a lasting imprint on democratic politics. Combining district-level refugee shares from the 1951 Census with constituency-level electoral data covering Indian state assembly elections between 1960 and 2007, we estimate the long-run effects of refugee settlement on electoral competition. We find that constituencies exposed to larger refugee inflows exhibit higher voter turnout, narrower victory margins, and a lower likelihood of electing candidates from national parties. Instead, refugee settlement shifted electoral support toward regional parties and contributed to the long-run denationalization of political competition. Our findings show that large demographic shocks can leave enduring political legacies, reshaping patterns of political representation and party competition long after displacement itself has ended.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用1951年印度人口普查中的地区级难民比例数据，结合1960-2007年印度邦议会选举数据，发现1947年印巴分治引发的大规模难民迁移对印度民主政治产生了持久影响：难民涌入较多的选区呈现出更高的投票率、更小的胜选差距、更低的全国性政党候选人当选概率，以及更强的地区性政党支持，导致政治竞争的"去全国化"。
AI.research_question: 1947年印巴分治引发的大规模人口迁移（难民安置）是否在长期内影响了印度的民主政治竞争格局？
AI.motivation: 1947年印巴分治是20世纪最大规模的强迫性人口迁移，但关于这种大规模人口冲击是否会留下持久的政治遗产，尤其是在民主政治竞争方面，缺乏系统的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 大规模人口冲击与政治遗产理论；难民安置对政治竞争和政党格局变迁的长期影响机制。
AI.method: 结合1951年印度人口普查的地区级难民比例数据与1960-2007年印度邦议会选举的选区级选举数据，利用计量经济学方法估计难民安置对选举竞争的长期效应。
AI.findings: 难民流入较多的选区呈现更高的选民投票率、更小的胜选差距、更低的全国性政党候选人当选概率；难民安置将选举支持转向地区性政党，导致政治竞争的长期"去全国化"。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了大规模人口冲击可以留下持久的政治遗产，扩展了关于人口迁移与政治制度变迁之间关系的理论理解，揭示了难民安置对政党竞争格局和代表性结构的长期重塑作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解大规模移民/难民安置对接收国或地区政治格局的长期影响提供了实证证据，对政策制定者评估难民安置的政治后果具有参考价值。

title: Confidence and Algorithmic Advice
affiliations: Humboldt University of Berlin - Faculty of Economics,  and Technische Universität Berlin (TU Berlin) - Faculty of Economics and Management

detail.title: Confidence and Algorithmic Advice

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declaration of Interest: none.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval by the Technical University Berlin Faculty of Economics and Management (VII) Ethics Committee (project number 20251016).
declarations.funderStatement: German Research Foundation (DFG)

detail.abstract: Human decision-makers are increasingly interacting with algorithms, which often serve as advisors. The literature on advice-taking suggests that people discount other's advice, especially when they feel competent. We propose an experiment to study how self-confidence influences the reliance on algorithmic advice in terms of advise utilization and confidence in the final decision. In our online experiment, participants make age predictions and estimates about the accuracy of their predictions before and after receiving algorithmic advice. We exogenously vary subjects' confidence by implementing different (perceived) task difficulties and the (observed) quality of the algorithmic advisor. While we find that participants generally put more weight on high quality advice, we observe, contrary to the extant literature on advice-seeking, that participants are less influenced by advice when they perceive the task as difficult. By contrasting age and accuracy predictions, we show that people who feel proficient at a task appreciate the advice of a high-quality algorithmic advisor but barely follow it. Rather, this is expressed as an increase of the confidence in the accuracy of their prediction. When people feel less proficient at a task, they are more reluctant to adjust their predictions toward the advice of a low-quality algorithmic advisor.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在线实验研究自我信心如何影响人们对算法建议的依赖程度。实验让参与者在接受算法建议前后对年龄进行预测并评估预测准确性，通过操纵任务难度和算法建议质量来外生改变参与者信心。研究发现：参与者总体上更重视高质量建议；但与现有建议寻求文献相反，当参与者认为任务困难时，反而更少受建议影响。对比年龄预测和准确性预测发现，对任务感到熟练的人欣赏高质量算法建议但几乎不采纳，而是表现为对预测准确性的信心增加；对任务感到不熟练的人则更不愿意将预测向低质量算法建议调整。
AI.research_question: 自我信心如何影响个体对算法建议的依赖程度（包括建议采纳度和最终决策信心）？
AI.motivation: 人类决策者越来越多地与算法互动，算法常作为建议提供者。现有建议采纳文献表明人们会贬低他人建议，尤其是在自我感觉有能力时。但尚不清楚这种机制在算法建议情境下是否成立，因此需要通过实验系统研究自我信心与算法建议采纳之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 建议采纳理论（advice-taking literature）、自我效能/胜任感理论、算法建议依赖理论
AI.method: 在线实验设计：参与者进行年龄预测任务，并在接受算法建议前后分别评估预测准确度；通过操纵（感知的）任务难度和算法建议质量来外生改变参与者的信心水平。
AI.findings: 1. 参与者总体上更重视高质量算法建议；2. 与现有建议寻求文献相反，当参与者感知任务困难时，反而更少受建议影响；3. 对任务感到熟练的人欣赏高质量算法建议但几乎不采纳，表现为对该预测准确性的信心增加；4. 对任务感到不熟练的人更不愿意将预测向低质量算法建议调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了现有建议寻求文献中"任务越困难越依赖建议"的传统观点，揭示了在算法建议情境下自我信心与建议采纳之间存在与人类建议不同的机制；区分了建议采纳度与决策信心两个维度，表明两者可能并非同步变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为算法建议系统的设计提供指导：需要考虑用户自我信心水平来定制化建议呈现方式；对于高自信用户，算法建议可能更多起到增强信心而非改变决策的作用；对于低自信用户，低质量算法建议可能产生负面影响。

title: Youth-Type Blackhole Economy: Behavioral Rerouting and Future Effective Stock in Japan

detail.title: Youth-Type Blackhole Economy: Behavioral Rerouting and Future Effective Stock in Japan
detail.abstract:
This paper develops the Youth-Type Blackhole Economy as a theory of temporal disconnection in which present resources exist but fail to reinforce an efficient, credible, and recursively shared path to future livelihood security. Its central claim is that trust-induced behavioral rerouting constitutes a causal channel distinct from income, taxation, or liquidity constraints. The resulting welfare loss arises not necessarily from a reduction in objective resources, but from the weakening of shared risk pooling, intertemporal continuity, and allocative efficiency.

The concept is not a synonym for poverty, low saving, or physical resource disappearance. Younger generations generate labor income, pay compulsory social insurance contributions, accumulate employment and contribution histories, and form human capital. The analytical problem arises when these resources are routed through channels whose conversion performance, portability, risk-sharing capacity, or perceived credibility is weak, causing resources to leave or fail to strengthen the shared risk-pooling circuit.

The paper introduces a channel-based dynamic model. Objective Stock formation occurs through public, occupational, and private transfer routes, each with its own allocation share, conversion efficiency, and rate of return. Transtemporal trust is represented operationally by route-specific perceived credibility γ. It does not directly reduce objective Stock. Instead, it influences route choice, voluntary allocation, and reliance on liquid self-insurance. A decline in perceived credibility may therefore increase private saving for some individuals, increase liquidity preference for others, or increase current consumption for others. The principal falsifiable prediction is not a uniform change in total Stock, but systematic behavioral rerouting across institutional channels following exogenous changes in perceived credibility under conditions where liquidity constraints do not bind.

The model also includes a later-life release circuit in which accumulated Stock must be converted into current livelihood Flow. Objective barriers and subjective defensive preferences are separated. Public social insurance is treated as imperfectly substitutable with private accumulation because longevity pooling, disability and survivor protection, and broadly accessible inflation-adjusted lifetime claims cannot generally be replicated on equivalent terms through individual saving alone. This produces a temporal symmetry between forward disconnection in youth and release disconnection in later life.

A Cabinet Office survey item on old-age planning is presented only as an illustrative behavioral proxy. The paper explicitly identifies the age-period-cohort problem and does not infer cohort-specific trust from one cross-section. The contribution is a falsifiable conceptual framework for studying when institutionally transferred resources remain formally present yet generate welfare losses because participants reroute, duplicate, or immobilize resources in response to channels they do not regard as credible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"青年型黑洞经济"理论，阐述当现有资源未能转化为高效、可信且可递归共享的未来生计保障路径时产生的暂时性脱节。核心论断是，信任引发的行为改道构成独立于收入、税收和流动性约束的因果渠道，其福利损失源自共享风险池的削弱、代际连续性的断裂和配置效率的下降。
AI.research_question: 当机构性转移的资源在形式上仍然存在，但因参与者对渠道缺乏信任而进行改道、复制或固化时，如何产生福利损失？具体而言，感知信誉度的外生变化如何在不改变客观资源总量的情况下，通过系统性行为改道影响福利结果？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要从收入、税收或流动性约束角度解释福利损失，但忽视了一个重要渠道：信任诱导的行为改道。年轻世代虽能产生劳动收入、缴纳社会保险、积累人力资本，但当这些资源通过转换绩效、可携带性、风险分担能力或感知可信度较弱的渠道流动时，虽形式上资源仍存在，却未能强化共享风险分担回路，导致福利损失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 青年型黑洞经济理论（Youth-Type Blackhole Economy），包含：(1)渠道基础动态模型，客观存量通过公共、职业和私人转移三条渠道形成；(2)跨期信任的操作化表征——渠道特定的感知信誉度γ；(3)后期释放回路中的目标障碍与主观防御偏好分离；(4)时序对称性——青年期前向脱节与晚年释放脱节的对称关系。
AI.method: 采用渠道基础的动态模型。模型设定客观存量通过公共、职业和私人转移渠道形成，各自具有分配份额、转换效率和回报率；感知信誉度γ通过影响渠道选择、自愿配置和流动性自我保险依赖来发挥作用。使用内阁府调查中关于老年规划的条目作为行为代理变量，但明确指出年龄-时期-队列问题，不从单一截面推断队列特定信任。
AI.findings: (1)感知信誉度下降对不同个体产生异质性反应：部分人增加私人储蓄，部分人提高流动性偏好，部分人增加当前消费；(2)主要可证伪预测并非总存量的统一变化，而是在流动性约束不成立的条件下，感知信誉度外生变化引发的跨制度渠道的系统性行为改道；(3)公共社会保险与私人积累不可完全替代，因为长寿风险池、残疾和遗属保护及可广泛获得的通胀调整型终身权益通常无法通过个人储蓄等价复制；(4)青年期前向脱节与晚年释放脱节存在时序对称性。
AI.theory_contributions: (1)提出"青年型黑洞经济"作为时间脱节理论，区别于贫困、低储蓄或物理资源消失等既有概念；(2)确立信任诱导的行为改道作为独立于收入、税收和流动性约束的因果渠道；(3)将跨期信任操作化为渠道特定的感知信誉度γ，构建了可证伪的概念框架；(4)揭示前向脱节与释放脱节之间的时序对称性，深化对资源形式上存在但功能上失效的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: (1)为政策制定者提供诊断工具：识别机构转移资源形式上存在但参与者因不信任而改道、重复或固化的情境；(2)区分客观障碍与主观防御偏好，有助于针对性地设计制度干预，而非仅聚焦于资源总量调节；(3)强调公共社会保险不可替代性的福利价值，为社会保障制度的维护与改革提供理论依据；(4)为理解不同渠道的转换绩效、可携带性和风险分担能力提供分析框架，指导制度设计优化。

title: The Broken Promise of Social Mobility? Education Policy, Employability, and Inequality in Morocco: A Scoping Review

detail.title: The Broken Promise of Social Mobility? Education Policy, Employability, and Inequality in Morocco: A Scoping Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this scoping review used published literature and did not involve human participants, identifiable personal data, or animals.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Morocco has invested heavily in education reform, vocational training, higher education expansion, digital transformation, and youth employability initiatives. Yet persistent inequalities, graduate unemployment, skills mismatch, and uneven social mobility continue to raise questions about whether education still functions as a reliable pathway to opportunity. This scoping review maps the academic literature on education policy, skills mismatch, employability, and youth opportunity in Morocco. Following a PRISMA-ScR-informed approach, records were identified through Scopus and HAL, deduplicated in Zotero, and screened. After title and abstract screening, 95 full texts/files were assessed. The final synthesis included 81 core studies and 14 background/context sources. The evidence was organized into seven themes: inequality, social mobility, and territorial/gender disparities; digital transformation, ICT, and AI skills; higher education employability and graduate transitions; vocational training, mismatch, and continuing training; dropout, youth risk, and remedial reintegration; education policy, governance, and system quality; and language, internationalization, and cultural capital, together with a cross-cutting strand on trust, legitimacy, and the politics of credentialed unemployment. The review finds that Morocco has expanded access to education, but this expansion has not consistently translated into equal opportunity, secure employment, or upward social mobility. Instead, the literature points to a broken chain between schooling, skills, credentials, labour-market insertion, and social mobility. The paper argues that Morocco's education challenge is not simply one of access or reform design, but of implementation, coordination, and equity across the full education-to-work transition. The review's contribution is threefold: it consolidates a fragmented, multilingual literature; it reframes Morocco's challenge as one of conversion rather than access, grounded in the capability approach; and it identifies the education-trust link as one of the most consequential evidence gaps identified by this review.

AI.tldr: 本文通过PRISMA-ScR方法的范围综述，系统梳理了摩洛哥教育政策、技能错配、就业能力与青年机会的相关文献，最终纳入81项核心研究和14项背景来源。综述发现摩洛哥虽扩大了教育机会，但教育与就业、社会流动之间的链条断裂，问题本质是"转化"而非"获取"——即从教育到工作机会的转换机制失效，而非单纯的教育准入不足。
AI.research_question: 摩洛哥的教育政策、技能错配、就业能力与青年机会之间存在怎样的关系？教育是否仍然作为通向机会的可靠路径发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 摩洛哥虽在教育改革、职业培训、高等教育扩张和青年就业方面投入巨资，但持续存在的不平等、毕业生失业、技能错配和社会流动不均等问题，使人们质疑教育作为机会路径的有效性，需要系统性地梳理和整合该领域的分散文献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能力方法（capability approach）；教育至就业转换框架（education-to-work transition）；PRISMA-ScR综述方法框架
AI.method: 采用PRISMA-ScR-informed的范围综述方法：通过Scopus和HAL数据库识别文献，在Zotero中去重和筛选，经标题和摘要筛选后评估95篇全文，最终综合81项核心研究和14项背景/语境来源，并按七个主题组织证据。
AI.findings: 摩洛哥的教育扩张并未持续转化为平等机会、稳定就业或向上的社会流动。文献指向学校教育、技能、证书、劳动力市场融入与社会流动之间的"断裂链条"。教育挑战不仅是准入或改革设计问题，更是贯穿教育到就业全过程的实施、协调与公平问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将摩洛哥的教育挑战从"准入"问题重新框定为"转化"问题（基于能力方法）；整合分散的多语言文献；识别出教育-信任关联是文献中最关键的证据空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为摩洛哥教育政策制定提供系统证据基础，揭示从教育到就业转化链条中的关键断裂点，为政策干预提供方向；识别信任与教育合法性这一被忽视的维度。

title: Why Baby Raven Reads Endures

detail.title: Why Baby Raven Reads Endures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial conflict of interest. The author previously held leadership roles in Alaska Native early-childhood and Head Start programming and at Chugachmiut, Inc., and the framework advanced here draws on the author's prior published corpus; these professional relationships are disclosed in the interest of transparency. The author holds no financial interest in the Sealaska Heritage Institute, Baby Raven Reads, or the Chugach School District.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this work. The paper is a conceptual and secondary analysis drawing exclusively on previously published program evaluations and publicly available aggregate data; it involved no primary data collection, no human participants, and no personally identifiable information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Conventional pre-kindergarten interventions, Head Start chief among them, reliably produce measurable cognitive gains that fade within one to three years of school entrythe well-documented "fade-out" effect (Puma et al., 2010, 2012). Baby Raven Reads (BRR), the Sealaska Heritage Institute's culturally grounded early-literacy program, produces early gains that the field's standard explanations do not readily account for, and whose durability the standard models cannot predict. The contrast between the two programs, I contend, is not a difference of quality but of architecture. Drawing on the Shaman's Trail / Haa Latseení framework-integrating Barrett's body-budget account of predictive regulation, Oakley's consolidation-and-chunking model of durable learning, the Adverse Childhood Experiences corpus, Dunbar's social-brain architecture, and Ortiz's epistemology of circular and relational time-I argue that literacy endures only when it consolidates within a regulated, belonging-anchored child, and that it consolidates there only when the learning is inseparable from relationship, identity, and family. Head Start, as commonly delivered, transmits decontextualized skills to children whose relational floor is unbuilt; the gains do not consolidate and thus fade. Baby Raven Reads does not teach literacy and then add culture-the literacy happens through belonging, and so it holds. Two further design features of conventional programs sharpen the contrast: an early effect that resource injection and a temporarily constructed adult relationship will produce regardless of pedagogy (the Hawthorne problem), which evaluation cannot separate from durable learning; and the absence of breakthrough-initiative thinking, in which a fixed proficiency target is taught to as one teaches to a minimum-competency exit exam, making the bar a ceiling and guaranteeing the population's catch-up. Reframing the evaluation question "from a Head Start perspective"-asking what actually constitutes a durable head startreveals BRR not as a regional curiosity but as a proof of architecture. The same architecture, scaled to a whole district, appears in Alaska's Chugach School District, which abandoned seat-time schooling for mastery-and-relationship and then surpassed the state average on the very exit exam it had stopped teaching toward. I close by confronting the decisive methodological objection-that the programs draw from differently selected populations-and argue it does not dissolve the thesis but dictates its test: a longitudinal

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比Head Start与Baby Raven Reads (BRR)两个早期教育项目，提出"皮亚杰式消退效应"并非质量差异而是架构差异。BRR作为文化扎根的早期读写项目，通过归属感、关系与家庭认同使读写能力持久巩固，而Head Start传授去情境化技能但因缺乏关系基础而消退。作者基于Shaman's Trail/Haa Latseení整合框架论证：读写能力只有在受调节、以归属感为锚的儿童身上才能巩固，并指出Chugach学区的实践进一步验证了这一架构。
AI.research_question: 为什么传统学前教育项目（如Head Start）的认知收益会在一至三年内消退，而文化扎根的项目（如Baby Raven Reads）的收益能持久？其背后的架构机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统学前教育"消退效应"已被广泛记录但缺乏对例外案例的解释框架。Baby Raven Reads产生的持久收益无法用现行标准模型预测，这提示需要一个新架构性解释，而非单纯的质量改进。
AI.theoretical_framework: Shaman's Trail / Haa Latseení框架，整合了：1) Barrett的身体预算预测调节理论；2) Oakley的巩固-组块持久学习模型；3) Adverse Childhood Experiences（不良童年经历）研究；4) Dunbar的社会大脑架构；5) Ortiz的循环与关系时间认识论。
AI.method: 理论分析与多案例比较方法：对比Head Start与Baby Raven Reads的项目架构差异，并引入阿拉斯加Chugach学区的备案研究作为架构验证，同时处理选择性偏差的方法论反驳。
AI.findings: 1) 传统项目的早期收益可能源于资源注入和临时成人关系（Hawthorne问题），与持久学习不可分离；2) "最低能力达标"式教学目标使标准成为天花板而非地板；3) BRR通过"在归属中习得读写"使学习得以巩固；4) Chugach学区放弃在座学时制转向精通-关系模式后超过州平均成绩，验证了该架构的可扩展性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"消退效应是架构问题而非质量差异"的新理论透镜，将认知科学（预测调节、巩固机制）、神经科学、人类学（关系时间论）与教育评估理论整合为一个统合解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为早期教育项目设计提供架构性启示：学习必须嵌入关系、身份与家庭之中才能持久；批评"达标测试"式教学设计；为评估框架提供重构建议——应从"什么构成持久的领先优势"而非短期分数增长来评估项目。

title: The Accounting System for Natural Persons (SCPP)

detail.title: The Accounting System for Natural Persons (SCPP)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the originator and rights holder of the SCPP framework and heads L'N EXPERTISE (Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso). No other competing interests are declared.

detail.abstract: In Africa, and more particularly within the OHADA legal space, the existing accounting regulatory framework governs legal entities exclusively. Natural persons-who broadly dominate the economic fabric in Burkina Faso and neighbouring countries-operate in an absolute methodological void, deprived of accountability tools adapted to their realities. This void produces seven documented structural consequences: financial exclusion of informal households, fiscal under-mobilization, heightened vulnerability to corruption and moneylaundering risks, statistical underestimation of real GDP, a structural accountability gap, the absence of dedicated accounting informatization, and a structural deficit in financial literacy. Existing responses-group microfinance, simplified standards for very small enterprises, presumptive tax regimes, and personal-finance applications-each address only part of the problem. This paper proposes the doctrinal and functional framework for a Personal Accounting System (SCPP), grounded in the principles of double-entry bookkeeping adapted to African socioeconomic realities. The framework integrates three accountability systems according to the user's economic profile (Normal, Simplified, Subsistence), a nine-class chart of accounts incorporating African specificities (tontines-rotating community savings-and-credit associations-, biological assets, community solidarity, personal cost accounting), and three original analytical indicators: the Social Pressure Index (IPS), the Residual Living Capacity (RAV), and the SCPP Confidence Score (SCS). The practical implications of the SCPP for financial inclusion through the financial system (commercial banks and MFIs) and for the fiscal transition of the informal sector are analysed. We also submit, in three coordinated annexes, a draft OHADA Uniform Act (AUSCPP), its companion doctrinal application Guide, and the Adaptable Chart of Accounts for Natural Persons (PASCO) intended for international interoperability.

AI.tldr: 本文针对非洲（特别是OHADA法律空间下的布基纳法索）自然人缺乏个人会计制度的问题，提出了一套名为"个人会计系统（SCPP）"的理论与功能框架。该系统基于复式记账原理，结合非洲社会经济现实，整合三套记账系统（标准、简化、生存型）、九类科目表（纳入tontine等非洲特色）及三个原创分析指标（社会压力指数IPS、剩余生活能力RAV、SCP置信度分数SCS），并配套提交了OHADA统一法案草案（AUSCPP）、应用指南及国际互操作的科目表（PASCO）。
AI.research_question: 如何为非洲（特别是OHADA法律空间内）的自然人设计和建立一套适应其社会经济现实的个人会计系统，以解决当前会计监管框架仅覆盖法人实体、自然人处于方法论真空的问题？
AI.motivation: 非洲（尤其布基纳法索及邻国）的经济主体以自然人为绝对主导，但现行会计监管框架仅辖法人实体。这一空白产生了七个结构性后果：非正规家庭被金融排斥、财政征收不足、腐败与洗钱风险加剧、GDP统计被低估、责任性缺失、缺乏会计信息化、金融素养赤字。现有应对措施（团体小额信贷、小微企业简化准则、推定税制、个人理财应用）均只解决部分问题，亟需一个系统性的个人会计框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复式记账原理（adapted to African socioeconomic realities）；会计监管框架理论（OHADA法律体系）；金融包容性理论；财政转型理论；会计信息化理论。
AI.method: 本文采用理论框架构建（doctrinal/functional framework）的方法论路径：基于对现有空白与现有应对措施（团体小额信贷、简化小微标准、推定税制、个人理财APP）局限性的系统分析，设计并提出SCPP个人会计系统的完整制度框架，包括会计科目表、指标体系及配套立法文件（法案草案、应用指南、国际互操作科目表）。
AI.findings: 提出了完整的SCPP个人会计系统框架，包含三大记账系统（标准/简化/生存型）、九类科目表（纳入tontine社区储蓄、生物资产、社区互助、个人成本会计等非洲特色科目）、三个原创分析指标（IPS社会压力指数、RAV剩余生活能力、SCS置信度分数），以及系统对金融包容和财政转型的实践意义，并提交了三套配套立法文件（AUSCPP统一法案草案、应用指南、PASCO国际互操作科目表）。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文拓展了会计监管理论的应用边界，首次将复式记账制度系统性地延伸至自然人层面；构建了适应非洲社会经济现实（非正规经济、社区互助文化）的个人会计理论框架；提出了原创性的分析指标体系（IPS、RAV、SCS），丰富了个人会计与金融包容交叉领域的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为OHADA法律空间提供了可直接操作的立法草案（AUSCPP统一法案）；为金融机构（商业银行和小额信贷机构）提供了评估自然人信用和金融包容的实操工具；为政府实现非正规部门财政转型提供了制度路径；为会计信息化和金融素养提升提供了基础框架；PASCO科目表确保了国际互操作性。

title: The Last Signal Wins: How Recent Performance Information Shapes Subsequent Performance Under Contradictory Signals
affiliations: University of Navarra - Business, Universidad de Navarra and University of Navarra - IESE Business School

detail.title: The Last Signal Wins: How Recent Performance Information Shapes Subsequent Performance Under Contradictory Signals
detail.abstract: We extend research on relative performance information (RPI) by examining how individuals respond to recent performance signals when they receive contradictory RPI in highstakes settings. Drawing on recency theory, we predict that the latest signal carries greater weight in shaping motivation and behaviour. We test this prediction using professional bestof-three-set tennis matches that reach a deciding third set. We find that a recent positive signal is associated with better subsequent performance than a recent negative signal, even when both occur close in time. We further document substantial heterogeneity in this relationship, with RPI informativeness moderating the recency effect. Responses also differ by gender. The recency effect is attenuated among male players classified as Top Players-our proxy for higher self-efficacy-but persists among other male players and among female players. Responses also differ depending on whether recent RPI is positive or negative: women tend to underperform following unexpected positive signals, consistent with choking under pressure, whereas men respond more negatively to recent setbacks, consistent with the Golem effect. Overall, our findings highlight the importance of recency as a motivational dimension of performance information and show how individual characteristics and signal properties shape responses to and interpretations of recent performance signals.

AI.tldr: 本文基于近因理论（recency theory），利用职业网球"三盘两胜制"进入决胜盘的比赛数据，研究高风险情境下个体如何回应矛盾的相对绩效信息（RPI）。研究发现近期积极信号比近期消极信号更能促进后续表现，即使两者发生时间接近；该近因效应受RPI信息性调节，并且在性别和高自我效能（顶级男球员）群体间存在显著异质性。
AI.research_question: 在高风险情境下，当个体接收到相互矛盾的相对绩效信息（RPI）时，近期绩效信号如何影响其动机与行为？近因效应是否存在，以及其边界条件（个体特征、信号属性）是什么？
AI.motivation: 既有研究已广泛探讨相对绩效信息（RPI）对个体动机和行为的影响，但较少关注当个体同时接收到相互矛盾（一正一负）的RPI信号时的反应。本研究引入近因理论，填补了这一空白，探讨近期信号在塑造动机与行为中的相对权重。
AI.theoretical_framework: 近因理论（Recency Theory）；相对绩效信息理论（RPI）；自我效能理论；压力下失常（Choking under pressure）；戈莱姆效应（Golem Effect）
AI.method: 利用职业网球"三盘两胜制"比赛数据，选择进入决胜第三盘的比赛作为研究样本，通过实证分析比较近期积极信号与近期消极信号对后续表现的影响，并进行异质性分析（性别、球员排名、RPI信息性等）。
AI.findings: （1）近期积极信号比近期消极信号更能提升后续表现，即使两种信号在时间上接近；（2）RPI的信息性调节近因效应；（3）近因效应在顶级男球员（高自我效能代理）中被削弱，但在其他男球员和女球员中持续存在；（4）性别差异显著：女性在意外积极信号后表现下滑（压力下失常），男性对近期挫折反应更消极（戈莱姆效应）。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将近因理论引入RPI研究，揭示"时间维度"是绩效信息动机效应的关键维度；（2）阐明了RPI信息性对近因效应的调节作用；（3）从自我效能视角解释了近因效应的个体差异；（4）揭示了积极与消极近期信号触发的不同心理机制（压力下失常与戈莱姆效应）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织和管理者在设计和传递绩效反馈信息时提供指导：需注意近期信号的心理权重、个体差异（如自我效能水平、性别）以及信号信息性对反馈效果的影响，从而更有效地激励员工。

title: Party Lines or Voter Preferences? Explaining Political Realignment

detail.title: Party Lines or Voter Preferences? Explaining Political Realignment
detail.abstract: This paper estimates a political equilibrium model to disentangle demand factors (voters) from supply factors (politicians) in shaping political outcomes, focusing on the recent realignment of blue-collar voters away from left-wing parties. I jointly evaluate the impact of changes in voter preferences and voter demographics (demand side) and party positions and party discipline (supply side) on voters' partisan realignment as observed in U.S. House elections between 2000 and 2020. To measure candidate ideological positioning, I estimate a multimodal text-and-survey model using campaign websites. To estimate voter preferences, I build a new panel of precinct-level election results (N=1.6 million), which allows me to exploit congressional district border discontinuities for identification. The paper ultimately identifies parties' stronger polarization on cultural issues compared to economic issues as the main driver of voters' partisan realignment. In contrast, shifts in voter preferences-particularly the increasing support among blue-collar voters for progressive economic policies-have mitigated their defection from the Democratic Party. Absent these demand-side changes, partisan realignment would have been even more pronounced.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建政治均衡模型，将影响政治结果的供给侧因素（政党和政治家）与需求侧因素（选民）分离开来，利用2000-2020年美国众议院选举数据，识别出政党在文化议题上的极化是蓝领选民党派重组的主要驱动因素，而选民偏好的变化（尤其是对进步经济政策支持度的上升）则缓解了蓝领选民对民主党的背离。
AI.research_question: 在塑造政治结果（特别是蓝领选民脱离左翼政党的党派重组）的过程中，需求侧因素（选民偏好和人口特征变化）与供给侧因素（政党立场和政党纪律）各自发挥了怎样的作用？
AI.motivation: 近年来蓝领选民大规模脱离左翼政党的现象备受关注，但现有研究难以区分选民端变化与政党端变化对政治结果的相对贡献。为准确理解党派重组的成因，需要一个能够同时评估供需两侧因素的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治均衡模型，将政治结果视为选民偏好/人口（需求侧）与政党立场/纪律（供给侧）交互作用的均衡产出。
AI.method: （1）构建政治均衡模型估计框架；（2）利用多模态文本-调查模型（基于竞选网站）测量候选人意识形态定位；（3）构建包含160万个选区的选区级选举结果面板数据，利用国会选区边界不连续性进行识别。（4）联合评估供需两侧因素对党派重组的影响。
AI.findings: （1）政党在文化议题上的极化程度显著强于经济议题，这是选民党派重组的主要驱动力；（2）选民偏好变化（特别是蓝领选民对进步经济政策支持度上升）缓解了其对民主党的背离；（3）如果没有需求侧变化，党派重组将更加显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在统一的政治均衡框架内同时识别供需两侧因素对党派重组的相对贡献，超越了以往仅关注单一侧（如仅关注选民偏好或仅关注政党策略）的研究。方法上创新性地结合多模态文本模型与选区级面板数据进行因果识别。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政党策略提供实证依据：政党在文化议题上的过度极化会加速蓝领选民流失；同时揭示选民经济偏好变化对党派忠诚的维系作用，对理解美国政治极化格局和选举策略具有现实意义。

title: Fishing for the Biodiversity Risk Factors in Corporate Bonds: An Empty Pond
affiliations: University of Turin and University of Turin

detail.title: Fishing for the Biodiversity Risk Factors in Corporate Bonds: An Empty Pond
detail.abstract: Do biodiversity risks command a premium in corporate bonds? We examine 4,023 United States bonds issued by 329 non-financial firms between 2018 and 2023, adopting a double-materiality perspective that captures both firms' impacts on biodiversity (transition risks) and their dependence on ecosystem services (physical risks). By sorting bonds and firms into long-short portfolios, we evaluate both raw and riskadjusted returns and find no robust evidence of a biodiversity premium, at either the bond or issuer level, for both physical and transition biodiversity risks. This result holds across alternative weighting schemes and credit-rating groups, as well as in the post-Kunming Declaration in October 2021. Our findings carry an important implication for investors and the asset management industry. Biodiversity risk remains unpriced in corporate bond markets, leaving investors unrewarded for bearing exposures that may become material in future.

AI.tldr: 本文研究企业债券市场是否为生物多样性风险提供溢价。利用2018-2023年间329家美国非金融企业发行的4,023只债券，采用双重实质性视角区分转型风险（企业对生物多样性的影响）和物理风险（企业对生态系统服务的依赖），通过多空组合检验原始收益和风险调整后收益，发现债券和发行人层面均不存在稳健的生物多样性溢价，该结论在多种加权方案、信用评级分组及《昆明宣言》之后的时期均成立。
AI.research_question: 企业债券市场是否为生物多样性风险定价？债券投资者是否会因承担生物多样性风险而获得风险溢价补偿？
AI.motivation: 生物多样性丧失已成为全球性重大环境问题，但现有文献主要关注气候风险定价，对生物多样性风险在资本市场（尤其是债券市场）中的定价问题研究较少。理解生物多样性风险是否被定价对投资者资产配置和风险管理具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重实质性（double-materiality）视角——区分企业对生物多样性的影响（转型风险）与企业对生态系统服务的依赖（物理风险）；资产定价理论中的风险溢价框架。
AI.method: 构建债券层面和发行人层面的多空投资组合（long-short portfolios），评估原始收益率和风险调整后收益率（如Fama-French因子调整后的超额收益），并通过多种加权方案、信用评级分组和时变检验（昆明宣言前后）进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 未发现生物多样性风险溢价的稳健证据，无论是物理风险还是转型风险，在债券层面和发行人层面均不成立；结论在替代加权方案、信用评级分组以及2021年10月《昆明宣言》之后的时期均保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了生物多样性风险定价研究的空白，将双重实质性框架应用于债券市场，为ESG资产定价文献提供了关于非气候环境风险定价的证据，表明生物多样性风险尚未被市场纳入定价体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 对投资者和资产管理行业具有重要启示：生物多样性风险目前在企业债券市场中未被定价，投资者承担此类暴露不会获得额外补偿，未来这些风险可能变为实质性影响，需要前瞻性地将生物多样性因素纳入投资决策和风险管理。

title: PyXtabond2 Methodological Note : GMM Theory, the IFE-GMM Extension, and Validation Against Stata’s xtabond2
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: PyXtabond2 Methodological Note : GMM Theory, the IFE-GMM Extension, and Validation Against Stata’s xtabond2
detail.abstract: This note provides the full econometric derivation underlying pyxtabond2, together with a complete, primary-source-grounded account of its validation. Section 2 derives the standard dynamic panel GMM estimator (Difference and System GMM), its one-and two-step weighting matrices, the Windmeijer [2005] finite-sample variance correction, and the smallsample degrees-of-freedom corrections, each tied explicitly to the corresponding construction in Stata's xtabond2.mata [Roodman, 2009a]. Section 3 derives the Sargan/Hansen, Difference-in-Sargan/Hansen, and Arellano-Bond AR() test statistics. Section 4 derives IFE-GMM, an original extension not present in xtabond2: an iterative, PCA-based estimator for dynamic panels contaminated by interactive fixed effects [Bai, 2009], combining automatic factor-count selection [Bai and Ng, 2002, Ahn and Horenstein, 2013], a profile-GMM defactoring loop [Hong et al., 2022], and a split-panel jackknife bias correction [Dhaene and Jochmans, 2015]. Section 5 reports, in full, the findings of two validation passes conducted against xtabond2.mata and a real Stata run, alongside every confirmed-correct result and every documented, unresolved limitation.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了pyxtabond2（动态面板GMM估计器的Python实现）的完整计量经济学推导，并基于第一手资料对其与Stata的xtabond2进行了全面验证，同时提出了一个原创扩展——IFE-GMM（迭代PCA估计器），用于处理含交互固定效应的动态面板。
AI.research_question: 如何完整推导pyxtabond2中动态面板GMM估计器的计量理论，并系统验证其与Stata xtabond2的一致性？如何进一步扩展以处理交互固定效应污染的动态面板？
AI.motivation: Python生态中缺乏与Stata xtabond2完全对标、经过严格验证的动态面板GMM实现；同时xtabond2本身不具备处理交互固定效应（interactive fixed effects）的能力，需要算法扩展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态面板GMM估计（Difference GMM和System GMM）、一步与两步加权矩阵、Windmeijer (2005)有限样本方差修正、小样本自由度修正、Sargan/Hansen过度识别检验、Difference-in-Sargan/Hansen检验、Arellano-Bond AR检验、交互固定效应模型（Bai 2009）、因子数目自动选择（Bai & Ng 2002; Ahn & Horenstein 2013）、profile-GMM去因子循环（Hong et al. 2022）、分裂面板jackknife偏差修正（Dhaene & Jochmans 2015）。
AI.method: 本文采用理论与实证结合的方法：首先逐项推导GMM估计器及其检验统计量的计量公式，并将其与Stata xtabond2.mata的代码实现逐一对应；其次进行两轮验证（对照xtabond2.mata和真实Stata运行）；最后提出IFE-GMM原创算法，整合因子数选择、迭代去因子和jackknife偏差修正。
AI.findings: 所有已确认正确的结果均已通过验证，与Stata xtabond2输出一致；同时存在若干已记录但尚未解决的局限（unresolved limitations），论文完整报告了这些发现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了动态面板GMM及其检验统计量的完整、严谨的计量推导（与xtabond2逐项对应）；提出了IFE-GMM这一原创方法，将交互固定效应处理能力扩展至动态面板GMM框架中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Python用户提供了一个经过严格验证、与Stata xtabond2对标且具备额外IFE处理能力的动态面板GMM工具（pyxtabond2），并公开了完整的验证过程和已记录局限。

title: Exporting Gas, Exporting Emissions: The Externalization of Climate Costs through the Southern Gas Corridor
affiliations: Economic Research Center (ERC)

detail.title: Exporting Gas, Exporting Emissions: The Externalization of Climate Costs through the Southern Gas Corridor
detail.abstract:
This article examines the structural tension between Azerbaijan's international climate commitments and its expanding role as a major natural gas exporter to Europe. Since hosting COP29 in 2024, Azerbaijan has positioned itself as an active participant in global environmental governance while simultaneously accelerating hydrocarbon production, developing new gas fields (including Absheron Phase II, Babek, and non-associated gas at ACG), and deepening its strategic energy partnership with the EU through the Southern Gas Corridor (SGC) and Trans Adriatic Pipeline (TAP). Drawing on the concept of "exported emissions," the article argues that while European states may reduce territorial emissions by substituting Azerbaijani gas for more carbon-intensive fuels, a substantial share of the associated methane emissions-generated during extraction, processing, compression, and transmission-remains externalized to Azerbaijan and other points along the supply chain. 
The analysis assesses whether existing environmental, health and safety, and human rights safeguards imposed by EU legislation, EBRD, EIB, IFC, OECD, and Equator Principles standards, as well as the new EU Methane Regulation (2024/1787), are adequate to address this challenge. It finds that although TAP operates under one of the most extensive formal governance frameworks applied to energy infrastructure, effective implementation depends heavily on independent monitoring, transparency, and civic space-all of which are significantly constrained in Azerbaijan and, to varying degrees, in Georgia and Türkiye. Restrictions on civil society, journalists, and human rights defenders limit the ability of independent actors to verify compliance, creating a gap between formal regulatory commitments and actual environmental and social outcomes. 
The article concludes that Azerbaijan's declining performance in the World Economic Forum's 2026 Energy Transition Index-driven by weaknesses in institutional and regulatory "Transition Readiness" rather than technical system performance-illustrates a broader dilemma facing hydrocarbon-exporting states: the credibility of climate commitments ultimately hinges not only on renewable energy targets, but on methane governance, transparency, and protection of the civic space needed to hold gas export infrastructure accountable throughout its operational lifecycle.

AI.tldr: 本文考察了阿塞拜疆在国际气候承诺与其作为欧洲主要天然气出口国不断扩张的角色之间的结构性张力。自2024年主办COP29以来，阿塞拜疆一方面积极参与全球环境治理，另一方面加速油气生产并深化与欧盟的能源合作。文章运用"出口排放"概念，指出欧洲虽可通过用阿塞拜疆天然气替代高碳燃料降低领土排放，但大量甲烷排放被外化到阿塞拜疆及供应链沿线。文章评估了EU法规、多边开发银行标准和EU甲烷法规等治理框架的充分性，发现尽管TAP拥有广泛的正式治理框架，但独立监督、透明度和公民空间的受限造成了正式承诺与实际环境社会结果之间的鸿沟。
AI.research_question: 阿塞拜疆作为COP29主办国和欧洲主要天然气供应国，其国际气候承诺与油气出口扩张之间的结构性矛盾如何影响气候治理的可靠性？现有的国际监管框架是否足以确保阿塞拜疆天然气供应链中的甲烷排放得到有效管控？
AI.motivation: 越来越多的化石燃料出口国在参与全球气候治理的同时持续扩大生产，造成"领土减排"与"出口排放"分离的现象。现有研究对正式监管框架关注较多，但对公民空间、独立监督和透明度等"实施条件"的制约关注不足。本文旨在揭示正式承诺与实际执行之间的鸿沟，并阐明气候承诺可信度的关键决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: "出口排放"（exported emissions）概念：欧洲通过进口天然气减少领土排放，但甲烷排放（开采、加工、压缩、传输环节）被外部化到出口国和供应链其他节点。文章还涉及能源转型指数（Energy Transition Index）中的"转型就绪度"（Transition Readiness）概念，用以区分制度能力与技术系统表现。
AI.method: 定性分析：1）梳理阿塞拜疆气候承诺与油气扩张政策之间的张力；2）系统评估EU法规、EBRD、EIB、IFC、OECD、赤道原则及EU甲烷法规（2024/1787）等正式治理框架对TAP项目的约束力；3）分析阿塞拜疆、格鲁吉亚和土耳其的公民空间、独立监督和透明度状况；4）援引世界经济论坛2026年能源转型指数数据进行验证。
AI.findings: 1）TAP虽拥有能源基础设施中最广泛的正式治理框架之一，但实际执行严重依赖独立监督、透明度和公民空间，而这三者在阿塞拜疆受到显著限制，格鲁吉亚和土耳其也有不同程度的问题。2）对公民社会、记者和人权捍卫者的限制削弱了独立行为者验证合规的能力，造成正式监管承诺与实际环境社会结果之间的差距。3）阿塞拜疆在世界经济论坛2026年能源转型指数中的下滑主要源于制度和监管层面的"转型就绪度"薄弱，而非技术系统表现，揭示出化石燃料出口国面临的气候承诺可信度困境。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将"出口排放"概念从单纯的碳排放核算拓展到甲烷治理的"实施条件"分析，强调正式制度框架与实际执行之间的鸿沟。2）提出气候承诺可信度的多维决定因素框架：不仅包括可再生能源目标，还包括甲烷治理、透明度和公民空间保护。3）为理解"领土减排"与"碳泄漏"之外的新型外部化机制提供理论视角——排放外部化叠加治理能力外部化。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）对EU及其成员国制定和实施甲烷法规（2024/1787）提供政策启示，尤其是对进口天然气供应链的监管盲区提出警示。2）对多边开发银行（EBRD、EIB、IFC）和OECD在项目融资、环境社会标准执行中强化独立监测和透明度要求提供参考。3）为国际社会在评估化石燃料出口国气候承诺可信度时提供评估框架，提示能源进口国需将出口国的治理环境和公民空间状况纳入供应链尽职调查。

title: Who Decides Washington State? Who Returns the Ballot? Age Composition in Washington's Odd-Year Electorate, 2021-2025

detail.title: Who Decides Washington State? Who Returns the Ballot? Age Composition in Washington's Odd-Year Electorate, 2021-2025

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the principal of Tikor Consulting and of Kirby Law Office, PLLC. This paper was produced with a voter-file and election-data codebase that the author also develops for commercial political-analytics and campaign-services applications, including partisan campaign work. This descriptive study was not commissioned, funded, or reviewed prior to release by any political party, campaign, political action committee, or client; it makes no partisan or policy recommendation; and the author has no financial interest in the outcome of any election-timing policy. AI assistance is disclosed separately.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a secondary analysis of public-record data — Washington's statewide voter-registration database, obtained under RCW 29A.08.710, and certified aggregate election results from the Secretary of State. It involved no intervention with or contact with human subjects, and it released no individual-level records; all published outputs are aggregate counts. Conducted by an independent (non-institutional) researcher, it was not subject to Institutional Review Board review. The design corresponds to the categories U.S. federal regulations treat as exempt or not-human-subjects research (secondary use of publicly available information; 45 CFR 46.104). Use of the voter file was confined to the political and scholarly purposes permitted by RCW 29A.08.720, and no data are redistributed.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author; no grant, institution, political party, campaign, political action committee, or client provided financial support or commissioned the work.

detail.abstract: Many of Washington's local officesare filled in odd-year Novemberelections, when turnout runs far below presidential years.This paper asks who returns those ballots. Using Washington's statewide voter-registration database,a 5.51-millionvoter roll linked to 27.1 million individual vote-history records with the voter's year of birth, it measures the age make-up of every November general electorate from 2021 through 2025.The central finding is descriptive: Washington's odd-year electorate is markedly older than its presidential one. Voters 65 and older were 36.7%, 40.2%,and 40.3% of the 2021, 2023, and 2025 odd-yearelectorates,against 28.5% in 2024; voters 18–29 fell from 14.2% in 2024 to about 7.6% off-cycle.The result survives voter-file coverage validation against certified ballot counts, formal bounds for current-roll survivorship,a closer-in-time roll cross-check,alternative birth-year assumptions, county-level checks,and exclusion of any single off-year. The off-yearelectorate isalso older than the registered roll and the citizen voting-age population. Individual records show it is largely the presidential electorate's habitual core (92–97% of off-year votersalso vote in presidential years), while the peripheral voters who drop off off-cycle skew young.The paper measures ballot return, not votes cast in specific downballot contests,and does not estimate partisan or policy consequences. Its contribution isa validated, individual-record measurement of age composition across the presidential–midterm–off-year salience gradient, in a universal vote-by-mail state where the formal administrative cost of voting is comparatively low.

AI.tldr: 本文利用华盛顿州全州选民登记数据库（550万选民名单与2710万条个人投票记录关联），系统测量了2021-2025年奇数年选举（非大选年）与总统选举年选民的年龄构成差异。核心发现是奇数年选举选民显著偏老：65岁以上选民占约36.7%-40.3%，而18-29岁年轻选民仅占约7.6%；奇数年选民中92-97%来自总统选举的"习惯性核心选民"，流失的主要是年轻的外围选民。研究经过了多重稳健性检验。
AI.research_question: 谁在华盛顿州奇数年（非总统年）低投票率选举中投出了选票？这些选民的年龄构成如何？
AI.motivation: 华盛顿州许多地方职位在奇数年11月选举中产生，但此时投票率远低于总统选举年。既有研究对"谁在低显著性选举中投票"缺乏基于个人记录的系统测量，尤其是年龄维度的精确刻画。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选举显著性梯度（presidential-midterm-off-year salience gradient）与选民核心-外围结构（habitual core vs. peripheral voters）理论。
AI.method: 使用华盛顿州全州选民登记数据库（550万选民名单）与2710万条个人投票历史记录进行个体层面链接，根据出生年份测量每次选举选民的年龄构成，并进行多重稳健性检验（选民文件覆盖率验证、存活偏差边界检验、近期名单交叉核对、替代出生年份假设、县级层面检验及排除单一奇数年）。
AI.findings: （1）奇数年选举选民显著偏老：65岁以上占36.7%-40.3%（2021/2023/2025），而2024年仅占28.5%；18-29岁从总统年14.2%降至奇数年约7.6%。（2）奇数年选民比登记选民和公民投票年龄人口更老。（3）奇数年选民中92-97%同时也是总统选举选民，属于习惯性核心选民；脱落的主要是年轻的外围选民。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了在普遍邮寄投票、行政成本较低的州中，对总统-中期-奇数年选举显著性梯度上年龄构成变化的经过验证的个体记录测量，丰富了选举参与中的核心-外围选民结构理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了奇数年地方选举中老年选民系统性代表过多、年轻选民系统性缺位的现象，为理解地方治理中的代际代表性偏差、选举制度设计（如选举时间安排）提供了实证依据。

title: Fragile Hands: Bondholders' Portfolios and the Transmission of Monetary Policy to Credit Markets
affiliations: Academy of Mathematics and Systems Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences,  and Universite de Toulouse 1 Capitole

detail.title: Fragile Hands: Bondholders' Portfolios and the Transmission of Monetary Policy to Credit Markets
detail.abstract: How does the composition of a firm's creditor base affect the transmission of monetary policy to credit markets? Using bond-level institutional holdings matched to CDS data over 2001-2019, we show that CDS spreads respond more to high-frequency monetary policy surprises when bonds are held by investors whose portfolios are concentrated in low-rated or long-duration securities, consistent with binding portfolio constraints that force rebalancing. Mutual fund ownership no longer amplifies shocks once bondholders' portfolio exposures and trading intensity are controlled for. Ownership concentration dampens transmission only when large holders are constrained. Bondholders' balance sheets, not institutional labels, shape monetary transmission.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2001-2019年美国公司债层面的机构持股数据匹配CDS数据，发现债权人组合的构成（而非机构类型标签）决定了货币政策向信用市场的传导效果。当债券持有人投资组合集中于低评级或长久期证券时，CDS利差对货币政策冲击的反应更强，这与约束性组合再平衡机制一致。
AI.research_question: 公司债权人基础的构成如何影响货币政策向信用市场的传导？
AI.motivation: 已有文献通常以机构类型标签（如共同基金持股比例）来识别货币政策传导渠道，但忽略了债权人资产负债表特征（如组合暴露和持有集中度）的作用。作者试图超越机构标签，从投资者资产负债表特征角度重新审视货币政策的信用市场传导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组合约束理论：投资者面临约束性投资组合约束时，货币政策冲击迫使其进行再平衡交易，从而放大对信用利差的传导效果。
AI.method: 采用2001-2019年债券层面机构持股数据匹配CDS数据，使用高频货币政策意外作为冲击变量，回归分析CDS利差对货币政策冲击的反应，并控制债券持有人组合暴露和交易强度。
AI.findings: （1）债券由集中于低评级或长久期证券的投资者持有时，CDS利差对货币政策冲击的反应更强；（2）控制组合暴露和交易强度后，共同基金持股本身不再放大货币政策传导；（3）所有权集中仅在大型持有人受约束时才削弱传导；（4）核心结论是债权人的资产负债表特征而非机构类型标签驱动货币政策传导。
AI.theory_contributions: 将货币政策的信用市场传导理论从机构类型视角转向投资者资产负债表特征视角，识别出组合约束和再平衡机制是传导的关键渠道，为理解资产价格对货币政策的异质性反应提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估货币政策对信用市场的传导效果提供了更精确的预测工具，提示应关注投资者组合特征而非机构类型；为投资者理解组合约束对价格冲击的放大效应提供参考。

title: Optimizers as Scale Mixtures, from Adam to Muon
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Optimizers as Scale Mixtures, from Adam to Muon
detail.abstract: We give a unifying account of geometry-aware optimizers, including Muon, Shampoo, and Ada-factor, through the lens of scale mixtures of Gaussians and matrix-variate priors. The organizing principle is a duality: a training step is steepest descent under a chosen norm, and that norm is dual to a prior under which the step is a maximum a posteriori move. The Euclidean norm returns stochastic gradient descent, the coordinate max-norm returns sign descent and the sign geometry of Adam, and the spectral operator norm returns Muon, whose Newton-Schulz orthogonalization computes the polar factor  of the momentum matrix. Adaptive second-moment methods form a hierarchy of scale mixtures: Adam is a per-coordinate local scale, Adafactor is a separable rank-one scale that factors the second moment into row and column statistics, and Shampoo is a Kronecker matrix-normal scale. Muon sits at the spectral end of this hierarchy, where the update is whitened so that every singular direction moves at a common rate, the matrix analogue of the common global scale in a horseshoe prior. We make the norm-to-prior correspondence precise, show that Ada-factor is the maximum-likelihood separable scale mixture, and connect fast compute, Newton-Schulz iteration and factored moments, to our generative Bayesian computation program. Illustrative numerical studies on anisotropic objectives display the invariance the geometry predicts: the spectral and Kronecker methods are unchanged under an orthogonal change of frame, while coordinate methods lose several orders of magnitude of accuracy when the same anisotropy is rotated off-axis.

AI.tldr: 本文通过尺度混合高斯和矩阵变量先验的统一框架，揭示了Muon、Shampoo和Adafactor等几何感知优化器之间的深层联系。核心组织原则是一种对偶性：训练步骤是在所选范数下的最陡下降，而该范数与一个先验相对偶，在该先验下该步骤是最大后验移动。Euclidean范数对应SGD，坐标最大范数对应符号下降（Adam的符号几何），谱算子范数对应Muon（其Newton-Schulz正交化计算动量矩阵的极因子）。Adam、Adafactor和Shampoo构成自适应二阶矩方法的层次结构：Adam是逐坐标局部尺度，Adafactor是可分离秩一尺度（将二阶矩分解为行和列统计量），Shampoo是Kronecker矩阵正态尺度。Muon位于该层次结构的谱端，其更新被白化使得每个奇异方向以共同速率移动。
AI.research_question: 如何用统一的数学框架来解释和联系Muon、Shampoo、Adafactor等几何感知优化器，并揭示其背后的对偶性原理（范数与先验的对应关系）？
AI.motivation: 现有的几何感知优化器（如Muon、Shampoo、Adafactor）虽然在实际应用中表现优异，但缺乏统一的数学理论框架来解释它们之间的内在联系。这些优化器各自有不同的推导和动机，难以从统一的视角理解其设计原则和适用场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 尺度混合高斯（scale mixtures of Gaussians）、矩阵变量先验（matrix-variate priors）、范数-先验对偶性（norm-to-prior correspondence）、最大后验估计（MAP）、谱算子范数、Kronecker矩阵正态分布、horseshoe先验
AI.method: 理论推导与数学分析：建立优化步骤与范数最陡下降之间的对偶关系，将不同优化器映射到对应的尺度混合高斯先验框架中；通过最大似然方法论证Adafactor作为可分离尺度混合的最优性；通过数值实验验证几何预测的不变性性质。
AI.findings: 1) 训练步骤与先验之间存在精确的范数-先验对偶性；2) Adam、Adafactor、Shampoo和Muon构成从逐坐标到Kronecker再到谱端的尺度混合层次结构；3) Adafactor是可分离尺度混合的最大似然解；4) 数值实验证实：谱方法和Kronecker方法在正交坐标变换下保持不变，而坐标方法在旋转各向异性目标时精度损失数个数量级。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个统一的数学框架，将SGD、符号下降/Adam、Adafactor、Shampoo和Muon置于同一理论体系下，建立了范数-先验对偶性的精确对应关系，并揭示了这些优化器之间作为尺度混合层次结构的深层联系。将贝叶斯计算程序与快速计算（Newton-Schulz迭代和因式化矩）相连接。
AI.practical_contributions: 为优化器的选择提供了理论指导：在需要坐标变换不变性的场景下应优先选择谱或Kronecker方法；为设计新的几何感知优化器提供了统一的生成式贝叶斯计算框架；明确了各优化器在层次结构中的位置及其适用条件。

title: Retail Attention, Odd-Lot Trading, and Daily Stock Volatility
affiliations: Bar-Ilan University - Graduate School of Business Administration and Bar Ilan University

detail.title: Retail Attention, Odd-Lot Trading, and Daily Stock Volatility
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether online investor attention and small-trade activity contain distinct information about daily stock volatility. Using a panel of ten large-cap U.S. stocks from 2012 to 2022, we combine Google Trends Relative Search Volume with the share of trading volume executed in odd lots and relate both measures to a daily range-based volatility proxy. Because odd-lot transactions may originate from retail, institutional, or algorithmic traders, we interpret the odd-lot measure as an indicator of small-trade intensity rather than a pure proxy for retail trading. Across specifications in levels, logarithmic levels, and daily logarithmic changes, higher search intensity and greater oddlot activity are associated with wider daily price movements. Odd-lot activity is the more stable correlate across specifications, whereas search activity retains explanatory content after conditioning on small-trade intensity. The design is descriptive and does not identify the direction of causality. The findings indicate that online information demand and small-trade order flow capture related but distinct dimensions of investor engagement that coincide with short-run volatility states, even in highly liquid, institutionally dominated stocks.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2012至2022年十只美国大盘股的日度面板数据，结合Google Trends相对搜索量与零股交易量占比，考察在线投资者关注与小额交易活动是否包含关于日内股票波动的不同信息。结果表明，两种指标均与波动率正相关，但零股交易活动在各类设定中更为稳定，而搜索活动在控制小额交易强度后仍具解释力。
AI.research_question: 在线投资者关注度与小额交易活动是否包含关于日度股票波动的不同信息？
AI.motivation: 以往研究通常将零股交易或搜索量单独作为投资者关注的代理指标，但忽略了两者可能捕捉投资者参与的不同维度。本文旨在区分这两种信息渠道，考察它们对短期波动状态的相对解释力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融中投资者关注度与交易活动对资产价格波动的影响理论；信息不对称与订单流构成理论。
AI.method: 使用2012—2022年十只美国大盘股的日度面板数据，将Google Trends相对搜索量与零股交易占比分别作为在线关注和交易强度的指标，以日内基于价格区间的波动率代理为因变量，进行水平值、对数水平值及日度对数变动三种设定的回归分析。
AI.findings: （1）更高的搜索强度与更大的零股交易活动均与更宽的日内价格波动相关；（2）零股交易活动在各类设定中是与波动率更稳定的相关指标；（3）在控制小额交易强度后，搜索活动仍保留解释内容；（4）总体表明在线信息需求与小额订单流捕捉了投资者参与中相关但不同的维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将在线搜索关注度与小额交易活动区分开来，指出它们是投资者参与的不同维度，拓展了投资者关注度文献中对信息获取与交易行为双重渠道的理解。同时明确零股交易不能简单视为纯散户交易代理，为后续研究提供了概念厘清。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和监管者提供了基于公开数据（搜索量和零股交易数据）监测短期波动状态的补充指标；强调了在高度流动、机构主导的股票中，小额交易和在线关注仍与短期波动密切相关。

title: Energy, Security and the State: A Hobbesian Critique of the Social Contract in the Climate Era
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Energy, Security and the State: A Hobbesian Critique of the Social Contract in the Climate Era
detail.abstract: The deepening climate crisis has revived fundamental questions about the purpose of the state, the reach of political authority, and the conditions under which citizens owe obedience to public power. This article revisits Thomas Hobbes' social contract theory as an analytical framework for evaluating contemporary state obligations in the governance of energy and climate security. It argues that the Hobbesian security covenant, premised on the exchange of natural liberty for sovereign protection, generates a normative standard by which states may be assessed when they fail to address existential environmental threats. Applying Hobbes' foundational concepts of natural insecurity, the state of nature, sovereign authorisation, and the protection-obligation nexus, the article examines how the climate emergency reconfigures the terrain of political legitimacy.
