However, most existing approaches operate on a single decoding trajectory, limiting their ability to explore alternative reasoning paths and making them susceptible to error accumulation. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Path-Contrastive Decoding (APCD), an adaptive multi-path contrastive decoding framework that improves factual reliability without model retraining or fine-tuning. APCD comprises two key components: Entropy-Driven Path Expansion, which adaptively expands the decoding process only at high-uncertainty decision points, and Divergence-Aware Path Contrast, which dynamically regulates contrastive interactions among parallel decoding paths based on their distributional divergence to balance diversity and coherence. We evaluate APCD on four LLM backbones across eight benchmarks spanning both general-domain and medical question answering tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that APCD consistently outperforms strong inference-time baselines in factual accuracy while maintaining competitive inference efficiency. These results demonstrate the robustness and generalizability of APCD across diverse models and tasks, highlighting its effectiveness as a practical inference-time decoding framework for reliable LLM deployment, particularly in high-stakes domains such as medicine. Code is available at https://github.com/zty-king/APCD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应路径对比解码（APCD）框架，通过熵驱动的路径扩展和散度感知的路径对比，在不重新训练模型的情况下提升大语言模型的事实可靠性，在四个LLM骨干和八个基准上优于强推理时基线。
AI.research_question: 如何在不进行模型重训练或微调的情况下，通过多路径对比解码提升大语言模型在医学等高风脸领域的事实生成可靠性？
AI.motivation: 现有推理时方法（logit级和表示级）大多在单一解码轨迹上操作，限制了探索替代推理路径的能力，容易产生错误累积；高风脸领域（如医学）对文本生成的事实可靠性要求极高。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对比解码理论、熵驱动的自适应解码机制、分布散度度量（如KL散度）在解码路径动态调节中的应用。
AI.method: 提出APCD框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 熵驱动路径扩展——仅在不确定性高的决策点自适应地扩展解码路径；(2) 散度感知路径对比——根据各并行解码路径的分布散度动态调节对比交互，平衡多样性与一致性。在四个LLM骨干和八个基准（涵盖通用领域和医学问答）上进行评估。
AI.findings: APCD在事实准确率上持续优于强推理时基线方法，同时保持有竞争力的推理效率；在多种模型和任务上展现出鲁棒性和泛化性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种自适应多路径对比解码框架，将熵驱动路径扩展与散度感知路径对比相结合，克服了单一解码轨迹的局限，为推理时事实可靠性提升提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种无需重训练或微调即可部署的推理时解码框架，适用于医学等高风脸领域的LLM实际部署；提供了开源代码便于社区使用和复现。

title: Identifying Fairness with No Envy: an Axiomatization
affiliations: University of Vienna - Department of Economics

detail.title: Identifying Fairness with No Envy: an Axiomatization
detail.abstract: Envy-freeness is arguably the most popular fairness principle for evaluating an allocation of goods to individuals. A given allocation is envy-free if no individual strictly prefers the bundle given to someone else. We present the first axiomatization of this principle. The desire for no envy emerges from our axioms even though none of them have the goal to avoid any kind of individual discontent with bundles being allocated to others. Through the lens of our axioms, a very basic behavioral trait (envy) emerges formally as being the obstacle to achieving fairness.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对"无嫉妒"（Envy-freeness）这一公平分配原则进行了公理化。作者提出的公理系统中没有任何一条公理直接以"避免对他人所得产生不满"为目标，然而这些公理共同推导出无嫉妒原则，从而从形式上揭示了嫉妒这一基本行为特质是实现公平的障碍。
AI.research_question: 如何为"无嫉妒"这一最流行的公平分配原则提供公理化基础？能否从一组不以消除嫉妒为目标的公理中推导出无嫉妒原则？
AI.motivation: 无嫉妒是评估物品分配公平性最广泛使用的原则，但此前从未被公理化。作者希望从更基本的行为假设出发，为这一原则提供坚实的理论基础，并厘清嫉妒在公平分配中的角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无嫉妒（Envy-freeness）公平原则；公理化方法；社会选择理论与分配理论中的机制设计框架。
AI.method: 公理化分析：构建一组从直觉上合理的公理（这些公理均不直接以消除嫉妒为目标），通过逻辑推导证明这组公理唯一地刻画了无嫉妒分配原则。
AI.findings: 第一，提出了无嫉妒原则的首个公理化；第二，各条公理本身并不包含消除嫉妒的目的，但它们的联合却推导出无嫉妒要求；第三，通过这一公理化的视角，嫉妒作为一种基本行为特质被形式化地揭示为实现公平的障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 为无嫉妒原则提供了严格的公理化基础，填补了该领域长期空白；揭示了无嫉妒原则背后更深层的规范性假设；从形式逻辑上阐明了"嫉妒"在公平理论中的结构性角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计公平分配机制提供了理论依据，帮助政策制定者和分配机制设计者理解无嫉妒原则的深层假设基础；也帮助识别在何种条件下嫉妒行为会阻碍公平目标的实现。

title: A Normalizing Flow Approach to Portfolio Optimization using the NTS Model with Volatility Clustering
affiliations: College of Business, Stony Brook University and Stony Brook University

detail.title: A Normalizing Flow Approach to Portfolio Optimization using the NTS Model with Volatility Clustering
detail.abstract: We propose a new multivariate model for portfolio optimization that combines an ARMA-GARCH model with normal tempered stable (NTS) innovations and a normalizing flow model, Real NVP, which is a Generative AI technique. Capturing both the fat tails and the dependence structure of asset returns is critical for portfolio optimization, but traditional covariance measures and standard parametric copulas cannot fully describe asymmetric tail dependence. The NTS distribution alone can capture fat tails in the marginal distribution of each asset, but it remains restrictive as a copula for describing dependence. Real NVP alone can flexibly learn the dependence structure, but it does not directly model fat tails in the marginal distributions. We combine the two models: each marginal residual follows an NTS distribution, while the dependence among the residuals is described by a copula built from Real NVP. We apply this combined model to market factors extracted from asset returns via principal component analysis (PCA). In an empirical study on the components of the DJIA index, the combined model gives a better riskadjusted portfolio than a model using only the NTS distribution or only Real NVP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合ARMA-GARCH模型、正态 tempered stable（NTS）创新分布与Real NVP归一化流的多变量投资组合优化模型。该模型利用NTS分布捕捉各资产边际分布的肥尾特征，同时利用Real NVP灵活学习残差之间的依赖结构，并在实证研究中（基于道琼斯工业平均指数成分股）证明了其优于单独使用NTS或Real NVP的模型，能够获得更好的风险调整后投资组合表现。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个既能捕捉资产收益的肥尾特征，又能灵活描述资产间非对称尾部依赖结构的多变量模型，以优化投资组合的风险调整后表现？
AI.motivation: 传统的协方差度量与标准参数化copula无法完全描述资产收益的非对称尾部依赖；NTS分布能捕捉肥尾但作为copula描述依赖结构时存在局限性；Real NVP能灵活学习依赖结构但不直接建模边际分布的肥尾特征。因此需要一种将两者优势结合的模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: ARMA-GARCH模型、正态tempered stable（NTS）分布、Real NVP归一化流（生成式AI技术）、copula理论、主成分分析（PCA）
AI.method: 构建ARMA-GARCH模型以标准化各资产收益的边际残差；使用NTS分布拟合每个资产的边际残差分布以捕捉肥尾特征；利用Real NVP构建copula来描述残差间的依赖结构；通过PCA提取市场因子；将组合模型应用于投资组合优化，并在DJIA成分股数据上进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 在道琼斯工业平均指数（DJIA）成分股的实证研究中，结合NTS分布与Real NVP的组合模型在风险调整后投资组合表现上优于仅使用NTS分布或仅使用Real NVP的模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将参数化分布（NTS）与非参数化生成式深度学习模型（Real NVP）相结合的新颖建模框架，解决了单一模型无法同时捕捉肥尾和复杂依赖结构的理论局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资组合优化提供了更优的建模工具，能够更准确地刻画资产收益的尾部风险与依赖关系，从而帮助投资者构建风险调整后表现更好的投资组合。

title: Does Natural Resource Dependence Restrict Green Development? An Investigation from The “Belt and Road” Countries
affiliations: Ningbo University, University of Auckland Business School, University of Auckland Business School, University of Auckland Business School and University of Auckland Business School

detail.title: Does Natural Resource Dependence Restrict Green Development? An Investigation from The “Belt and Road” Countries
detail.abstract: Addressing natural resource dependence is integral to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals by promoting economic diversification, environmental sustainability, and climate resilience. This study explores the effect of natural resource dependence on green development by adopting the balanced panel dataset from the "Belt and Road" countries from 2005 to 2019. Notably, the novelty of our analysis lies in the empirical analysis using instrument-based techniques that consolidate the "green development curse hypothesis" in the Belt and Road countries. The mechanism analysis reveals that natural resource dependence curbs green development by weakening innovative capability, disturbing institutional quality, reducing population density, and crowding out human capital. Further, the dynamic panel threshold model handling endogeneity verifies the nonlinear relationship between natural resource dependence and green development. Interestingly, digital trade offers greater "resilience" than traditional trade, correcting the resource curse dilemma. Finally, heterogeneity analyses indicate that the green development curse hypothesis only exists in countries with high-level environmental regulations and resource-based countries. The full paper is available at https://doi.org/10.1016/j.envres.2024.119108

AI.tldr: 本研究基于2005-2019年"一带一路"国家平衡面板数据，采用工具变量技术和动态面板门槛模型，实证检验了自然资源依赖对绿色发展的影响，验证了"绿色发展诅咒假说"，并发现数字贸易比传统贸易更具"韧性"以纠正资源诅咒困境。
AI.research_question: 自然资源依赖如何影响"一带一路"国家的绿色发展？其作用机制、非线性特征与异质性表现是什么？
AI.motivation: 应对自然资源依赖是实现可持续发展目标的重要途径，但现有研究缺乏对"一带一路"国家中自然资源依赖与绿色发展关系的系统实证检验，特别是缺乏处理内生性的工具变量分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源诅咒假说、绿色发展理论、制度经济学、人力资本理论、创新能力理论
AI.method: 采用2005-2019年"一带一路"国家平衡面板数据，运用工具变量技术（2SLS等）处理内生性，通过机制分析检验传导渠道，使用动态面板门槛模型验证非线性关系。
AI.findings: （1）自然资源依赖通过削弱创新能力、干扰制度质量、降低人口密度、挤出人力资本四条渠道抑制绿色发展；（2）自然资源依赖与绿色发展之间存在非线性关系；（3）数字贸易比传统贸易更能纠正资源诅咒困境；（4）绿色发展诅咒假说仅在高环境规制国家和资源型国家成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在"一带一路"国家背景下系统验证"绿色发展诅咒假说"，拓展了资源诅咒理论在绿色发展领域的应用，并揭示了数字贸易对资源诅咒的"韧性"修正作用这一新机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为"一带一路"国家制定绿色发展战略提供实证依据，建议通过发展数字贸易、提升创新能力、完善制度治理来缓解资源依赖对绿色发展的约束，同时为不同环境规制水平和资源禀赋的国家提供差异化的政策启示。

title: Greener on the Other Side: General Equilibrium Asset Pricing in a Technological Transition
affiliations: Monash University, Boston University - Questrom School of Business and Boston University - Questrom School of Business

detail.title: Greener on the Other Side: General Equilibrium Asset Pricing in a Technological Transition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nothing to declare
declarations.funderStatement: Not externally funded.

detail.abstract: We study the equilibrium asset-pricing implications of a technological transition. A firm endogenously reallocates capital from a mature brown technology to a more productive but initially nascent green technology. Investment in green determines the intensity of infrequent breakthroughs, which create green capital while destroying brown capital. The optimal transition path is non-monotonic and is shaped by two competing forces: diversification and growth. As the economy becomes greener, the dominant force shifts from diversification to growth. Early in the transition, breakthroughs reduce total capital and are therefore priced as disasters. Green capital hedges this creative-destruction risk and earns a lower risk premium than brown capital. As the economy greens, breakthroughs become expansionary and are priced as booms, causing the brown-minus-green risk-premium wedge to reverse sign.

AI.tldr: 本文研究技术转型（从棕色技术转向绿色技术）的均衡资产定价影响。企业内生地将资本从成熟的棕色技术重新配置到更具生产力但初期尚不成熟的绿色技术。绿色投资决定了不频繁突破的强度，这些突破创造绿色资本同时摧毁棕色资本。最优转型路径非单调，由分散化和增长两种竞争力量塑造。转型初期突破减少总资本，被定价为灾难；绿色资本对冲创造性破坏风险，风险溢价低于棕色资本。随着经济变绿，突破变为扩张性，被定价为繁荣，棕色与绿色风险溢价差反转。
AI.research_question: 技术转型（从棕色到绿色技术）对均衡资产定价有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解技术转型过程中资产价格如何变化，特别是绿色与棕色资本的风险溢价差异及其动态演变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 均衡资产定价理论、创造性破坏模型、实物期权/内生投资理论
AI.method: 理论建模：构建一般均衡模型，刻画企业内生资本配置、突破性技术创新的随机过程及其资产定价含义。
AI.findings: 转型路径非单调；早期突破被定价为灾难（降低总资本），绿色资本因对冲此风险获得更低风险溢价；随着经济变绿，突破变为扩张性并定价为繁荣，棕色-绿色风险溢价差反转符号。
AI.theory_contributions: 将技术转型与创造性破坏纳入资产定价框架，揭示了分散化与增长两种力量在转型过程中的动态权衡，并解释了绿色与棕色资本风险溢价差异反转的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者理解绿色转型过程中的资产定价变化提供理论依据，对绿色投资的风险评估和投资策略具有指导意义。

title: A Scalable Array of Integrated LiDAR-Camera Units for Continuous Colourised 3D Monitoring of Underground Longwall Operations
affiliations: , University of New South Wales, University of Southern Queensland, Beijing Tianma Intelligent Control Technology Co., Ltd, Beijing Tianma Intelligent Control Technology Co., Ltd and University of New South Wales (UNSW)

detail.title: A Scalable Array of Integrated LiDAR-Camera Units for Continuous Colourised 3D Monitoring of Underground Longwall Operations
detail.abstract: Safe and efficient longwall mining depends on continuous awareness of the working face, where the shearer, roof supports, conveyor, and personnel interact in a confined and hazardous space. Current practice relies on fixed cameras that provide fragmented two-dimensional views, provide no distance measurement, and lose reliability in low light, dust, and occlusion. Three-dimensional sensing provides geometry but is limited to periodic surveys; a single protected LiDAR-camera unit covers only part of the face. This paper scales the unit into an array for continuous colourised 3D monitoring. The system combines a device-level software pipeline, deployment-level coverage analysis, and constrained array reconstruction. Onboard processing performs low-light enhancement, enclosure-aware calibration, LiDAR-camera fusion, point-cloud reduction, orientation estimation, and data streaming, reducing the transmitted data rate from more than 2.4 Gb/s to below 25 Mb/s per unit. Coverage analysis showed that a 15°-20° downward mounting angle improves visibility beneath the roof-support canopy, with a 20° tilt increasing footprint by more than 66%, while 6.3 m spacing provides continuous neighbouring coverage with approximately 15% overlap. The reconstruction method uses known installation spacing, IMU prior, roof-plane pre-alignment, overlap-region registration, and pose-graph optimisation to merge device outputs into a common frame. In a 50-device simulated longwall evaluation, the method achieved 1.01° rotation error and translation errors of 0.01 m along the deployment axis and 0.09 m along the cross-axis. It achieved 100% success, while five standard registration baselines failed. These results establish a validated pathway from a single sensing unit to continuous panel-wide 3D monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将单一LiDAR-相机单元扩展为阵列的系统，实现长壁开采工作面的连续彩色3D监测。系统包含设备级软件流水线、部署级覆盖分析和约束阵列重建。在50设备仿真中实现100%成功配准，旋转误差1.01°，平移误差0.01-0.09米，数据率从2.4Gb/s降至25Mb/s以下。
AI.research_question: 如何将单一的LiDAR-相机感知单元扩展为阵列系统，实现长壁开采工作面连续、可靠、覆盖全面的彩色3D监测？
AI.motivation: 当前长壁开采依赖固定摄像头，存在视野碎片化、无距离测量、在低光照/粉尘/遮挡条件下可靠性差等问题；3D传感虽能提供几何信息但仅限于周期性测量，单一LiDAR-相机单元仅能覆盖工作面一部分。需要从单一传感单元扩展到阵列以实现连续的全面监测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多传感器融合、点云配准、姿态图优化的3D重建理论框架。
AI.method: 三层方法：(1)设备级软件流水线（低光增强、封闭感知标定、LiDAR-相机融合、点云降采样、朝向估计、数据流传输）；(2)部署级覆盖分析（安装倾角和间距优化）；(3)约束阵列重建（利用已知安装间距、IMU先验、顶板平面对齐、重叠区域配准、姿态图优化）。
AI.findings: (1)数据率从2.4Gb/s降至25Mb/s以下；(2)20°倾角增加覆盖率66%以上，6.3m间距实现15%重叠；(3)在50设备仿真中旋转误差1.01°，沿部署轴平移误差0.01m，交叉轴0.09m；(4)100%配准成功，而五个标准配准基线方法全部失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从单一感知单元到面板级连续3D监测的可验证路径，建立了设备级处理与部署级覆盖分析相结合的多设备阵列重建框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为长壁开采提供连续、可靠、低带宽的彩色3D工作面监测方案，可在低光、粉尘、遮挡等恶劣条件下工作，支持安全高效的采矿作业。

title: ETF Tax Efficiency vs. Structural Risk: An ETF / Index Mutual Fund Framework Applied to Bond Markets

detail.title: ETF Tax Efficiency vs. Structural Risk: An ETF / Index Mutual Fund Framework Applied to Bond Markets
detail.abstract: ETFs are increasingly common investment vehicles, due in part to the common understanding that these vessels carry a tax-efficiency advantage, especially when compared to its open-ended mutual fund brethren. This is of course caused by the in-kind creation/redemption mechanism that allows ETFs to avoid forced sales, and the distributed capital gains that come with it. The mechanism of this efficiency depends on a network of authorized participants (AP’s) willing to step in and arbitrage the ETF market price towards its net asset value (NAV) Shim and Todorov (2023) document AP impact as far more fragile for less liquid asset classes, particularly corporate bonds. In comparison Equities which are much more liquid, experience less of an impact. Those less liquid asset classes end up with larger and more persistent premium/discount dislocations when markets experience stress. This paper treats Shim and Todorov findings as a baseline for risk-side of our model, which acts in conjunction with an original tax-side analysis to one end; answering whether in a matched set of ETF and index mutual fund pairs it is possible to determine how large the tax efficiency advantage is in practice. The central finding is that the size of the advantage shrinks as liquidity falls, while the AP-related risk Shim & Todorov describe grows in opposite. These two trends move in conjunction have a direct impact on how an investor, or institution managing a bond portfolio should weigh ETF vs. Mutual fund exposure in any given asset class.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了ETF与传统开放式指数共同基金之间的税收效率优势，发现税收优势的大小随资产流动性下降而缩小，而AP套利相关风险则随之上升，两者共同影响投资者在特定资产类别中ETF与共同基金的选择。
AI.research_question: 在匹配的ETF和指数共同基金配对中，税收效率优势在实际中究竟有多大？这一优势如何随资产流动性变化？
AI.motivation: ETF通常被认为具有税收效率优势（源于实物申赎机制避免强制卖出和分配资本利得），但Shim和Todorov（2023）发现AP机制在低流动性资产（如公司债）中更为脆弱，导致更大的溢价/折价偏离。本文结合税收侧分析与风险侧分析，量化实际税收优势的大小。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ETF实物申赎机制带来的税收效率理论，以及AP（授权参与者）套利机制在低流动性资产中的脆弱性理论（Shim和Todorov 2023）。
AI.method: 通过匹配的ETF与指数共同基金配对样本，结合税收侧分析（税收效率优势）与风险侧分析（AP相关风险），进行实证比较研究。
AI.findings: 税收效率优势的大小随资产流动性下降而缩小，而AP相关风险则随流动性下降而上升。这两股相反的趋势共同影响投资者在债券组合中对ETF与共同基金敞口的权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 将税收效率理论与AP套利风险理论结合，统一在一个框架中，揭示了税收优势与流动性风险之间的权衡关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和机构在管理债券组合时，如何在给定资产类别中权衡ETF与共同基金的敞口提供了实证依据和决策指导。

title: Was Stalin Necessary? Counterfactual Evidence on Soviet Growth

detail.title: Was Stalin Necessary? Counterfactual Evidence on Soviet Growth
detail.abstract: This article evaluates whether the exceptionally rapid growth of the Russian and Soviet economy after 1928 requires a specifically Stalinist explanation. The empirical design treats the historical claim as a sequence of increasingly demanding counterfactual comparisons rather than as a binary contest between observed growth and one preferred alternative. Long-run output series from the Global Macro Database and the Maddison Project are combined with synthetic control, augmented synthetic control, synthetic difference-indifferences , interactive-factor models, low-rank matrix completion, robust prediction benchmarks, historical analogues, exact spatial placebos, fake treatment dates, recovery placebos, donor-pool perturbations, endpoint sensitivity, and independent Soviet national-account reconstructions. A central methodological change concerns the New Economic Policy alternative. Mechanical extrapolation of the 1922-1928 recovery rate is rejected because it confounds trend growth with the closure of a war and civil-war output gap. The revised NEP counterfactual is estimated as a bootstrap recovery-gap process whose trend is anchored in the pre-1914 record and whose persistence is estimated from the observed 1921-1928 closure of the Russian output gap. The Russian-core specifications exceed the median admissible frontier at every endpoint and exceed the primary 90th-percentile frontier from the mid-1930s onward. The broader Soviet territorial aggregate remains more conservative and does not exceed that frontier. Donor perturbations preserve a positive Russian-core premium, but the small effective placebo set, weak pre-treatment fit for several estimators, recovery-related false positives, source dependence, and hostile upper bounds prevent an inference of unique or absolute historical necessity. The evidence supports a conditional growth premium and a narrower proposition: the observed acceleration required an unusually strong resource-mobilisation mechanism, while the available data do not identify Stalin as the only institutionally possible route.

title:
Anchored to Prices Past: 
Managerial Beliefs about Stock Value
affiliations: Korea University Business School and

detail.title:
Anchored to Prices Past: 
Managerial Beliefs about Stock Value
detail.abstract: Using novel data on explicit undervaluation claims in earnings calls, we study how managers form beliefs about their firms' stock value. Appearing in only 4.7% of calls, these claims seem to capture genuine managerial beliefs: they elicit strong positive price reactions without reversal, predict opportunistic repurchases, and are more common when managers have greater long-term equity exposure. Yet these beliefs are anchored to salient past prices: undervaluation claims are more likely following sharp declines from prior peaks. Consistent with persistent anchoring, technology firms that experienced extreme dot-com valuations remain more likely than peers listed after the dot-com bubble to claim undervaluation and repurchase shares opportunistically, with both effects weakening as dot-comera managers leave. Our findings suggest that financial-market bubbles can leave a lasting imprint on managerial beliefs and thereby distort corporate financial policy long after bubble prices recede.

AI.tldr: 本文利用盈余电话会议中关于股价被低估的明确声明这一新颖数据，研究管理层如何形成关于公司股票价值的信念。研究发现这些低估声明确实反映了管理层的真实信念，但这些信念锚定于显著的过往股价，且金融市场泡沫会在泡沫消退后长期影响管理层信念并扭曲公司财务政策。
AI.research_question: 管理者如何形成关于公司股票价值的信念？这些信念是否受到过往价格锚定效应的影响，以及市场泡沫是否会对管理者信念产生持久性影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对管理者公司价值信念的形成机制关注不足，缺乏直接观测管理者信念的数据。本文利用盈余电话会议中的低估声明作为管理者信念的直接度量，探讨信念形成中的锚定偏差及其对公司财务政策的长期影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 锚定效应理论（anchoring heuristic）；行为金融学中的代表性启发与锚定偏差；管理层信念与公司财务政策的理论框架。
AI.method: 利用盈余电话会议文本数据构建管理层低估声明的度量指标，采用事件研究法分析股价反应与反转，结合回购行为、管理层股权激励等公司特征数据进行实证回归分析，并利用科技公司互联网泡沫事件进行准自然实验检验。
AI.findings: （1）低估声明仅出现在4.7%的电话会议中，但能引发强正向股价反应且无反转，反映真实信念；（2）低估声明预测机会主义回购，且管理层长期股权敞口更大时更常出现；（3）低估声明更可能出现在股价从前期高点大幅下跌之后，表明信念锚定于显著过往价格；（4）经历过极端互联网泡沫估值的科技公司比泡沫后上市的同业更可能声称低估并机会性回购，且这种效应随泡沫时代管理者退出而减弱，表明泡沫对管理层信念有持久印记。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次利用直接观测数据实证检验管理者信念中的锚定偏差；揭示了金融市场泡沫对管理者信念的长期持久性影响机制；将锚定效应从投资者层面拓展到企业管理者信念形成层面，丰富了行为金融学关于管理层信念的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者解读盈余电话会议中的低估声明提供了证据参考，帮助识别管理层机会主义回购行为；提示公司治理层面关注管理层信念偏差对财务政策（如回购决策）的扭曲效应；对监管机构理解市场泡沫的长期经济后果具有政策启示。

title: Median-anchored Adjustment of Joint VaR-ES Forecasts
affiliations: and University of California, Riverside (UCR)

detail.title: Median-anchored Adjustment of Joint VaR-ES Forecasts

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: Risk managers often work with a fitted forecasting model they cannot replace even when its tail forecasts need adjustment. We propose a median-anchored rule that multiplies the distances from the fitted median to Value-at-Risk (VaR) and Expected Shortfall (ES) by a common positive multiplier. The rule preserves VaR-ES ordering, and minimizing VaR check loss gives a closed-form weighted-quantile estimator. We establish consistency, give an asymptotic distribution under high-level conditions accounting for baseline estimation, and derive a VaR coverage-error bound at the forecast origin. When the same multiplier correctly adjusts both VaR and ES, the adjusted pair has lower conditional zero-homogeneous Fissler-Ziegel (FZ0) risk at that origin. Monte Carlo experiments examine this condition and several forms of misspecification. In rolling S&P 500 forecasts the adjustment lowers FZ0 loss in all four GARCH cells, each pairwise significant, with the largest and most robust gain, 10.4%, for Gaussian GARCH at the 1% tail; the 5% gains do not survive the most conservative family-wise adjustments. A quantile-regression baseline marks the boundary: when the fitted tail is already flexible, one multiplier adds little. Filtered historical simulation quantifies what standardized residuals and conditional scales add when available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种以中位数为锚的调整规则，通过将拟合中位数到VaR和ES的距离乘以一个共同的正乘数来调整尾部预测。该规则保持VaR-ES排序，最小化VaR检查损失可得到闭式加权分位数估计量。作者建立了估计量的一致性，给出了考虑基线估计的高阶条件下的渐近分布，并推导了预测原点的VaR覆盖误差界。当同一乘数正确调整VaR和ES时，调整后的配对在预测原点具有更低的条件零齐次Fissler-Ziegel（FZ0）风险。蒙特卡洛实验检验了该条件及多种设定错误形式。在滚动S&P 500预测中，调整在所有四个GARCH单元中降低了FZ0损失，且每对均显著，其中高斯GARCH在1%尾部的增益最大且最稳健（10.4%）；5%的增益在最保守的族系调整下不显著。分位数回归基线标记了边界：当拟合尾部已经足够灵活时，单一乘数的调整收益有限。滤波历史模拟量化了标准化残差和条件尺度在可用时的贡献。
AI.research_question: 当风险管理者的预测模型无法更换但尾部预测需要调整时，如何设计一种有效且可操作的规则来同时调整VaR和ES预测？
AI.motivation: 实践中风险管理者常常面对一个已经拟合好的预测模型，即使其尾部预测不佳也无法轻易更换。现有方法缺乏一种简单有效的尾部调整规则，因此需要一种既能保持VaR-ES一致性排序、又具有统计理论基础且易于实施的调整方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分位数回归理论、VaR检查损失（check loss）、Fissler-Ziegel一致性评分函数、极大似然估计的渐近理论
AI.method: 提出中位数锚定的单一乘数调整规则；通过最小化VaR检查损失获得闭式加权分位数估计量；建立一致性和渐近分布理论；推导VaR覆盖误差界；通过蒙特卡洛实验和滚动S&P 500数据实证检验。
AI.findings: (1) 提出的调整规则在理论上保持VaR-ES排序，且最小化VaR检查损失可得闭式解；(2) 当同一乘数正确调整两者时，调整后的配对具有更低的FZ0风险；(3) 蒙特卡洛实验考察了条件满足性和多种设定错误；(4) 实证中，调整在全部四个GARCH单元中显著降低FZ0损失，高斯GARCH在1%尾部最大增益10.4%；(5) 5%水平下的增益在保守调整下不显著；(6) 当基线模型（如分位数回归）已足够灵活时，单一乘数调整收益有限。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出了一种新颖的中位数锚定尾部调整规则，具有封闭形式的加权分位数估计量；(2) 为调整后的VaR和ES估计建立了完整的一致性、渐近分布和覆盖误差界理论；(3) 证明了在FZ0风险框架下调整配对的优越性条件；(4) 将尾部调整问题置于一致的评分函数理论框架中进行严格分析。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为无法更换模型的风险管理者提供了一种简单、计算高效且可操作的尾部调整工具；(2) 该方法保持VaR-ES的序关系，避免实践中可能出现的VaR大于ES的不一致问题；(3) 在S&P 500实证中展示了显著的预测改进，特别是在1%尾部水平；(4) 为实务中何时采用该调整（基线不灵活时收益大）提供了清晰的指导边界。

title: Policy Priorities for the Global Labor Market Transition to the Capability Economy
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Policy Priorities for the Global Labor Market Transition to the Capability Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All three authors are employed by Takamol Holding, the publisher of this paper. Takamol Holding runs digital labor market systems in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, including several of the programs and platforms discussed in the paper, among them the Qiwa platform, the Waad National Training Campaign, and the National Skills Platform, and works in partnership with the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development. Takamol Holding also convenes the Global Labor Market Conference, whose proceedings form part of the evidence base. Readers should take this institutional relationship into account when assessing the treatment of Saudi Arabian labor market policy, which the paper presents alongside comparative material on Singapore, Germany, Finland, France, Estonia, India, and the United States. The authors have no personal or financial interests to declare beyond their employment.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a policy analysis based on published secondary data from international organizations, including the World Economic Forum, the International Labour Organization, the OECD, and the World Bank, together with proceedings from the Global Labor Market Conference. The research involved no human participants, no patient data, and no collection of personal information, so ethics approval was not required. The illustrative worker scenario in Box 5 is a composite constructed from published statistical patterns and describes no actual individual.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by Takamol Holding as part of its institutional policy research program. No external funding was received.

detail.abstract:
Labor market institutions in industrialized economies developed over the twentieth century as a single interlocking settlement, in which wage employment mediated access to social protection, payroll contributions financed social insurance, educational credentials served as the dominant signal of workplace capability, and periodic surveys supplied the statistical basis for policy. Each of those conditions has since weakened, and they have weakened in concert, which gives the resulting institutional mismatch a systemic character.

Drawing on proceedings from three editions of the Global Labor Market Conference, together with data from the World Economic Forum, the International Labour Organization, the OECD, the World Bank, and BCG, this paper documents five structural transformations, beginning with the movement from credentials toward verified skills and extending through intensifying competition for labor capacity, the reorganization of task composition by artificial intelligence, the fragmentation of employment into platform and multi-engagement arrangements, and the growing distance between labor market activity and the statistical systems designed to observe it.

The evidence assembled includes the 39 percent of core skills projected to change by 2030, the two billion workers who remain in informal employment, social security contributions that constitute a quarter of OECD tax revenue, and the 47.7 percent of workers globally whose qualifications correspond to the requirements of their jobs.

Six policy priorities follow from that analysis. They would establish skills as primary economic signals, treat workforce capacity as strategic infrastructure, govern artificial intelligence as a workforce multiplier, align fiscal systems with capability-based economies, design portable and adaptive protection systems, and build computational labor intelligence systems.

AI.tldr: 本文论述了工业化经济体在20世纪形成的劳动力市场制度（就业、社会保障、教育信号、统计系统）作为一个相互关联的整体正同步弱化，导致制度性错配具有系统性特征。基于三届全球劳动力市场会议记录及WEF、ILO、OECD、世界银行和BCG的数据，论文记录了五大结构性转型（从学历信号转向技能验证、劳动力竞争加剧、AI重构任务构成、就业碎片化为平台和多重雇佣、劳动力市场活动与统计系统脱节），并提出六项政策优先事项以应对这些转型。
AI.research_question: 工业化经济体中20世纪形成的劳动力市场制度（就业-社保-教育-统计四位一体的制度安排）如何因结构性转型而系统性失灵，以及应如何重构政策框架以应对这些变化？
AI.motivation: 20世纪形成的劳动力市场制度安排（工资就业作为社会保障的媒介、工资税资助社会保险、学历作为工作能力信号、周期调查支撑政策统计）每个支柱都在同步弱化，这种协同弱化使制度错配具有系统性而非局部性特征，因此亟需系统性的重新审视和政策设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度互补性理论——劳动力市场各项制度（就业、社保、教育信号、统计）在20世纪构成"相互嵌合"（interlocking）的制度安排，各支柱之间具有系统性关联，一方的弱化会传导并放大至其他方面，形成系统性制度错配。
AI.method: 基于三届全球劳动力市场会议（Global Labor Market Conference）的会议记录，结合世界经济论坛（WEF）、国际劳工组织（ILO）、OECD、世界银行及BCG的多源数据进行文档分析与证据综合。
AI.findings: （1）五大结构性转型：从学历信号转向已验证技能、劳动力容量竞争加剧、AI重组工作任务构成、就业碎片化为平台与多重雇佣安排、劳动力市场活动与统计观测系统之间的脱节日益扩大。（2）关键证据：到2030年预期39%的核心技能将发生改变；20亿工人仍处于非正规就业；社保缴费占OECD税收收入的四分之一；全球仅47.7%的工人资质与工作岗位要求相匹配。
AI.theory_contributions: 从制度互补性视角揭示了劳动力市场制度各支柱的协同弱化如何形成系统性错配，超越了以往对单一制度缺陷的孤立分析，为理解后工业时代劳动力市场治理提供了整体性理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出六项政策优先事项：（1）将技能确立为主要经济信号；（2）将劳动力容量视为战略基础设施；（3）将人工智能治理为劳动力倍增器；（4）使财政制度与基于能力的经济体对齐；（5）设计可携带、自适应的保护体系；（6）构建计算型劳动力情报系统。

title: Freemium is all you need
affiliations: State University of New York (SUNY) - University at Buffalo and Yale University

detail.title: Freemium is all you need
detail.abstract: Free access to a generative AI (GenAI) service requires costly compute, yet can also produce data that improve future service quality. We study a service provider whose users differ in request value and privacy preference, under the constraint that paid requests are kept private, while free requests can be used to improve model quality which otherwise reverts toward a baseline. In particular, we characterize service demand and prove that quality converges to a unique steady state for every stationary service strategy. Next, we analyze optimal pricing and quality policies and show that these can be expressed using two endogenous user value thresholds. For uniform values, we provide a closed-form optimal service strategy and characterize the sufficient conditions for offering free services as dependent on inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成式AI（GenAI）服务提供商的定价与质量策略。提供商面临用户异质性（请求价值与隐私偏好不同），付费请求保持隐私，免费请求的数据可用于改进模型质量（否则质量会回退至基准水平）。作者刻画了服务需求，证明了质量在任意静态服务策略下收敛至唯一稳态，进一步分析了最优定价与质量政策，发现可用两个内生用户价值阈值表达。对均匀价值分布，给出了闭合形式的最优服务策略，并刻画了提供免费服务的充分条件取决于推理成本。
AI.research_question: 在GenAI服务中，提供商应如何设计定价与质量策略，以在免费服务带来的数据收益（改进模型质量）与付费服务带来的隐私保护（不可用于训练）之间实现最优权衡？
AI.motivation: GenAI服务免费访问需要高昂的计算成本，但免费请求产生的数据可以提升未来服务质量，形成正反馈。然而免费与付费服务在隐私和数据利用上存在结构性矛盾：付费请求需保持隐私，无法用于模型改进；免费请求则可被利用。这一权衡对企业定价与质量策略设计至关重要，但缺乏系统性理论刻画。
AI.theoretical_framework: 服务质量动态演化与稳态分析、用户异质性（请求价值与隐私偏好）下的消费者选择模型、最优定价理论
AI.method: 理论建模与数学分析：建立服务需求函数模型，证明质量动态收敛到唯一稳态；通过最优控制/优化方法求解定价与质量策略，推导基于内生用户价值阈值的表达式；对均匀价值分布情形给出闭合解并进行比较静态分析。
AI.findings: （1）对于任意静态服务策略，模型质量收敛至唯一稳态；（2）最优定价与质量策略可由两个内生用户价值阈值表达；（3）在均匀价值分布下，可得到闭合形式的最优服务策略；（4）是否提供免费服务的充分条件取决于推理成本的大小。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了GenAI服务定价与质量动态的完整理论框架；揭示了免费服务的数据收益与计算成本之间的权衡机制；证明了稳态质量的存在唯一性；为"免费增值"模式在AI服务中的最优设计提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为GenAI服务提供商提供了可操作的定价与质量策略指导；明确了何种条件下应提供免费服务（取决于推理成本）；帮助企业在数据利用、隐私保护与盈利能力之间进行最优决策。

title: Preference Robust Distortion Risk Measures
affiliations: Grenoble Ecole de Management and

detail.title: Preference Robust Distortion Risk Measures
detail.abstract: We introduce a framework for preference-robust decision making when preferences over risk are modelled through generalised distortion risk measures. Unlike distributional robustness, our approach addresses ambiguity in the risk functional itself. We construct ambiguity sets on distortion (weight) functions using the Wasserstein distance and Bregman divergences, and derive closed-form expressions for the worst-and best-case distortion risk measures. We further extend the framework to rank-dependent utility, yielding preference-robust behavioural models. In particular, rank-dependent utility appears as a robustification of the expected utility model, yielding a novel way to address the Allais paradox.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种偏好稳健决策框架，通过广义扭曲风险度量来建模风险偏好。与分布鲁棒性不同，该方法处理的是风险泛函本身的模糊性。作者利用Wasserstein距离和Bregman散度在扭曲（权重）函数上构建模糊集，并推导出最坏与最好情况扭曲风险度量的闭式表达式。该框架进一步扩展到等级依赖效用，得到偏好稳健的行为模型。特别地，等级依赖效用作为期望效用模型的稳健化出现，为解决Allais悖论提供了新途径。
AI.research_question: 如何在与分布鲁棒性不同的维度上处理风险度量本身（而非概率分布）的模糊性或不确定性，从而构建偏好稳健的决策框架？
AI.motivation: 传统鲁棒优化主要关注分布的不确定性（即真实分布未知），但风险偏好的不确定性同样重要且未被充分研究。此外，等级依赖效用与期望效用之间的理论关系需要更深层的解释，特别是关于Allais悖论这一行为经济学经典难题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广义扭曲风险度量（generalised distortion risk measures）、Wasserstein距离、Bregman散度、等级依赖效用（rank-dependent utility）、期望效用理论、Allais悖论。
AI.method: 理论推导与数学建模方法：在扭曲（权重）函数空间上构建模糊集（分别基于Wasserstein距离和Bregman散度），推导最坏/最好情况扭曲风险度量的闭式表达式，并将框架扩展至等级依赖效用模型。
AI.findings: （1）在Wasserstein距离和Bregman散度下均获得了最坏与最好情况扭曲风险度量的闭式解；（2）等级依赖效用可被解释为期望效用模型的稳健化版本；（3）该偏好稳健框架为Allais悖论提供了一种新颖的理论解释途径。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将鲁棒优化的思想从分布不确定性拓展到风险偏好（扭曲函数）的不确定性，开创了"偏好鲁棒性"这一新方向；（2）为等级依赖效用提供了新的理论基础——即期望效用的稳健化形式；（3）通过偏好鲁棒性框架为Allais悖论提供了新的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为决策者在风险偏好不确定时的稳健决策提供了数学工具；（2）闭式表达式的推导使得该方法在实际应用中计算可行；（3）对保险、金融等需要稳健风险度量的领域具有潜在应用价值。

title: Insider Trading and the Non-Public Character of Information: Reflections on the CJEU’s Brännelius Judgment

detail.title: Insider Trading and the Non-Public Character of Information: Reflections on the CJEU’s Brännelius Judgment
detail.abstract: The Court of Justice of the European Union marked a significant development in EU insider trading law. In its April 2026 Brännelius judgment, it adopted a restrictive interpretation of the non-public character of inside information, holding that information ceases to qualify as inside information only once it has been publicly disclosed by the issuer in accordance with Article 17 of the Market Abuse Regulation (MAR). While this approach effectively prevents insiders and tippees from exploiting information that is merely accessible but not yet reflected in market prices, it also gives rise to significant conceptual and practical difficulties. This article identifies two major shortcomings of the judgment. First, it produces paradoxical consequences for inside information that concerns issuers only indirectly and for issuers’ failures to comply with their disclosure obligations. Second, if interpreted broadly, Brännelius risks extending the insider trading prohibition to informed outsiders who independently uncover material information, thereby undermining information-search incentives and market efficiency. The article advocates a narrow reading of the judgment and concludes by highlighting the structural limits of the current formulation of the EU insider trading prohibition.

title: The Reopened Window: Revisiting the Choice Between IPO and Private Sale for Venture-Backed Technology Companies in the 2024-2026 Liquidity Cycle

detail.title: The Reopened Window: Revisiting the Choice Between IPO and Private Sale for Venture-Backed Technology Companies in the 2024-2026 Liquidity Cycle
detail.abstract: The 2022-2024 collapse in exit activity for venture-backed technology companies produced the longest liquidity drought in modern private-market history, followed by an unusually rapid reopening of the IPO window in 2025-2026. This paper revisits the classic IPO-versus-acquisition exit decision in light of that cycle. Drawing on exit data from Renaissance Capital, PitchBook/NVCA, PwC, and investment-bank commentary, I document a pronounced bifurcation: while public listings have re-emerged as the value-maximizing route for the largest, later-stage companies-dominated by AI-adjacent issuers and sponsor-backed portfolio companies-acquisitions accounted for roughly 94 percent of US venture-backed exit events in 2025. I argue that the reopened window has not restored the pre-2022 exit hierarchy but has instead entrenched a two-tier market in which scale, sector narrative, and sponsor overhang, rather than company quality alone, determine route availability. I propose a simple decision framework for founders, boards, and early-stage investors, and discuss implications for private-market valuation practice and for the design of dual-track processes.

title: Capital markets in Italy - Mid-year update 2026
affiliations: CONSOB (Commissione Nazionale per le Società e la Borsa), CONSOB (Commissione Nazionale per le Società e la Borsa), CONSOB (Commissione Nazionale per le Società e la Borsa), CONSOB (Commissione Nazionale per le Società e la Borsa), CONSOB (Commissione Nazionale per le Società e la Borsa) and CONSOB (Commissione Nazionale per le Società e la Borsa)

detail.title: Capital markets in Italy - Mid-year update 2026
detail.abstract:
Capital Markets in Italy: Mid-Year Update 2026 is a Consob report structured into four chapters that provides a comparative overview of the main trends and risks affecting the Italian financial system during the first half of 2026. The chapters are devoted to:

1. Macroeconomic and financial landscape, that examines recent developments in the global economy and financial markets. It discusses the economic consequences of renewed geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, their impact on energy prices, inflation and monetary policy, as well as cross-country differences in growth dynamics, public debt sustainability and financial conditions. The chapter also reviews developments in gold and crypto-asset markets.

2. Financial market performances, that illustrates the behaviour of global and domestic financial markets during the first half of 2026. It reviews the performance of major equity indices, sectoral drivers of stock market returns, valuation trends, volatility and liquidity conditions, as well as developments in corporate and sovereign bond markets following geopolitical shocks.

3. Capital markets development, that examines the evolution of capital markets across major economies. Attention is devoted to equity market capitalisation, market concentration, the growing importance of private equity and private credit, and the increasing role of private markets in financing business growth, especially in technology-intensive sectors.

4. Primary market trends, that provides a general overview of IPO and delisting activity in a global and European context. The chapter highlights the declining role of European public markets, recent developments in Euronext Milan and Euronext Growth Milan, and the impact of listing and delisting dynamics on the size and structure of the Italian equity market.

AI.tldr: 本报告是意大利Consob发布的2026年中期资本市场更新报告，分为四个章节，系统梳理了2026年上半年意大利金融体系面临的主要趋势与风险，涵盖宏观经济金融格局、金融市场表现、资本市场发展以及一级市场趋势。
AI.research_question: 2026年上半年意大利金融体系面临哪些主要趋势与风险？具体包括宏观经济与金融格局、金融市场表现、资本市场发展和一级市场趋势四个维度。
AI.motivation: 为监管机构、投资者及政策制定者提供对意大利金融体系最新动态的全面、系统性概述，帮助识别地缘政治冲击、通胀与货币政策调整等背景下资本市场面临的关键风险与机遇。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观经济金融分析框架、资本市场发展理论、公开市场与私募市场比较分析框架。
AI.method: 基于官方统计数据和市场数据的综合描述性分析，采用四章节结构分别考察宏观经济环境、金融市场表现、资本市场演变趋势及一级市场动态。
AI.findings: 1) 中东地缘政治紧张局势推高能源价格，影响通胀和货币政策路径；2) 各国在增长动力、公共债务可持续性和金融条件方面存在差异；3) 黄金和加密资产市场值得关注；4) 私募股权和私募信贷重要性上升，私募市场在科技密集型行业融资中的作用增强；5) 欧洲公开市场地位下滑，意大利股市上市与退市动态影响市场规模与结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 对意大利及欧洲资本市场发展趋势提供了系统性梳理，揭示了公开市场与私募市场此消彼长的结构性变化，以及地缘政治冲击对金融体系的传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、市场监管者和投资者提供了关于意大利金融体系上半年运行的全面概览，有助于识别系统性风险、评估市场结构变化，并指导资本市场监管和投资决策。

title: Multi-Layer Semantic Integrity Framework for Knowledge-Reliable and Consistent Responses in Large Language Models
affiliations: Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka, Central Queensland University and Central Queensland University

detail.title: Multi-Layer Semantic Integrity Framework for Knowledge-Reliable and Consistent Responses in Large Language Models
detail.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently generate responses that appear fluent yet may contain hallucinations, inconsistencies, or biased reasoning, that can pose significant integrity risks for knowledge-based applications. This paper proposes a Multi-Layer Semantic Integrity Framework (MLSIF) that automatically evaluates the integrity of LLM responses based on six complementary metrics: response consistency, semantic similarity, reasoning quality, adversarial robustness, bias estimation, and perplexity. These metrics are combined into a novel Semantic Integrity Index (SII) that provides a unified interpretable reliability score per model. The framework is evaluated on eight open-source LLMs including Gemma2 9B, DeepSeek-R1 7B, LLaMA2 7B, LLaMA3.1 8B, LLaMA3.2 3B, Qwen2.5 7B, Mistral 7B, and Vicuna 7B using 200 structured prompts that span five knowledge categories, namely factual, reasoning, contextual, adversarial, and sensitive. Experimental results reveal that LLaMA3.2 3B achieves the highest SII (0.688) despite being the smallest model, demonstrating that parameter count alone does not imply semantic reliability. DeepSeek-R1 7B leads in reasoning quality (mean = 0.600), while Mistral 7B achieves the highest adversarial robustness (mean = 0.809). ANOVA and Tukey HSD analysis confirm statistically significant differences between the tested models on response consistency, reasoning quality, adversarial robustness, and bias estimation. Noteworthy, the proposed framework is model-agnostic and extensible, providing a principled pre-deployment validation mechanism for LLM’s integration into knowledge-based systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个多层级语义完整性框架（MLSIF），通过六个互补指标（响应一致性、语义相似度、推理质量、对抗鲁棒性、偏见估计和困惑度）自动评估LLM响应的完整性，并整合为统一的语义完整性指数（SII）。在八个开源LLM和200个结构化提示上评估，发现LLaMA3.2 3B虽最小但SII最高（0.688），DeepSeek-R1在推理质量上领先，Mistral在对抗鲁棒性上最优。该框架与模型无关且可扩展，为LLM部署前的验证提供了原则性机制。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个自动化的多维度框架来系统评估大型语言模型响应的语义完整性，从而为知识型应用中LLM的部署前验证提供可靠的度量标准？
AI.motivation: LLM经常生成看似流畅但可能包含幻觉、不一致或偏见推理的响应，这对知识型应用的完整性构成重大风险。现有的评估方法往往只关注单一维度（如准确率或流畅度），缺乏对响应语义完整性进行全面、多维度、可解释的自动评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多指标综合评估理论，整合了语义一致性理论、对抗鲁棒性理论、偏见检测理论和信息熵（困惑度）理论，构建六维度的语义完整性评估框架。
AI.method: 提出MLSIF框架，采用六个互补指标（响应一致性、语义相似度、推理质量、对抗鲁棒性、偏见估计、困惑度）组合为SII指数；在8个开源LLM上使用200个覆盖五类知识（事实性、推理性、上下文性、对抗性、敏感性）的结构化提示进行实验，并运用ANOVA和Tukey HSD进行统计显著性检验。
AI.findings: 1) LLaMA3.2 3B在SII上得分最高（0.688），尽管模型最小，说明参数规模不代表语义可靠性；2) DeepSeek-R1 7B在推理质量上领先（均值0.600）；3) Mistral 7B在对抗鲁棒性上最佳（均值0.809）；4) ANOVA和Tukey HSD分析确认各模型在响应一致性、推理质量、对抗鲁棒性和偏见估计上存在统计显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了统一的语义完整性指数（SII）作为可解释的可靠性评分指标，将多个语义质量维度整合为一个综合度量；同时验证了模型规模与语义可靠性之间并非简单正相关关系，丰富了LLM评估理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了模型无关且可扩展的部署前验证机制，可用于知识型系统中LLM的选型和准入评估；通过多维度的SII指数帮助实践者快速比较不同LLM的可靠性；建立的统计检验方法为LLM选择提供了数据驱动的决策依据。

title: Behavioural Real Options in Electric Vehicle Replacement: Carbon Externalities and Policy Instrument Choice
affiliations: Corvinus University of Budapest and The University of Manchester

detail.title: Behavioural Real Options in Electric Vehicle Replacement: Carbon Externalities and Policy Instrument Choice
detail.abstract: We develop a behavioural real-options model of vehicle-replacement timing, in which a household decides when to replace an internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicle with an electric vehicle (EV) as EV prices decline over time and carbon emissions are costly. The model has two clocks: calendar time governs prices and the externality, while vehicle age governs the replacement hazard and a behavioural friction. Solving the associated free-boundary problem yields an age-dependent value of deferral that vanishes at forced replacement, and a dynamic wedge between private and social replacement timing. We calibrate the model to European Union (EU) and Hungarian registration data. The registration flow prices the switch with little deferral value: forced replacements carry none, and voluntary switches concentrate late in ownership spells, where the option premium has decayed; the calibrated friction (EU +EUR 2.0k, Hungary +EUR 4.4k) is stable across assumed fleet ages and deferral assumptions. The EU-Hungary adoption gap is attributed to friction, not fleet age: an older fleet changes the volume of replacements, not the EV share among them. In the policy comparison, instruments that reduce the friction (charging-access vouchers, residual-value guarantees) abate carbon emissions at EUR 120-140 per tonne, below the social cost of carbon, against EUR 377-732 for price subsidies at an equal budget, and reach a five percentage-point adoption target at a quarter to a third of the fiscal cost, under calibrated policy-cost assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个行为真实期权模型来研究家庭更换燃油车（ICE）为电动车（EV）的时机决策。模型包含两个时钟：日历时间决定价格和外部性，车辆年龄决定更换风险和行�为摩擦。通过求解自由边界问题，得到随年龄递减的延迟价值。校准结果显示EU和匈牙利的数据支持模型预测，且减少摩擦的政策工具（充电访问券、残值保证）比价格补贴更具成本效益。
AI.research_question: 家庭在考虑碳排放成本的情况下，何时决定将内燃机汽车替换为电动汽车？私家车和社会最优的替换时机之间存在怎样的动态差异？
AI.motivation: 随着电动车价格下降和碳排放问题日益严峻，理解家庭更换车辆的时机决策对于碳减排政策设计至关重要。现有模型忽视了行为摩擦和车辆年龄对替换决策的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为真实期权模型（Behavioral Real-Options Model），包含双时钟结构（日历时间和车辆年龄），自由边界问题求解，私人与社会替换时机的动态楔子分析。
AI.method: 构建行为真实期权模型并求解自由边界问题；使用欧盟和匈牙利注册数据进行模型校准；进行政策比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）注册流量为切换定价时延迟价值很小，强制更换没有延迟价值，自愿切换集中在拥有期后期；（2）校准的行为摩擦在欧盟为+EUR 2.0k，匈牙利为+EUR 4.4k，且在不同车队年龄假设下保持稳定；（3）EU与匈牙利的采用差距归因于摩擦而非车队年龄；（4）减少摩擦的政策工具（充电访问券、残值保证）以每吨120-140欧元的成本减排，低于碳的社会成本，而价格补贴为每吨377-732欧元。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为摩擦引入真实期权框架，揭示了年龄依赖的延迟价值结构；证明了车队年龄影响替换量而非EV份额；区分了私人与社会最优替换时机并量化其差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供成本效益分析：减少摩擦的政策工具（充电访问券、残值保证）比价格补贴更具成本效益，以四分之一到三分之一的财政成本实现5个百分点的采用目标。

title: Is Cost Sharing Valid Under Loper Bright?
affiliations: University of Michigan Law School

detail.title: Is Cost Sharing Valid Under Loper Bright?
detail.abstract: On July 15, 2026, Meta Platforms Inc. filed its motion for summary judgement in its Tax Court case challenging the validity of Treas. Reg. § §1.482-7(a)(4), (d)(1)(iii), and (d)(3)(ii)(2011) (the "SBC Rule"), requiring the inclusion of stock-based compensation ("SBC") in the pool of intangible development costs ("IDCs") to be shared under a qualifying cost sharing agreement (CSA). This issue is also before the courts in cases brought by Abbot Labs and McKesson, and all of these cases represent an attempt to overturn the IRS victory in Altera, in which the Ninth Circuit held that SBC must be included in IDCs. But unlike the other cases, the focus of Meta`s motion is not the conflict between the SBC Rule and the arm`s length standard (ALS), but rather the conflict with the language of the statute itself. This paper argues that Meta should lose and that Treasury should withdraw Treas. Reg. 1.482-7 in its entirety because it is inconsistent with the text of the statute, as required under the Supreme Court's decision in Loper Bright and by the Presidential Memorandum on Directing the Repeal of Unlawful Regulations (Apr. 10, 2025).

AI.tldr: 本文分析了Meta在税务法院对SBC规则（要求将股票薪酬纳入合格成本分摊协议下的无形资产开发成本池）的质疑，认为Meta应败诉，且财政部应依据Loper Bright案和总统备忘录废除整个Treas. Reg. 1.482-7，因为该法规与法规条文本身不一致。
AI.research_question: Meta对SBC规则的质疑是否成立，以及Treas. Reg. 1.482-7是否因与法规文本不一致而应被废除？
AI.motivation: SBC规则的法律争议涉及Altera案中IRS的胜利，Meta案与其他案件不同之处在于其聚焦于法规与成文法语言本身的冲突，而非正常交易原则（ALS）的冲突，需要厘清该法规是否符合最高法院Loper Bright判例及总统备忘录的要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法定解释理论（statutory interpretation），涉及Loper Bright案确立的司法审查标准，以及总统备忘录中关于废除非法规章的行政法原则。
AI.method: 法律案例分析（case analysis）与法规文本分析法，比较Meta案与其他相关案件（Abbot Labs、McKesson案）的论证差异，并依据最高法院判例和行政命令进行法律推理。
AI.findings: Meta的论证应被驳回；Treas. Reg. 1.482-7的SBC规则与成文法文本不一致，财政部应依据Loper Bright案确立的标准和2025年4月10日的总统备忘录，将整个Treas. Reg. 1.482-7予以撤销。
AI.theory_contributions: 为SBC规则的法律争议提供了不同于Altera案传统辩论（正常交易原则冲突）的新分析框架——即基于成文法文本和Loper Bright司法审查标准的法定解释路径，丰富了国际税务领域行政法规合法性审查的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Meta案、Abbot Labs案和McKesson案等SBC规则相关诉讼提供了法律论证参考；为财政部依据总统备忘录废除规章的实践提供了学理支撑；对跨国企业在成本分摊协议中处理股票薪酬的合规策略具有重要指引意义。

title: Beliefs and Norm Violations: Experimental Investigation of Perceptions of Human and AI Mistakes
affiliations: University of Zurich, University of Basel and University of Zurich

detail.title: Beliefs and Norm Violations: Experimental Investigation of Perceptions of Human and AI Mistakes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research is funded by ERC Chanse/Hera Program as part of Norms of Assertion in Linguistic Human-AI Interaction (NIHAI) project.

detail.abstract: How do people evaluate mistakes made by human versus AI agents in information-seeking interactions? We study this question in an inquiry-response setting in which an agent provides flight-gate information that is epistemically justied at the time of response but false ex post. Building on work on algorithm aversion/appreciation, we distinguish two channels behind humanAI evaluation gaps: a frequency-belief channel (dierent inferred error rates) and a normative-threshold channel (different tolerated error rates, conditional on beliefs). Across two pre-registered experiments with human versus AI framing and description versus experience formats, we measure perceived error frequency, acceptability of the false assertion, and personally tolerated error frequency. We also manipulate true error rates (1% in Experiment 1; 20% in Experiment 2) to test whether equalizing beliefs attenuates the acceptability gap. Results show a robust and substantively large humanAI acceptability gap in both experiments. Beliefs about error frequency are negatively associated with acceptability, but belief dierences are comparatively small and do not fully account for the gap. After frequency information is provided, belief gaps attenuate, whereas acceptability gaps largely persist (with partial attenuation in the high-error environment). Additional analyses show that norm-violation states (perceived errors exceeding personal tolerance) are strongly associated with lower acceptability and mediate a non-trivial share of the humanAI gap. The findings suggest that stricter normative standards for AI, rather than beliefs alone, play a central role in how people evaluate AI mistakes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究人们在信息搜寻互动中如何评价人类与AI代理所犯的错误。通过两项预注册实验（人类vs AI框架、描述vs经验格式），作者区分了频率信念渠道（推断的错误率差异）与规范阈值渠道（对错误的容忍度差异）。结果发现人类与AI之间存在稳健且显著的接受度差距，信念差异较小且不能完全解释该差距，而规范违背状态（感知错误超过个人容忍度）在人机差距中起重要中介作用，表明人们对AI持有更严格的规范标准。
AI.research_question: 在信息搜寻互动中，人们如何评价人类与AI代理犯下的错误？人类与AI评价差距背后的机制是什么——是错误频率信念的差异，还是规范性容忍阈值（标准）的差异？
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理越来越多地参与信息提供任务，理解人们如何评价AI犯错（相对于人类犯错）至关重要。现有研究虽涉及算法厌恶/欣赏，但未清晰区分两个机制渠道：人们可能认为AI更常犯错（信念渠道），也可能在同样信念下对AI错误更不容忍（规范渠道）。厘清这两条渠道对设计AI系统及管理用户预期具有重要理论和实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法厌恶/算法欣赏理论（algorithm aversion/appreciation）；双渠道框架：频率信念渠道（frequency-belief channel）与规范阈值渠道（normative-threshold channel）。
AI.method: 两项预注册实验。实验1真实错误率为1%，实验2为20%。两个实验均操纵人类vs AI框架（framing）与描述vs经验格式（description vs experience formats），测量感知错误频率、虚假陈述可接受性以及个人容忍的错误频率。通过提供频率信息来检验信念均等化是否缩小接受度差距，并使用中介分析和规范违背状态分析。
AI.findings: 1) 两项实验中均存在稳健且实质显著的人机接受度差距。2) 错误频率信念与接受度负相关，但信念差异较小，不能完全解释人机差距。3) 提供频率信息后，信念差距缩小，但接受度差距基本持续存在（高错误率环境下部分减弱）。4) 规范违背状态（感知错误超过个人容忍度）与更低接受度强相关，并在人机差距中起重要的中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将人机评价差距分解为频率信念与规范阈值两个独立渠道，提供了对算法厌恶/欣赏理论的精细化理解，表明人们对AI的规范标准比人类更严格，而非仅因信念不同。丰富了关于人机评价不对称性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 对AI系统设计者和管理者有重要启示：即使AI的错误率信息透明公开，接受度差距仍可能持续存在，因为用户对AI持有更严格的规范性标准。企业需考虑降低AI错误率至更低阈值，或通过设计干预调整用户对AI的规范预期。

title: The Effect of Exchange Rate and Financial Sanctions on the Return of the Tehran Stock Exchange Index
affiliations: University of Birjand, Institute for Humanities and Cultural Studies and University of Birjand

detail.title: The Effect of Exchange Rate and Financial Sanctions on the Return of the Tehran Stock Exchange Index
detail.abstract: This study examines the dynamic effects of exchange rate fluctuations and financial sanctions on the returns of the Tehran Stock Exchange (TSE) Index over the period March 2011 to March 2023. Employing a Time-Varying Parameter Vector Autoregression (TVP-VAR) model, the model captures the evolving and asymmetric interactions between exchange rate growth, sanction intensity-proxied by changes in Iran's oil revenues-and stock market performance. The findings reveal that exchange rate shocks generally stimulate short-term increases in TSE returns but may reverse under heightened uncertainty, while intensified sanctions exert predominantly negative impacts, particularly during the EU oil sanctions period (2012-2015) sanctions and the post-2018 U.S. withdrawal from the JCPOA. Impulse response analysis shows that neither exchange rate nor sanctions shocks converge to long-term equilibrium, indicating structural vulnerabilities and limited market depth within the Iranian financial system. These results contribute to the literature on financial markets in sanction-prone, oil-dependent economies and provide evidence-based insights for policymakers and investors aiming to enhance market stability and resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文使用TVP-VAR模型研究2011年3月至2023年3月期间汇率波动和金融制裁对德黑兰证券交易所（TSE）指数收益的动态影响，发现汇率冲击短期内刺激股市收益但在高不确定性下可能反转，制裁强度（以伊朗石油收入变化为代理）总体产生负面影响，且两类冲击均无法收敛至长期均衡，反映了伊朗金融体系的结构性脆弱性和有限的市场深度。
AI.research_question: 汇率波动和金融制裁如何动态影响德黑兰证券交易所（TSE）指数的收益？
AI.motivation: 伊朗作为受制裁且高度依赖石油的经济体，其金融市场在汇率波动和制裁冲击下的动态反应机制尚不清晰，现有研究缺乏对时变非线性关系的刻画。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时变参数向量自回归（TVP-VAR）模型，捕捉汇率增长、制裁强度与股市表现之间动态演化的非对称互动关系。
AI.method: 采用TVP-VAR模型进行脉冲响应分析，以伊朗石油收入变化作为制裁强度的代理变量，分析2011年3月至2023年3月期间的数据。
AI.findings: （1）汇率冲击通常在短期内刺激TSE收益上升，但在高度不确定性下可能反转；（2）强化制裁产生显著负面影响，尤其在2012-2015年欧盟石油制裁和2018年后美国退出JCPOA时期；（3）汇率和制裁冲击均无法收敛至长期均衡，表明伊朗金融体系存在结构性脆弱性和有限的市场深度。
AI.theory_contributions: 为受制裁且依赖石油的经济体中的金融市场研究提供了新的经验证据，揭示了汇率与制裁冲击对新兴市场股市的非对称和时变效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供基于证据的见解，有助于增强市场稳定性和韧性，指导在制裁环境下的投资决策和风险管理。

title: Seminal Human Behavior Insights

detail.title: Seminal Human Behavior Insights
detail.abstract: This is a condensed version of a monograph I wrote in 2021. The objective is to explain Perceptual Control Theory (PCT) in sufficient detail so that you can make an informed choice about a theory to serve as your foundational understanding of human behavior. Over many years, I have accumulated myriad PCT books and journal articles. As questions concerned me, I have been fortunate to get answers from the leading researchers, including Bill Powers who developed PCT. This paper distills the work of Bill Powers and his colleagues in developing PCT and highlights the potential wide application of PCT.  A widespread belief is that human behavior is about responses to stimuli (e.g., carrots and sticks management approach often seen in business) and/or that our brain plans in detail with incredible speed our every action to deal with disturbances in the environment. In this paper, a strong case is made that these approaches are decidedly inferior to the PCT approach focused on controlled perceptual input. We human beings live purposeful lives which can easily be ignored with a stimulus-response approach to understanding human behavior. Due to a continual stream of environmental disturbances, actions are varied in order to cancel the effects of these disturbances on our perceptions of controlled (important to our goals) variables. Behavior is control of perception. Two sections at the end of this paper, PCT for Business Firms and Concluding Thoughts, may provide new ideas for improving culture and performance measurement at all levels of the firm leading to a higher level of sustained value creation.

AI.tldr: 本文阐释了感知控制理论（PCT），主张人类行为是对感知输入的控制而非对刺激的响应，并探讨了该理论在企业管理和绩效提升方面的广泛应用潜力。
AI.research_question: 感知控制理论（PCT）如何作为理解人类行为的基础理论，并如何应用于企业管理和价值创造？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为人类行为是对刺激的响应（如企业中"胡萝卜加大棒"的管理方式）或大脑以极快速度规划每一个行动，这些方法在解释人类有目的的行为方面存在明显不足，需要一种更优的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 感知控制理论（Perceptual Control Theory, PCT），由Bill Powers发展，核心观点是"行为是对感知的控制"——人类行为旨在抵消环境干扰对受控感知变量（与目标相关的重要变量）的影响。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论阐述：基于作者多年积累的PCT书籍和期刊文章，对Bill Powers及其同事关于PCT的研究工作进行提炼和综合论述。
AI.findings: 1）人类生活是有目的性的，刺激-响应方法容易忽视这一本质；2）面对持续的环境干扰，人类行为的多样性在于消除干扰对目标相关感知的影响；3）PCT方法优于传统的刺激-响应方法和大脑精细规划方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地提炼和展示了PCT作为理解人类行为基础理论的框架，明确指出传统刺激-响应范式的局限性，并论证了"行为即感知控制"的核心命题。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了PCT在企业中的应用思路（PCT for Business Firms），为企业文化改善和各级绩效衡量提供新理念，有助于实现更高水平的持续价值创造。

title: Float Scarcity and Price Formation in Ultra-Low-Float Mega-IPOs

detail.title: Float Scarcity and Price Formation in Ultra-Low-Float Mega-IPOs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study. The research uses only publicly available documents and market information and does not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Ultra-low-float mega-IPOs concentrate, within a single security, several forces that the asset-pricing literature has typically examined in isolation and in retrospective settings: downward-sloping demand for shares, divergence of opinion under short-sale constraints, index-driven demand, scheduled lock-updriven supply expansion, and the difference between headline market capitalization and economic value. This paper establishes the conceptual and methodological foundation for a research program on this class of listings. It advances a framework rather than a result, makes no causal, predictive, or valuation claims, and does not assess whether any security is mispriced. The paper makes two contributions. First, it provides a unified decomposition that defines free float, effective tradable supply, lendable supply, float scarcity, index demand, lock-up supply expansion, headline market capitalization, and an economic value benchmark as separately specified constructs, each associated with a distinct observable proxy and a distinct identifying event. Second, it sets out an identification strategy that specifies, on the partly disclosed event calendar of such a listing, how each channel would be isolated as contractual supply restrictions lapse, as index-inclusion demand arrives, and as borrow and options markets form; fixing these constructs, proxies, and tests prospectively is one of several methodological safeguards-alongside the explicit construct definitions and a documented evidentiary basis-that discipline the empirical work to follow. We treat channel separability as a design objective to be tested rather than as a maintained assumption, and we identify where the relevant event windows overlap and thereby threaten identification. The June 2026 public listing of SpaceX-the largest initial public offering on record, with a base-offering free float of approximately four percent of total common stock-serves as the first worked instance of the class and as an informative empirical setting for the empirical papers that follow; it is a repeatable template rather than evidence, and the empirical execution is carried out in the sequel.

AI.tldr: 本文为"超低流通盘巨型IPO"这一上市类别建立概念与方法论基础。文章提出统一的分析框架，将自由流通盘、有效可交易供给、可借券供给、流通稀缺性、指数需求、锁定期供给扩张、名义市值与经济价值基准等八个概念分别定义，并配套可观测代理变量与识别事件。文章以SpaceX 2026年6月的上市为第一个工作实例，但明确声明本文仅提供框架而非结果，不作因果、预测或估值判断。
AI.research_question: 如何为超低流通盘巨型IPO这一特殊上市类别建立统一的概念框架与识别策略，以隔离资产定价文献中通常被单独且回顾性考察的多重力量（向下倾斜的股票需求、卖空约束下的意见分歧、指数驱动需求、锁定期供给扩张、名义市值与经济价值之差）？
AI.motivation: 超低流通盘巨型IPO在单一证券中集中了资产定价文献通常孤立且在回顾性情境中考察的多种力量，现有文献缺乏一个统一的、前瞻性的框架来同时处理这些渠道，因此需要建立概念与方法论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产定价的相关理论，涵盖向下倾斜的需求曲线、卖空约束下的意见分歧、指数纳入驱动的需求、契约性锁定期供给扩张，以及名义市值与经济价值基准之间的区别等理论与概念。
AI.method: 本文不采用实证方法，而是：（1）提出统一的分解框架，将八个关键概念分别定义并匹配可观测代理变量与识别事件；（2）设定识别策略，利用部分披露的事件日历，在契约性供给限制到期、指数纳入需求到达、借贷与期权市场形成时分别隔离各渠道；（3）将渠道可分离性作为待检验的设计目标而非维持假设，识别事件窗口重叠对识别的威胁。
AI.findings: 本文不产生实证结果，仅产出两个贡献：其一，统一分解框架定义八个独立构造及其代理变量与识别事件；其二，前瞻性识别策略，说明如何在事件日历上隔离各渠道。文章以SpaceX上市为第一个工作实例，作为可重复的模板而非证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 为超低流通盘巨型IPO类别建立概念与方法论基础，将资产定价文献中通常孤立考察的多重力量统一于一个分析框架，为后续实证研究提供结构化的概念定义、代理变量与识别策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 为超低流通盘巨型IPO的实证研究提供可重复的方法论模板，通过明确构造定义、前瞻性设定代理变量与测试、文献化的证据基础等多重方法学保障，规范后续实证工作的开展。SpaceX上市案例作为该类别首次实践，为后续研究提供信息丰富的实证场景。

title: Digital Technology and Models of Demand for and Supply of Religion: Empirical Evidence from World Values Surveys

detail.title: Digital Technology and Models of Demand for and Supply of Religion: Empirical Evidence from World Values Surveys
detail.abstract: Existing studies on secularisation-religious market doctrines largely presume-often implicitly-that forms of religious communication, organisation, and authority are fundamentally territorially bounded and mediated by stable organisational structures. Thus, we develop a framework that simultaneously reexamines the secularisation thesis and the religious market hypothesis with digital connectivity as a structural mediator at the nexus of development, the state and religiosity. Using a panel of 78 countries and data from the World Values Survey, International Religious Freedom, and the Religion and State Project between 2001 and 2022, we estimate a Structural Equation Model (SEM) with Full Information Maximum Likelihood (FIML). The results show that development through digital connectivity is negatively associated with religious beliefs and not religious participation, partially confirming the secularisation thesis. At the same time, we find robust support for the religious market model: state intervention consistently suppresses both participation and belief, and digital connectivity does not fully offset these constraints. These findings make three contributions. First, they demonstrate that new media modifies the mechanisms underlying both secularisation and religious market dynamics. Second, they reconcile competing theories by showing that development produces dual effects: weakening doctrinal belief while sustaining participation through digitally mediated supply. Third, they advance a revised framework in which religiosity persists not despite modernisation, but through its technological transformation.

AI.tldr: 该研究以数字连接性为结构性中介，同时重新审视世俗化理论和宗教市场假说。基于78个国家2001-2022年的面板数据（涵盖世界价值观调查、国际宗教自由和宗教与国家项目），使用结构方程模型（SEM）和全信息最大似然估计（FIML）进行分析。结果表明：通过数字连接实现的发展与宗教信仰负相关（而非宗教参与），部分证实了世俗化理论；同时国家干预持续抑制宗教参与和信仰，数字连接无法完全抵消这些约束，有力支持了宗教市场模型。
AI.research_question: 数字连接性如何作为结构性中介，同时调节发展、国家与宗教性之间的关系，进而影响世俗化理论与宗教市场假说的解释力？
AI.motivation: 现有世俗化理论-宗教市场理论的研究普遍隐含假设宗教的传播形式、组织和权威在本质上是地域性的、由稳定组织结构所中介的，忽视了数字连接性作为结构性中介变量的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 世俗化理论；宗教市场假说（宗教市场模型）；数字连接性作为结构性中介框架
AI.method: 78个国家的面板数据（2001-2022），数据来源包括世界价值观调查（WVS）、国际宗教自由（International Religious Freedom）和宗教与国家项目（Religion and State Project），采用结构方程模型（SEM）搭配全信息最大似然估计（FIML）。
AI.findings: （1）通过数字连接实现的发展与宗教信仰呈负相关，但与宗教参与无显著负相关，部分证实世俗化理论；（2）国家干预持续抑制宗教参与和信仰，数字连接无法完全抵消这些约束，有力支持宗教市场模型。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）证明新媒体（数字连接）修正了世俗化和宗教市场动态背后的机制；（2）调和竞争性理论，表明发展产生双重效应：削弱教义信仰的同时，通过数字化中介供给维持宗教参与；（3）提出修订框架：宗教性在现代化进程中并非消失，而是通过技术转型得以延续。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和宗教组织提供了关于数字时代宗教传播与管理的新视角，揭示了国家干预与数字连接在宗教生态中的交互作用。

title:
The Bulrix Score

A Calibrated Standard for the Risk Inside Homes and Buildings

detail.title:
The Bulrix Score

A Calibrated Standard for the Risk Inside Homes and Buildings
detail.abstract: The Bulrix Score A Calibrated Standard for the Risk Inside Homes and Buildings How a stewardship-based score on a permanent building record protects home value and reduces risk for warranty providers, insurers, and lenders Sebin Joseph • Bulrix Research • Version 2.2 (final) • July 2026 • Model: bulrix-2.1.0 (shipped, conformance-audited)

AI.tldr: 本文提出Bulrix评分系统，这是一种基于托管原则（stewardship-based）的校准标准，用于评估房屋和建筑物内部风险。该评分被记录在永久性建筑档案上，旨在保护房屋价值，并降低保修提供商、保险公司和贷款机构的风险敞口。论文提供了bulrix-2.1.0模型的最终版本及合规审计说明。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个校准的、基于托管原则的建筑内部风险评估标准（Bulrix评分），并将其记录在永久建筑档案上，以保护房屋价值并降低各类利益相关方的风险？
AI.motivation: 房屋和建筑物内部风险缺乏统一、校准的评估标准，导致保修提供商、保险公司和贷款机构难以准确量化风险，且建筑风险信息缺乏永久记录以保护房屋长期价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 托管原则（Stewardship-based approach）、风险评估校准理论、永久建筑档案记录框架
AI.method: 提出Bulrix评分模型（bulrix-2.1.0），采用校准标准对建筑内部风险进行量化评分，并将评分纳入永久建筑档案体系，通过合规审计确保模型可信度。
AI.findings: Bulrix评分能够作为校准的风险标准，通过永久建筑记录保护房屋价值，并为保修提供商、保险公司和贷款机构提供统一的风险衡量基准。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于托管原则的建筑风险评估理论框架，将风险评分与永久建筑档案相结合，拓展了建筑风险评估领域的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保修提供商、保险公司和贷款机构提供标准化的风险衡量工具，有助于降低风险敞口；同时通过永久建筑记录保护房屋价值，具有实际应用价值。

title: Rationalizing the Overhead Myth: Donor Aversion as a Selection Mechanism
affiliations: Rutgers Business School -- Newark and New Brunswick and Mississippi State University

detail.title: Rationalizing the Overhead Myth: Donor Aversion as a Selection Mechanism
detail.abstract: The overhead myth-the belief that a charity's fundraising ratio measures how well it serves its mission-has been debunked repeatedly since 2009, yet donors, raters, and regulators keep using the ratio. We argue the myth persists because it works, not as a way to rank charities but as a way to select them. Modeling fundraising as investment in a durable, depreciating stock of donor relationships, we show three things. First, the ratio is a poor ranking device: it confounds fundraising productivity with life cycle, volatility, and revenue mix, so a more effective charity can report a higher ratio than a less effective one. Second, donor aversion to the ratio in effect taxes fundraising, and the tax is survivable only for charities whose fundraising is productive and whose donor relationships are durable. Below a quality threshold, fundraising policy cannot offset depreciation and the charity is starved out. Third, this starvation is not merely a cost; it is a selection mechanism. Donor overhead aversion culls low-quality fundraisers and raises the quality floor of the surviving sector. If fundraising is competitive across entities, culling the least effective fundraisers can raise the output the sector delivers per donated dollar. The same filter, however, is biased against young, growing, and donation-reliant charities, which it culls along with the genuinely ineffective. Whether the overhead myth is on balance beneficial or detrimental, thus, is an empirical question about the distribution of fundraising quality, not a settled case of donor myopia.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"管理费用率神话"这一普遍认知，提出该神话之所以持续存在，是因为它不仅仅是排名工具，更是一种选择机制。作者将筹款建模为对持久性捐赠关系资产的折旧投资，论证了管理费用率作为排名工具存在缺陷，但作为筛选机制可以淘汰低质量筹款组织，同时也会误伤年轻、成长型和依赖捐赠的组织。
AI.research_question: 为什么管理费用率神话即使被反复证伪后仍然持续存在？这一神话对慈善部门的影响究竟是正面的还是负面的？
AI.motivation: 尽管自2009年以来管理费用率神话已被反复证伪，但捐赠者、评级机构和监管者仍在使用这一指标。现有研究多将其视为捐赠者短视行为，本文试图提供新的解释视角——该神话之所以持续，是因为它在功能性上服务于选择机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将筹款建模为对耐用性、可折旧的捐赠关系存量进行投资的经济模型，结合组织生命周期、收入结构和筹款生产率等理论视角。
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，构建筹款作为折旧投资的经济模型，通过模型推导论证管理费用率作为排名工具和选择机制的不同性质。
AI.findings: 三方面发现：（1）管理费用率是糟糕的排名工具，因为它混淆了筹款生产率与生命周期、波动性和收入结构；（2）捐赠者对管理费用率的厌恶相当于对筹款征税，只有筹款生产高效且捐赠关系持久的组织才能生存；（3）这种"饿死"机制不是纯粹的成本，而是一种选择机制——淘汰低质量筹款者并提高存活部门的整体质量底线，但对年轻、成长型和依赖捐赠的慈善组织存在系统性偏见。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将管理费用率神话重新概念化为功能性的选择机制而非单纯的认知谬误；建立了筹款作为折旧投资的经济模型；指出该神话的利弊是一个关于筹款质量分布的实证问题，而非已定的捐赠者短视案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为捐赠者、评级机构和监管者重新思考管理费用率的使用提供了理论基础；提示政策制定者需要关注该指标对不同类型慈善组织的差异化影响；强调需要更多实证研究来评估该神话的实际净效应。

title: The Legal Determination of Currency Value: Contradictions of Economic Theories and Econometric Projections 2026-2045
affiliations: and Universidad de los Andes, Venezuela

detail.title: The Legal Determination of Currency Value: Contradictions of Economic Theories and Econometric Projections 2026-2045
detail.abstract: This article critically examines the five most widespread explanations of how the value of one currency against another is determined: international reserves, portfolio theory linked to the size of economies, the law of supply and demand, the trust of countries, and mathematical patterns. Drawing on literature indexed in Scopus and Web of Science, it shows that these theories incur mutual logical contradictions and that none of them consistently outperforms the random walk in exchange rate forecasting. Through an econometric exercise using eurodollar exchange rate data from 2000 to 2025 and twenty-year projections (2026-2045), the indeterminacy of economic predictions is quantified: the 95% confidence interval reaches a width of 136% of the projected central level. By contrast, International Monetary Fund evidence shows that more than two thirds of States fix the value of their currency through legal decisions-anchors, bands and managed arrangements-and the projected trend raises that proportion toward 2045. The article concludes that contemporary currency value is predominantly a legal-institutional fact rather than the outcome of an economic rule.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地考察了五种最流行的汇率决定理论（国际储备、投资组合理论、供需法则、国家信任、数学模式），通过文献分析与2000-2025年欧元兑美元汇率的经济计量分析，证明了这些理论存在相互逻辑矛盾且均无法优于随机游走预测；同时引用IMF证据表明超过三分之二的国家通过法律决定（锚定、波幅、管理安排）固定货币价值，且该比例预计到2045年还将上升，从而得出结论：当代货币价值主要是法律-制度事实而非经济规则的结果。
AI.research_question: 当代货币价值究竟是由经济规则决定，还是由法律-制度安排决定的？现有五种主流汇率决定理论能否有效解释和预测汇率？
AI.motivation: 现有的五种主流汇率决定理论（国际储备、投资组合理论、供需法则、国家信任、数学模式）在解释和预测汇率时存在相互矛盾且预测效果不佳的问题，这促使作者重新审视货币价值决定的本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 汇率决定理论（国际储备理论、投资组合理论、供需法则、国家信任理论、数学模式/技术分析），以及法律-制度视角下的货币价值理论（法定货币理论）。
AI.method: 基于Scopus和Web of Science索引文献的系统性批判分析；对2000-2025年欧元兑美元汇率数据进行经济计量分析，并进行2026-2045年20年期预测以量化经济预测的不确定性；引用国际货币基金组织（IMF）的汇率安排制度证据。
AI.findings: (1) 五种主流汇率决定理论之间存在相互逻辑矛盾，且均无法在汇率预测中一致地优于随机游走模型；(2) 经济预测具有高度不确定性——95%置信区间宽度达到预测中心水平的136%；(3) IMF数据显示超过三分之二的国家通过法律决策（锚定、波幅和管理安排）固定货币价值，且该比例预计到2045年将继续上升；(4) 因此，当代货币价值在本质上是一种法律-制度事实，而非经济规则的结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了经济学中主流的汇率决定理论范式，提出了货币价值的"法律-制度事实"理论视角，将货币本质从经济学分析框架拓展到法律-制度分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 对汇率预测实践提出警示，指出经济模型预测的高度不确定性；对政策制定者和国际金融机构提供理论依据，强调法律与制度安排在货币价值形成中的核心作用，有助于理解各国汇率制度选择的深层逻辑。

title: Multilevel Analysis of the Perceived Greenwashing Across Age Cohorts
affiliations: Tehran University, , Presidency University and Tehran University

detail.title: Multilevel Analysis of the Perceived Greenwashing Across Age Cohorts
detail.abstract: Amid growing consumer demand for sustainability, corporate greenwashing-deceptive environmental marketing-has emerged as a significant threat to consumer trust. This study aims to develop a multilevel model to identify the key predictors of Perceived Greenwashing (PGW), with a specific focus on the role of generational cohorts in a cross-national context. A survey was conducted with 280 consumers from India and Iran. Multilevel Modelling (MLM) or Hierarchical Linear Modelling (HLM) was employed to analyse the data, with individuals (Level 1) nested within countries (Level 2), and predictors including generational cohort, awareness of greenwashing (AG), and exposure to greenwashing (EG). The analysis revealed that consumer awareness (β = 0.510) and exposure (β = 0.301) are the most powerful positive predictors of PGW. Critically, the widely assumed effect of generational cohort becomes non-significant after controlling for these experiential factors. Perceptions of industry type and regulations also emerged as significant, albeit smaller, predictors. The findings suggest that the perception of greenwashing is driven more by cognitive and experiential factors than by demographic identity. This study contributes to the literature by reframing the 'generational effect' as a function of information exposure and awareness. For practitioners, it underscores the importance of targeting consumer knowledge levels.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过多水平模型分析印度和伊朗280名消费者的调查数据，发现消费者对绿色漂洗的感知主要由认知和经验因素（意识和暴露程度）驱动，而非世代群体差异。这一发现挑战了广泛假设的"世代效应"。
AI.research_question: 在跨国背景下，感知绿色漂洗（PGW）的关键预测因素是什么？世代群体在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 企业绿色漂洗（欺骗性环保营销）对消费者信任构成重大威胁，而消费者对可持续性的需求日益增长。理解感知绿色漂洗的驱动因素对于保护消费者信任至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多水平模型理论框架，结合世代理论、认知与经验因素（意识、暴露）来解释消费者对绿色漂洗的感知。
AI.method: 对印度和伊朗280名消费者进行问卷调查，采用多水平模型（MLM/HLM）分析数据，个体（水平1）嵌套于国家（水平2）之中，预测变量包括世代群体、绿色漂洗意识和暴露程度。
AI.findings: 消费者意识（β=0.510）和暴露程度（β=0.301）是感知绿色漂洗最强的正向预测因素；在控制这些经验因素后，世代群体的影响变得不显著；行业类型感知和法规感知也是显著但较小的预测因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"世代效应"重新概念化为信息暴露和意识的功能，挑战了将世代作为人口统计学身份来解释绿色漂洗感知的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调企业和管理者应关注提升消费者知识水平，而非仅仅针对特定世代群体进行营销策略。

title: Analytical Redundancy for False Alarm Suppression in Edge-based Semiconductor Process Control

detail.title: Analytical Redundancy for False Alarm Suppression in Edge-based Semiconductor Process Control

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No Funding recieved, it's my personal interest.
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: With the scaling of semiconductor manufacturing technology towards sub-7nm nodes, the need for real-time Statistical Process Control (SPC) has led to the use of Tiny Machine Learning (TinyML) on the edge. However, applying univariate anomaly detection algorithms on resource-limited microcontrollers poses an inherent risk, namely that of distinguishing whether the observed anomaly is due to real yield-affecting process excursion or simply isolated sensor failure. This paper presents a novel, localized causal verification method which offers an analytical solution to the problem without the necessity of any additional hardware infrastructure or cloud connection. Using hierarchical agglomerative clustering to map mutual information of anonymized fab sensors into "Virtual Modules," the presented method is able to interrupt traditional Cumulative Sum (CUSUM) signals and assess spatial-temporal stability of neighboring sensors. Testing the proposed solution on the SECOM semiconductor manufacturing dataset resulted in a ternary diagnosis, separating sensor fault from real process change with nearly 100% false alarm reduction while maintaining 100% anomaly sensitivity. Additionally, micro-architectural profiling proves the algorithm requires less memory space and runs within a microsecond latency range, ensuring viability of the approach for cloud-less, ultra-low power edge deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于半导体制造边缘TinyML场景的局部因果验证方法，通过层次凝聚聚类将传感器映射为"虚拟模块"，利用互信息评估相邻传感器的时空稳定性，以区分真实工艺偏移与传感器故障。在SECOM数据集上实现了近100%的误报消除，同时保持100%的异常灵敏度，算法在微控制器上运行于微秒延迟范围内。
AI.research_question: 在资源受限的微控制器上部署TinyML进行实时统计过程控制时，如何区分异常是由真实影响良率的工艺偏移引起，还是仅由孤立的传感器故障导致？
AI.motivation: 随着半导体制造向亚7nm节点扩展，实时SPC需要TinyML在边缘运行。然而，在资源受限的微控制器上应用单变量异常检测算法存在固有风险——无法区分真实工艺偏移与传感器故障，可能导致误报警或漏报警。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统计过程控制(SPC)、Tiny机器学习(TinyML)、互信息理论、层次凝聚聚类(HAC)、累积和(CUSUM)控制图方法
AI.method: 提出一种局部化因果验证方法：1) 利用层次凝聚聚类将匿名的晶圆厂传感器按互信息映射为"虚拟模块"；2) 中断传统CUSUM信号；3) 评估相邻传感器的时空稳定性以进行三元诊断（真实工艺变化 vs 传感器故障）。在SECOM数据集上测试，并进行微架构剖析验证资源可行性。
AI.findings: 该方法在SECOM半导体制造数据集上实现了三元诊断，将传感器故障与真实工艺变化分离，误报减少近100%，同时保持100%的异常灵敏度。微架构剖析表明算法所需内存更少，运行时间在微秒延迟范围内。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了一种新的局部因果验证框架，将互信息聚类与CUSUM信号中断相结合，解决了TinyML边缘场景中单变量异常检测的固有歧义问题；2) 通过"虚拟模块"概念实现了无额外硬件条件下的传感器故障与真实工艺偏移的因果区分。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 无需额外硬件基础设施或云连接即可实现传感器故障与真实工艺偏移的区分，适用于无云、超低功耗边缘部署；2) 算法资源占用低（内存更小、微秒级延迟），验证了其在资源受限微控制器上的可行性，为半导体制造实时SPC提供了实用方案。

title: Community Knowledge Preservation and Activation Program (CKPAP™): A Framework for Preserving, Activating, and Transmitting the Knowledge Communities Have Always Carried

detail.title: Community Knowledge Preservation and Activation Program (CKPAP™): A Framework for Preserving, Activating, and Transmitting the Knowledge Communities Have Always Carried

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript is a conceptual and theoretical work. It does not report research involving human participants, identifiable personal data, or animal subjects. Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external grant funding. The research, framework development, and manuscript preparation were independently conducted by the author.

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the Community Knowledge Preservation and Activation Program (CKPAP) as a comprehensive community-centered framework for identifying, preserving, translating, and transmitting experiential knowledge developed within grassroots, faith-based, artistic, cultural, culinary, and community environments. CKPAP is the fourth paper in the Brown Theory of Experiential Intelligence ecosystem and represents its most community-grounded contribution.

The paper argues that community knowledge — the accumulated wisdom of cooks who out-cook credentialed chefs, musicians who transmit cultural memory across generations, faith leaders who counsel without clinical titles, grassroots organizers who stabilize neighborhoods without institutional authority, and artists whose work embodies centuries of community identity — represents one of humanity's most significant and most systematically underpreserved intellectual resources. This knowledge disappears not gradually but suddenly, through displacement, death, gentrification, political disruption, and institutional neglect. CKPAP was developed to address that disappearance before it becomes irreversible.

Grounded in Paulo Freire's philosophy of naming as liberation, Dorothy Smith's institutional ethnography, Etienne Wenger's communities of practice theory, and the Brown Theory of Experiential Intelligence, the paper presents CKPAP's six governing principles, four-phase methodology, and a comprehensive implementation toolkit of nine tools designed for use across diverse community contexts. New Orleans serves throughout as the benchmark implementation context — a city whose cultural knowledge is simultaneously among the richest and most extracted in the world, and whose communities demonstrate that when the methodology works here, it works anywhere.

The paper concludes with an ethical framework and a future research agenda, arguing that the preservation of community knowledge is not a supplemental scholarly activity but a form of community protection — and that institutions seeking to serve communities honestly must develop the capacity to recognize and honor the knowledge communities have always carried.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了社区知识保存与激活项目（CKPAP），这是一个以社区为中心的综合框架，用于识别、保存、翻译和传播在草根、信仰、艺术、文化、烹饪和社区环境中形成的经验知识。这是Brown体验智力理论生态系统的第四篇论文，也是其最具社区根基的贡献。论文以新奥尔良为基准实施背景，提出了六大治理原则、四阶段方法论和九种实施工具，并认为社区知识保存不是补充性的学术活动，而是一种社区保护形式。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地识别、保存、翻译和传播社区经验知识，以防止其在流离失所、死亡、绅士化、政治动荡和制度忽视中突然消失？
AI.motivation: 社区知识——包括超越专业厨师水平的厨师、跨代传递文化记忆的音乐家、无临床头衔的信仰领袖、无制度权威却能稳定社区的草根组织者以及体现数百年社区身份认同的艺术家所积累的智慧——是人类最重要却被最系统性低估保存的知识资源之一。这些知识不是逐渐消失，而是通过流离失所、死亡、绅士化、政治动荡和制度忽视突然消失，亟需在不可逆转之前加以保存。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) Paulo Freire的命名即解放哲学；2) Dorothy Smith的制度民族志；3) Etienne Wenger的实践共同体理论；4) Brown体验智力理论（本文所属的理论生态系统）。
AI.method: 本文提出了CKPAP框架，包括六大治理原则、四阶段方法论以及包含九种工具的综合性实施工具包，并以新奥尔良作为基准实施城市进行方法论验证。
AI.findings: CKPAP框架能够为多样化的社区背景提供系统性的社区知识保存与激活方案。新奥尔良作为基准实施背景展示了方法的可行性——该城市的文化知识既是最丰富也是被榨取最多的之一，其社区证明当方法论在此有效时，在任何地方都有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将社区知识保存概念化为社区保护的一种形式，而非补充性的学术活动；2) 扩展了Brown体验智力理论的应用范围，使其更具社区根基；3) 整合Freire、Smith和Wenger的理论，构建了社区知识保存的系统框架；4) 提出了一个完整的伦理框架和未来研究议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了六大治理原则、四阶段方法论和九种实施工具的详细操作框架；2) 以新奥尔良为基准场景验证了方法的可实施性；3) 呼吁寻求诚实服务社区的制度机构发展识别和尊重社区知识的能力；4) 为各类社区环境中的知识保存提供了可复制的实践工具包。

title: A Scalable and Secure Framework for AI Deployment in High-Impact Sectors

detail.title: A Scalable and Secure Framework for AI Deployment in High-Impact Sectors

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author has no personal or financial relationships with any organizations that could have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or patient data. All data used in this research were obtained from publicly available datasets (BUSI - Breast Ultrasound Images Dataset). Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: As industries increasingly adopt AI-driven solutions, scalable and secure infrastructures become essential to manage data-intensive operations. This paper presents a modular design for scalable AI infrastructure that integrates advanced security protocols with cloud-native technologies. The proposed architecture ensures data integrity, protects sensitive information, and adapts to evolving workload demands. Applications in healthcare and finance are analyzed to demonstrate the model's versatility, highlighting improvements in scalability, reliability, and compliance.
